jobs.excerpt: Role: Senior Associate - Policy Engagement, Mumbai Experience: 4+ years Salary: 9 to 12 LPA Role OverviewWe seek individuals to work in our Policy Engagement vertical and help us in the creation of evidence-backed collaterals.
jobs.description:
Role: Senior Associate - Policy Engagement, Mumbai
Experience: 4+ years
Salary: 9 to 12 LPA

Role Overview
We seek individuals to work in our Policy Engagement vertical and help us in the creation of evidence-backed collaterals. This will involve conducting literature reviews, analyzing government budgets, policies, and programs, reviewing existing evidence, and liaising with academics and experts to produce sharp insights, policy briefs, and actionable toolkits.
This role requires a solid understanding of public policy in India, social research methodologies, and program evaluation. Most importantly, the ideal candidate must have a strong belief that cash transfers empower people with choice, dignity, and the ability to carve their own path out of poverty.
Key Responsibilities:
Research & Data Analysis
  • Work closely with the policy research and program teams to conduct evidence-based research on social policies and author articles and briefs.
  • Develop concept notes and decks for proposed ideas and programs.
  • Support in producing comprehensive research reports, whitepapers, and presentations for stakeholders.
  • Ensure wide dissemination of insights into the cash transfer movement, including existing schemes, internal implementation, and global research.
  • Support monitoring, evaluation, and data analysis efforts, including building research tools for program implementation.
Policy Engagement
  • Undertake rigorous analysis of different aspects of the cash transfer movement in India to understand gap areas and potential solutions to strengthen our role in enabling cost-effective impact at scale.
  • Support the team in developing and executing a policy engagement plan to engage with relevant stakeholders, including governments.
Communication
  • Effectively communicate research findings to stakeholders through slide decks, concept notes, policy briefs, op-eds, newspaper articles, and journals.
  • Build and maintain stakeholder relationships independently.
Qualifications and Experience:
  • Education: A Master's degree in Economics, Public Policy, Development Studies, or a related field is strongly preferred.
  • Work Experience: At least 3 years of full-time, relevant work experience with a preferred Master's degree.
  • Alternatively, candidates with a Master's degree and at least 6 years of full-time work experience in empirical analysis, policy-focused research, and writing will be considered.
  • Candidates with over 3 years of experience working with government stakeholders on a day-to-day basis are highly preferred.
Technical Skills:
  • Experience in preparing high-quality policy briefs, research papers, and concept notes is required.
  • Experience working with government orders, budgets, and policies is required.
  • Experience with quantitative and qualitative research methodologies, data analysis, and interpretation is required.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office tools is required.
  • Prior experience with data analysis software such as Stata, R, JAMOVI, or Tableau is preferred.
  • Familiarity with major Indian research datasets and experience compiling/using complex, large-scale datasets is preferred.
Knowledge & Competencies:
  • Familiarity with cash transfer programs, poverty dynamics, social security systems, and fieldwork is a strong plus.
  • Understanding of macroeconomics, public policy, and development economics is a strong plus.
  • Demonstrated commitment to ethical research practices and a passion for social justice.
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to convey complex research findings to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment, handling uncertainties, and adapting quickly to organizational needs.
  • Language & Travel:
    • Ability to understand Marathi; proficiency in reading, writing, and speaking the language is preferred.
Hiring Process:
Step 1: R1 with co-founder
Step 2: Assignment
Step 3: R2 with other co-founder
-
Hiring Note: Applications will be reviewed on rolling basis. This job is reposted on November 12, 2026 on Ground Zero

For any questions, ping us on WhatsApp chat: +91-8058331557

About Rippling

Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.

Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.

Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1.2B from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.

We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.

About the role

We're looking for an experienced payroll specialist to join Rippling’s Global Payroll Operations team. We are rapidly expanding Rippling to serve the needs of employees and employers all over the world. Our Global Payroll Operations team plays a critical role in ensuring the success of our global payroll products, which are natively built and fully integrated with Rippling’s broader suite of products.

As Rippling expands its product offerings globally, there is a critical business need for Rippling to develop new muscles around global product operations and country-specific payroll expertise outside of the US.

This role, Global Payroll Operations Specialist, is a critical hire for the Global Payroll Operations team that will be fully dedicated to developing and executing these new capabilities. This role will own all operational aspects across select countries, relationships with our external partners, and drive our expansion into new customer segments and geographies. Additionally, this role brings critical country-specific payroll expertise to support the development of our natively built payroll software.

This is an exciting role that requires significant cross-departmental engagement with a major impact on the product and customer experience.

What you will do

  • Execute timely payroll, filings, and payments for all customers across key countries
  • Drive issue resolution and communication with various government agencies and partners; you will directly interface with our customers and resolve issues on their behalf
  • Work closely with Global Payroll Engineering and Product teams to ensure that:
    • Natively built payroll software supports key payroll and tax compliance requirements
    • Product bugs and product issues (e.g., calculation errors, file generation errors) are quickly addressed
    • Internal tooling requirements are properly prioritised and implemented

What you will need

  • Minimum of 5+ years in a UAE payroll processing role, and ideally 2+ years in a client facing role
  • Expert knowledge of UAE payroll.
  • Bonus if you have experience running payroll in other EMEA countries.
  • Process payroll activities in accordance with company guidelines, social security, legislations and local taxes requirements.
  • Experience with Google Suite or Microsoft Office, especially Docs/Sheets/Excel, for data analysis and task organisation; familiarity with Salesforce queues, JIRA, and Confluence a plus
  • Ability to review and validate calculations
  • Must have understanding of payroll concepts
  • Strong knowledge of payroll regulations
  • Has working experience with payroll related systems and software
  • Deep understanding of the leave entitlements
  • Good knowledge of labor legislation
  • Strong organisational skills and able to work under strict deadlines
  • Fluent in Arabic and English - written and spoken

Please apply with CV in English

Direct experience working with major Investor-Owned Utilities (IOUs), municipal utilities, public utility districts, and electric cooperatives. Advanced knowledge of utility construction methods, utility contract structures, labor productivity factors, and cost estimating principles. Experience with computerized estimating and bidding software and proficiency with Microsoft Office applications. Knowledge of utility work methods, grid modernization programs, wildfire mitigation programs, underground distribution, and transmission line construction. Experience supporting master service agreements (MSAs), unit-price contracts, and utility capital improvement programs.   • Implement zero-trust network security architectures
  • Design and configure network access control (NAC) solutions

jobs.excerpt: Get to know us betterCodiLime is a software and network engineering industry expert and the first-choice service partner for top global networking hardware providers, software providers and telecoms.
jobs.description:
Get to know us better

CodiLime is a software and network engineering industry expert and the first-choice service partner for top global networking hardware providers, software providers and telecoms. We create proofs-of-concept, help our clients build new products, nurture existing ones and provide services in production environments. Our clients include both tech startups and big players in various industries and geographic locations (US, Japan, Israel, Europe).

While no longer a startup - we have 250+ people on board and have been operating since 2011 we’ve kept our people-oriented culture. Our values are simple:

  • Act to deliver.

  • Disrupt to grow.

  • Team up to win.

The project and the team

You will join the team behind a leading network source-of-truth (NSoT) platform, used by thousands of organizations - from fast-growing tech companies to Fortune 500 enterprises - to model, document, and automate their network infrastructure.

CodiLime engineers work within the platform's Observability team, which connects the network source of truth with what is actually running on the network. The team builds products for network discovery, network assurance (detecting drift between the intended and the actual state of the network), management of the agents that collect discovery and telemetry data, and a reliable pipeline that ingests this data into the platform.

The platform is built AI-first, with its own Claude Code agent skills and MCP server, and that mindset carries over to how the team works: Claude Code is used heavily day to day to help the team move fast and consistently deliver high-quality results.

In this role, you will build and run the infrastructure and tooling behind the platform's products - from AWS and Kubernetes environments, through CI/CD pipelines, to the observability stack - for both the SaaS and on-premise versions of the platform. The scale is significant: some of the platform's largest customers manage hundreds of thousands of devices across globally distributed environments.

As the observability offering keeps growing, the team is looking for a Senior DevOps Engineer who manages infrastructure through code and automation, owns the reliability of what they deploy, and works closely with developers to get code to production.

Technology stack:

  • Cloud: AWS (EC2, VPC, IAM, RDS, EKS)

  • Containerization & orchestration: Kubernetes (EKS), Docker, Docker Compose

  • Infrastructure as code: Terraform, Helm

  • CI/CD: GitHub Actions

  • Observability: Prometheus, Grafana, Mimir, Loki, OpenTelemetry

  • Programming & scripting: Python, Go, shell scripting

  • Data & messaging: PostgreSQL (RDS), event streaming and CDC, RabbitMQ, MQTT

  • Security & compliance: IAM, SOC 2 controls, OAuth2

  • APIs: REST, gRPC

  • AI tooling: Claude Code, MCP servers, Anthropic tooling

What else you should know:

  • Small, cross-functional team with strong ownership of reliability, security and automation

  • The team is distributed across Europe and the US, and we are looking for someone whose working hours can overlap with the US East Coast

  • AI tools are part of the daily workflow - Claude Code is used heavily across the team

  • This is an infrastructure-focused role, working closely with the product teams to connect code to production

  • Startup-like vibe: proactive, ownership-driven, fast-paced

We work on multiple interesting projects at a time, so it may happen that we’ll invite you to an interview for another project if we see that your competencies and profile are well suited for it.

Your role

As a part of the project team, you will be responsible for:

  • Designing, building and maintaining infrastructure for both the SaaS and on-premise versions of the platform

  • Operating and optimizing AWS infrastructure (EKS, EC2, VPC, IAM, RDS) for cost, security and performance

  • Managing infrastructure as code with Terraform and Helm

  • Building and improving CI/CD pipelines in GitHub Actions and internal platform tooling that lets developers serve themselves

  • Improving monitoring, alerting and incident response, and defining SLOs (Prometheus, Grafana, Mimir, Loki)

  • Helping enforce security and compliance standards, including SOC 2 controls

  • Working closely with the product teams to get code to production reliably

  • Contributing to documentation and onboarding, and taking part in the on-call rotation

  • Using Claude Code day to day: setting constraints, reviewing the output and staying accountable for correctness and security

Do we have a match?

As a Senior DevOps Engineer, you must meet the following criteria:

  • 7+ years of experience in DevOps, SRE or platform engineering

  • Strong experience with AWS, especially EKS and Kubernetes

  • Experience with infrastructure as code using Terraform and Helm

  • CI/CD experience (ideally GitHub Actions)

  • Experience with observability tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, Mimir or Loki, and with OpenTelemetry

  • Proficiency in Python, Go or shell scripting

  • Experience with CDC and event streaming, or with scaling large multi-tenant observability systems

  • Comfort in a fast-paced, ambiguous startup environment

  • Hands-on, everyday use of AI coding tools (ideally Claude Code)

  • Strong communication and documentation skills

  • Availability for an on-call rotation and working hours overlapping with the US East Coast

  • Good knowledge of English (minimum C1 level)

Beyond the criteria above, we would appreciate the following nice-to-haves:

  • Experience with SOC 2 or other security-focused environments

  • Experience with messaging technologies such as MQTT or AMQP (e.g. RabbitMQ)

  • Familiarity with network source-of-truth or network automation tooling

  • Open-source contributions

  • Experience working in a B2B software startup (ideally 2+ years)

More reasons to join us

  • Flexible working hours and approach to work: fully remotely, in the office or hybrid

  • Professional growth supported by internal training sessions and a training budget

  • Solid onboarding with a hands-on approach to give you an easy start

  • A great atmosphere among professionals who are passionate about their work

  • The ability to change the project you work on

jobs.description:
For 30 years, Surgical Information Systems (SIS) has empowered surgical providers to Operate Smart™ by delivering innovative software and services that drive clinical, financial, and operational success.

SIS provides comprehensive technology and services for ambulatory surgery centers (ASCs), including practice management software, electronic health records (EHRs), patient engagement solutions, compliance technology, and revenue cycle management services. SIS also supports hospital perioperative teams with specialized software solutions.

Trusted by more than 2,900 surgical facilities, SIS is committed to helping healthcare organizations improve efficiency, optimize financial performance, and focus on delivering exceptional patient care.

At SIS, we believe our people drive our success. We foster a culture built on respect, integrity, accountability, client focus, bias for action, and continuous improvement. As a nationally recognized Top Workplace, we strive to provide an environment where employees can contribute, grow, and make a meaningful impact.

The Business Development Representative (BDR) is responsible for generating new business opportunities through targeted outbound sales campaigns and proactive prospect engagement. This role focuses on identifying prospective customers, connecting with key decision-makers, qualifying leads, and developing a consistent pipeline of sales opportunities for SIS software and revenue cycle services.

The BDR will collaborate closely with Sales and Marketing to execute outreach strategies, engage prospective customers, and schedule qualified sales meetings. Success requires strong communication skills, persistence, organization, and the ability to effectively communicate the value of SIS solutions.

Key Responsibilities

Outbound Prospecting & Lead Generation

  • Execute targeted outbound campaigns through cold calling, email, and other direct outreach methods to generate new business opportunities.
  • Research and identify prospective customers, key decision-makers, and target accounts within the ambulatory surgery center market.
  • Develop personalized messaging that communicates the value of SIS software and revenue cycle services.
  • Conduct consistent follow-up with prospects to build relationships, generate interest, and advance sales conversations.
  • Identify potential customer needs and opportunities aligned with SIS solutions.

Sales Pipeline Development

  • Qualify prospective customers based on business needs, decision-making authority, timing, and potential fit.
  • Schedule qualified discovery meetings for Account Executives and sales leadership.
  • Collaborate with the Sales team to ensure effective handoffs and continued engagement with qualified prospects.
  • Maintain accurate prospect information, activity records, lead status, and pipeline information in Salesforce CRM.
  • Consistently work toward established outbound activity, qualified meeting, and pipeline generation goals.

Campaign Execution & Collaboration

  • Partner with Sales and Marketing to execute outbound campaigns targeting priority customer segments and accounts.
  • Track campaign results and identify opportunities to improve prospect engagement and conversion rates.
  • Develop knowledge of SIS products, services, competitive positioning, and the challenges facing healthcare providers.
  • Share market insights and prospect feedback to support improvements in sales messaging and campaign effectiveness.

Required Qualifications

  • Minimum of 18 months of experience in B2B software sales, revenue cycle management, sales development, or business development.
  • Experience conducting outbound prospecting, including cold calling, email outreach, and lead generation.
  • Demonstrated ability to engage prospective customers, qualify leads, and generate sales opportunities.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate with business decision-makers.
  • Experience using Salesforce to manage leads, document sales activities, and track opportunities.
  • Strong organizational and time management skills with the ability to manage multiple outbound campaigns and prospect follow-ups.
  • Ability to work independently, take initiative, and achieve established performance objectives.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience selling SaaS solutions, healthcare technology, revenue cycle management software, or related services.
  • Familiarity with ambulatory surgery centers, healthcare operations, or revenue cycle processes such as billing, collections, and denials management.
  • Experience working collaboratively with Account Executives to generate and advance qualified sales opportunities.
  • Understanding of account-based prospecting and outbound campaign strategies.

BENEFITS:

  • Benefit package including Medical, Vision, Dental, Short Term Disability, Long Term Disability, and Life Insurance
  • Vacation/Sick time
  • 401(k) retirement plan with company match
  • Paid Holidays
  • SIS Cares Day
  • Hybrid or Remote environment depending on the role

jobs.description:
Position Summary:

The Closing Specialist is responsible for coordinating real estate closings and managing the full lifecycle of closing transactions. This includes assembling, preparing, reviewing, and verifying loan closing documents while ensuring compliance with all applicable state, federal, and regulatory requirements. This role manages an active pipeline of transactions to ensure files are completed accurately, on time, and in accordance with established service level agreements while delivering high-quality support to clients, lenders, and settlement partners.

Essential Functions:

  • Assemble, prepare, review, and verify all documents required for loan closings, including contracts, settlement statements, closing disclosures, mortgages, deeds, and title policies, ensuring accuracy and completeness.
  • Prepare preliminary and final settlement statements, including Closing Disclosures (CD) and ALTA statements, and manage revisions and approvals as needed.
  • Review and revise closing documents to meet lender requirements, ensuring full compliance with regulatory, investor, and company guidelines prior to transmitting finalized packages to settlement agents.
  • Coordinate the closing process, including scheduling and execution of document signings, while ensuring all required documentation is complete prior to closing.
  • Perform final pre-closing reviews of title fees, taxes, premiums, endorsements, vesting, and all checklist items to ensure readiness for closing.
  • Serve as a liaison between lenders, title companies, borrowers, and settlement agents, maintaining clear and timely communication to ensure expectations and deadlines are met.
  • Collaborate with internal teams, including disbursement and post-closing, to ensure a seamless transition from closing through funding and recording.
  • Support post-closing activities, including revisions to CDs or ALTA statements and overall file completion.
  • Manage an active pipeline of files, prioritizing tasks to meet deadlines and established service level agreements.
  • Provide operational support across all workflow stages, including back-office functions, and assist with coverage needs such as on-call, alternate shifts, and weekend support as required.
  • Perform additional duties as assigned.

Competencies:

  • Capacity to work under pressure and tight deadlines.
  • Capable of generating a high degree of respect and trust to develop, maintain strong relationships with business partners across all levels of stakeholders.
  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to clearly and concisely present issues, ideas and recommendations in verbal, written and presentation formats.
  • Highly motivated, inquisitive, self-started with the ability to multi-task and effectively manage priorities to meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong attention to detail and excellent organizational skills

Education, Formal Training, and Experience:

  • High school diploma or GED required, Baccalaureate degree preferred.
  • 2+ years’ experience with title or closing company preferred.
  • Strong customer service skills required.
  • National title closing experience preferable.

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to talk or hear, is frequently required to sit, is occasionally required to stand; walk; use hands and fingers to type & reach with hands and arms. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, depth perception, and ability to adjust focus.

Candidate must have in-depth travel industry knowledge, exceptional problem-solving skills, while maintaining the highest degree of professionalism and courtesy.

This role will have you arranging domestic and complex international travel for busy executives including air, car hotel and ground transportation. Before you begin your role, you will spend four weeks training (paid). This program will boost your knowledge, train you on contract airfares and sharpen your Sabre skills. Our corporate travel agents handle the air, car, rail and ground transportation bookings as well as the ticketing, changes and the exchange and queue management.  You will also need to offer exceptional customer service to satisfy our business traveler’s needs.

The schedule for this role will include a 40-hour work week with five 8-hour shifts from 6:00 AM to 3:00 PM ET, Monday – Friday.

You'll field the hard product, architecture and integration questions in the room, then work with our delivery team so what gets sold is scoped to land. It's a hands-on role for someone who would rather configure the product than talk about it, with occasional travel for customer meetings, demos and team events.

Salesforce clients want to see Agentforce and Data Cloud working against their own use cases before they commit. As a Salesforce Summit Partner growing on private equity backing, BPX gives you the platform breadth and the customer conversations to show them, across Sales, Service, Data and Experience Cloud.

jobs.excerpt: Learn to Evaluate Freight, Not Just Find ItWe are hiring Entry-Level Freight Dispatchers to support U.
jobs.description:
Learn to Evaluate Freight, Not Just Find It

We are hiring Entry-Level Freight Dispatchers to support U.S. transportation operations with a focus on freight evaluation, load selection, mileage calculations, and operational planning.

This position is entry-level specifically in professional freight dispatching. Previous employment as a freight dispatcher is not required. Applicants must, however, have relevant exposure to U.S. trucking or transportation operations and a working understanding of freight load boards.

The right candidate should understand that a load cannot be evaluated by rate alone. Deadhead, loaded miles, equipment, appointments, driver availability, Hours of Service, and operating requirements all affect whether freight makes sense for a truck.

What You'll Evaluate

  • Search DAT One, Truckstop, or comparable freight load boards.
  • Compare available freight by lane, equipment type, mileage, rate, and appointment requirements.
  • Calculate loaded miles, deadhead miles, total trip miles, and rate per mile.
  • Identify excessive deadhead and inefficient freight options.
  • Review pickup and delivery schedules for operational feasibility.
  • Consider available driver Hours of Service when evaluating loads.
  • Determine whether available equipment is appropriate for the freight.
  • Identify potential delays, accessorial considerations, and unusual load requirements.
  • Organize suitable freight options for authorized review and booking.

Understanding Freight Economics

Freight evaluation requires looking beyond the advertised load rate.

You will be expected to understand how factors such as:

  • Loaded mileage
  • Deadhead mileage
  • Rate per mile
  • Equipment type
  • Pickup and delivery appointments
  • Driver Hours of Service
  • Freight lanes
  • Driver location and availability
  • Potential detention or other accessorial situations

affect the operational value of a load.

Applicants should be comfortable working with mileage calculations, spreadsheets, freight information, and basic trip economics.

Relevant Transportation Background

Prior professional freight-dispatch employment is not required.

Relevant experience or knowledge may come from:

  • CDL-A truck driving
  • Owner-operator or fleet operations
  • Transportation coordination
  • Truck-driver recruiting with practical trucking knowledge
  • Freight brokerage support
  • Carrier operations
  • Load planning
  • Logistics or transportation operations

Applicants must have enough U.S. trucking knowledge to understand basic freight terminology, equipment, mileage, lanes, and load-board information.

Essential Qualifications

  • Working knowledge of U.S. trucking and transportation operations.
  • Familiarity with freight load boards such as DAT One, Truckstop, or comparable systems.
  • Understanding of common equipment types including Dry Van, Reefer, Flatbed, and Step Deck.
  • Ability to calculate loaded miles, deadhead miles, total miles, and rate per mile.
  • Basic understanding of U.S. freight lanes.
  • Working understanding of driver Hours-of-Service considerations.
  • Strong spoken and written English communication skills.
  • Ability to communicate professionally with drivers, brokers, carriers, and transportation personnel.
  • Strong attention to detail and accurate recordkeeping.
  • Computer proficiency and reliable internet access.
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment.

Additional Responsibilities

  • Verify freight information before presenting loads for review.
  • Communicate load information accurately to drivers and authorized operations personnel.
  • Assist with pickup and delivery scheduling.
  • Review rate confirmations and load information for consistency with agreed terms.
  • Monitor active shipments and document operational changes.
  • Maintain accurate load and dispatch records.
  • Escalate broker-verification, safety, compliance, service, or documentation concerns.
  • Maintain professional and timely communication throughout assigned operations.

Work Arrangement

This is a full-time remote position supporting U.S. transportation operations.

The position requires availability during assigned U.S. trucking operating hours. Specific working days and schedules will be provided as part of the hiring process.

Applicants must have a reliable computer, stable high-speed internet connection, dependable communication capability, and a professional remote-work environment.

Company Overview

Job Summary and Responsibilities

SUMMARY

Circet USA is a premier technology infrastructure design, build, and maintain partner. The Director, Project Management Office (PMO) will build and lead the Data Center Services PMO and Primavera P6 scheduling department. This hands-on leader establishes the project delivery framework, project controls, scheduling standards, governance, tools, reporting, and talent needed to support rapid growth and consistent execution across the project portfolio.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES include the following; other duties may be assigned:

  • Define the PMO charter, operating model, roles, decision rights, governance cadence, and project delivery framework from preconstruction handoff through closeout and customer turnover.
  • Establish common standards and templates for project kickoffs, stage gates, risk and issue logs, change management, lessons learned, closeout, and customer reporting.
  • Select and implement the PMO tools and reporting stack in partnership with IT, Finance, Operations, Sales, and Estimating.
  • Build and lead the Primavera P6 scheduling department, including its mission, organization, staffing plan, hiring, training, career paths, and operating standards.
  • Serve as the business unit authority for P6 enterprise structure, coding, calendars, permissions, templates, baselines, resource loading, and update protocols.
  • Develop repeatable schedule templates for data center scopes, including structured cabling, phased data hall turnover, and commissioning support.
  • Require sound critical path method schedules and lead schedule-quality reviews using recognized criteria such as the DCMA 14-point assessment.
  • Oversee look-ahead schedules, recovery plans, delay analyses, and time impact analyses supporting change orders and claims.
  • Align Circet schedules with owner, customer, and general contractor master schedules and reporting requirements.
  • Provide leadership with an integrated view of portfolio health across schedule, cost, margin, safety, quality, staffing, change, and risk.
  • Partner with Finance on forecasting, estimates at completion, change-order tracking, work-in-progress reviews, and margin performance.
  • Lead monthly portfolio reviews, identify at-risk projects early, and present data-supported recovery recommendations to the SVP.
  • Define and maintain key performance indicators for project delivery, PMO effectiveness, schedule quality, and portfolio performance.
  • Forecast labor and resource demand across backlog and pipeline, identify capacity constraints, and connect training capacity to project demand.
  • Support Sales and Estimating with schedule development, delivery plans, and customer-facing project-controls content.
  • Recruit, coach, and develop PMO and scheduling professionals; train project managers, superintendents, and field leaders on standards and tools.
  • Build a culture of accurate reporting, early escalation, accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
  • Provide oversight and coaching to Project Managers for change management and change order execution on their assigned project/s.
  • Provide oversight and coaching to Project Managers as applies to project budget management, job cost control, and earned value management on their assigned project/s.

Qualifications

QUALIFICATION REQUIREMENTS

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and ability required.

  • Bachelor's degree in construction management, engineering, business, or a related field; equivalent relevant experience may be substituted.
  • 10+ years of project delivery, project controls, or scheduling experience in data center, mission-critical, telecommunications, or complex infrastructure construction.
  • 5+ years leading a PMO, project controls group, scheduling team, or leading large-scale delivery.
  • Demonstrated success building or substantially rebuilding a PMO or scheduling function in a rapid-growth environment.
  • Advanced working knowledge of Primavera P6, critical path method scheduling, schedule logic, baselines, resource loading, and schedule-quality review.
  • Experience with recovery schedules, delay analysis, time impact analysis, and change orders tied to schedule impacts.
  • Working knowledge of contractor financials, including forecasting, estimates at completion, margin, and work in progress.
  • Experience reporting to executives and working directly with owners, customers, and general contractors.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Direct experience supporting hyperscale or colocation data center delivery.
  • Familiarity with structured cabling, methods of procedure (MOPs), commissioning levels, TIA-942, and BICSI standards.
  • PMP, PMI-SP, AACE PSP, or AACE CCP certification.
  • Experience with Power BI or a similar reporting platform and construction management software such as Procore.
  • Experience in a private equity-backed or similarly high-growth services business.
  • Experience with field-services workforces and labor-capacity planning.

COMPETENCIES

  • Strategic Leadership and PMO Development
  • Primavera P6 and Project Scheduling
  • Project Controls and Portfolio Governance
  • Financial Acumen and Performance Reporting
  • Risk, Change, and Claims Management
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration and Influence
  • Executive and Customer Communication
  • Talent Development and Change Adoption

SUCCESS MEASURES

  • Within 30 days: current projects, tools, and reporting gaps assessed; PMO charter and hiring plan approved.
  • Within 90 days: P6 environment and standards defined; initial schedulers hired or assigned; monthly portfolio review operating; highest-risk projects on P6 schedules.
  • Within 6 months: all new projects launched using standard templates and stage gates; portfolio dashboard live; schedule-quality reviews established.
  • Within 12 months: all active projects baselined in P6; PMO and scheduling teams staffed to plan; labor forecasts informing capacity decisions; function prepared to support continued growth.

LANGUAGE SKILLS

Ability to read, analyze, and interpret complex business, construction, contractual, and technical documents; ability to respond effectively to sensitive inquiries and communicate clearly with executives, customers, general contractors, and field teams.

MATHEMATICAL SKILLS

Ability to calculate and interpret percentages, rates, variances, productivity, forecast-to-complete values, margins, schedule performance, earned-value indicators, and other project and financial measures; ability to apply basic algebra and quantitative reasoning.

REASONING ABILITY

Ability to define problems, collect and validate data, establish facts, evaluate alternatives, identify cause and effect, and draw sound conclusions in situations involving multiple variables, competing priorities, and incomplete information.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to perform the essential functions of this position. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. While performing the duties of this position, the employee is regularly required to sit; use hands to handle objects, tools, or controls; talk; and hear. The employee is frequently required to stand, walk, and reach with hands and arms. The employee must frequently lift and/or move up to 10 pounds. Specific vision abilities include close vision.

WORK ENVIRONMENT

This role combines office or remote work with regular travel to active project sites and customer locations. Site visits may require personal protective equipment and compliance with site safety, security, and access requirements. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

TRAVEL

Anticipated travel is up to 30% based on business need, including project-site visits and customer-facing engagements.

JOB SUMMARY

The Lead Systems Engineer provides leadership, expertise, and delegates work for design document deliverables for building automation system (BAS), electrical power monitoring system (EPMS), and software integration design projects in hyperscale data center and similar mission critical / technology sectors.

The Lead Systems Engineer will work with internal and external MEP/FP trade engineers, equipment representatives, product vendors, and BIM / Revit / AutoCAD production resources.

The Lead Systems Engineer will be self-directed on day-to-day work and receive high level instruction on new projects, tasks or assignments. Will execute and lead teams and projects, tasks or assignments of complex scope. This role also will coordinate activities of other personnel and serve as a people manager.

This person will communicate and operate in line with organizational goals / values, and departmental objectives.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS

Develop and Execute Building Automation Systems Engineering Solutions (55%)

  • Serve as client program lead, project trade lead, and SME for the BAS and EPMS scope for one or more projects and / or programs.

  • Create and review sequence of operations
  • Create and review system diagrams and point / alarm lists
  • Work closely with client IT departments for network design, interface details, and security requirements
  • Provide direction on engineering production aspects with internal and external Revit / BIM resources

Construction Related Process, Deliverables and Submissions (15%)

  • Accountable for design document deliverables for design phases including Schematic Design (SD), Design Development (DD), Issue For Permit (IFP), Issue For Construction (IFC)
  • Lead planning and execution of Construction Administration (CA) phase activities remote and on site
  • Lead building automation focused design reviews and page turns
  • ​Participate in internal and external quality control and peer reviews
  • Lead internal and external project meeting discussions on engineering scope

Reporting and Communication (15%)

  • Manage project communication and reporting
  • Prepare project progress reports for internal and external stakeholders
  • Manage personal hours using company tools

People Manager (15%)

  • Implement and monitor team objectives to meet set goals.
  • Manage and execute departmental or organizational projects, ensuring alignment with departmental focus.

  • Adapt resource allocation in response to project demands and departmental needs.
  • Cultivate a team environment that encourages cooperation and collective problem-solving.
  • Assist with team and departmental hiring and recruiting processes.

Technology, Digital Tools & AI-Enabled Efficiency

  • Leverage AI-enabled and digital tools to enhance efficiency, reduce manual effort, and support consistent, high-quality work output.
  • Identify opportunities to improve processes and demonstrate a continuous learning mindset, seeking out new technologies, skills, and methods that elevate individual and team performance.
  • Adapt to emerging technologies and evolving digital workflows, actively supporting the integration and adoption of innovative tools across the organization.

Completion of Assigned Tasks and Deliverables on Time and on Budget

Performs Other Related Duties as Assigned

POSITION REQUIREMENTS (ADVANCED LEVEL FOR ALL THE FOLLOWING)

  • Skilled in navigating clients through BAS project designs including identification of standards, needs, and option evaluation
  • Skilled in completing assignments accurately and with attention to detail
  • Skilled at using MS Office Suite (Excel, Word, Outlook, PowerPoint, Teams), along with exceptional organizational skills for file management
  • Skilled in designing BAS and EPMS packages
  • Knowledge of construction design process, stakeholders, deliverables
  • Knowledge of code requirements and energy guidelines related to BAS designs
  • Knowledge of data center HVAC applications and BAS control strategies including chilled water plants
  • Knowledge of IoT and smart building solutions
  • Knowledge of Networking including Addressing, VLANs, LANs, Switches and Routers
  • Knowledge of open-source protocols (BACnet, Modbus and SNMP)
  • Knowledge of DDC systems used in building automation designs
  • Knowledge of PLC systems used in building automation designs
  • Organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously

  • Ability to communicate effectively directly with clients and at times serve as primary point of client contact
  • Ability to work successfully as a member of a team and independently with moderate supervision
  • Ability to work under pressure and meet close deadlines

OR

PLUS

jobs.title: Principal Forward Deployed Engineer, Operational AI
jobs.excerpt: Aerospike is the real-time database for mission-critical use cases and workloads, including machine learning, generative, and agentic AI.
jobs.description:
Aerospike is the real-time database for mission-critical use cases and workloads, including machine learning, generative, and agentic AI. Aerospike powers millions of transactions per second with millisecond latency, at a fraction of the total cost of ownership compared to other databases.

Global leaders, including Adobe, Airtel, Barclays, Criteo, DBS Bank, Experian, Grab, HDFC Bank, PayPal, Sony Interactive Entertainment, The Trade Desk, and Wayfair, rely on Aerospike for customer 360, fraud detection, real-time bidding, profile stores, recommendation engines, and other use cases.

At Aerospike, we dream big and deliver even bigger. Our mission is to unleash the power of the world’s real-time data with a database built for infinite scale, speed, and sustainability.

If you're ready to shape the future of data, join us.

The Opportunity

As AI transitions from analysis into real-world autonomous action, enterprises require more than intelligent models—they need an ultra-low-latency operational fabric that connects agent swarms and workflows directly to live reality. That requires authoritative state, unified context, and enterprise-grade policy controls.

As a Principal Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) at Aerospike, you will serve as the hands-on technical authority partnering with lead architects and engineering teams across Global 2000 enterprises. You will own the technical architecture and end-to-end implementation of mission-critical systems: discovering deep architectural challenges, writing core production code, validating high-throughput workloads, and driving post-production operational resilience.

This is a premier individual contributor (IC) role. You will bridge customer production deployments with Aerospike’s core product and platform engineering teams, translating novel distributed systems challenges into reusable platform patterns, hardened reference architectures, and foundational product features.

What You’ll Build

  • Authoritative State Engines: Architect and implement real-time distributed foundations for session, entity, workflow, and multi-agent state. Support massive concurrent reads/writes under stringent SLA guarantees for data freshness, consistency, and sub-millisecond recovery.
  • Context Assembly Pipelines: Design systems that merge enterprise records, streaming state, low-latency vector search, and graph topologies to provide grounded, permission-aware context for autonomous decisions.
  • Execution Guardrails & Policy Enforcement: Embed deterministic boundaries, authorization checks, rate/execution governors, and human-in-the-loop triggers directly into distributed data and execution paths.
  • Auditable Governance & Traceability: Build immutable telemetry and lineage pipelines that capture runtime context, decisions, downstream side-effects, and state mutations to meet enterprise security and compliance standards.
  • The Continuous Operating Loop: Build and tune closed-loop distributed systems: State → Context → Inference → Action → Consequence → State Mutation, ensuring deterministic execution at scale.

What You’ll Do

  • Drive System Architecture: Embed with enterprise staff/principal engineers and platform owners to break ambiguous, high-scale operational requirements into concrete systems designs, data schemas, and verifiable milestones.
  • Write Production Code: Write, optimize, and review high-performance code across Aerospike, distributed data backends, vector search runtimes, and agentic execution frameworks.
  • Own Technical Outcomes: Drive full-lifecycle validation in client staging and production environments. Troubleshoot concurrency bottlenecks, memory leaks, cluster failovers, and serialization overhead under extreme workloads.
  • Rigorous Systems Benchmarking: Design and execute performance profiles testing tail latency (p99p99p99/p99.9p99.9p99.9), throughput limits, cross-region replication lag, vector recall, and fallback reliability under active network partitions.
  • Influence Platform Roadmap: Function as the primary bridge back to internal core engineering. Extract reusable components, build field libraries and toolchains, and author standard-setting reference architectures.
  • Technical Thought Leadership: Serve as a domain expert on real-time operational AI. Present architectural trade-offs to senior client leadership, write definitive implementation guides, and mentor partner engineering teams.

How You’ll Lead (Staff/Principal IC Track)

  • Architectural Anchor: Act as the technical North Star for forward deployed engineering, setting standards for code quality, design documentation, and production readiness across high-value client projects.
  • Force Multiplier: Elevate senior and staff engineers across the team through design reviews, pair programming on complex distributed debugging sessions, and targeted technical mentorship.
  • Cross-Organizational Impact: Partner seamlessly with Product, Core Database Engineering, Professional Services, and Solutions Architecture to resolve architectural misalignments and accelerate deployment velocity.
  • Domain Advocacy: Distill real-world distributed agent failure modes into technical white papers, internal technical deep dives, and open-source tooling.

Operating Model with Client & Field Teams

Principal FDEs own the architecture, direct systems implementation, and end-to-end technical integrity of Operational AI deployments.

  • Professional Services leads standard installations, migrations, cluster sizing, and infrastructure operations.
  • Solutions Architecture & TAMs maintain long-term account governance, commercial alignment, and operational advisory.
  • Your Focus: You remain unburdened by routine implementation, maintenance tickets, or account management. Your remit is solving the hardest distributed computing and operational AI problems, deploying working code, and hardening our software for enterprise-scale adoption.

What You’ll Bring

  • 10+ years of software engineering experience building and scaling high-performance distributed systems, database internals, or large-scale data infrastructure in production.
  • Deep Systems Programming: Proven expertise in Go, C/C++, Java, or Rust, with an understanding of memory management, lock-free data structures, networking protocols, cache hierarchies, and concurrent systems programming.
  • Real-Time Data & Systems Design: Track record of designing systems with strict SLA targets (sub-10ms tail latency, high-throughput streaming, and robust consistency models).
  • Applied AI & Agentic Infrastructure: Hands-on experience building low-latency context retrieval platforms, vector index optimizations, stateful agent runtimes, or deterministic workflow orchestration engines.
  • Distributed Governance & Security: Practical knowledge of building zero-trust data access layers, cryptographic auditing, data isolation models, and distributed rate-limiting.
  • Client-Facing Technical Leadership: Demonstrated poise and clarity when working with customer engineering leaders, with the ability to cut through ambiguity and make high-judgment technical tradeoffs on the fly.
  • Independence & Execution Bias: Self-directed operator capable of taking an abstract concept from whitepaper or sketch through to battle-tested production software.

Helpful Experience

  • Hands-on experience with the Aerospike Real-time Data Platform, Aerospike Vector Search (AVS), or Aerospike Graph.
  • Experience with distributed coordination primitives (Raft, Paxos), durable event-driven systems (Kafka, Flink), or durable execution frameworks (Temporal).
  • Familiarity with Linux kernel tuning, eBPF, zero-copy networking, or bare-metal performance optimization.
  • Production experience with Kubernetes, hybrid-cloud networking, and Terraform.

Compensation and Impact

  • Evaluation Metric: Success is driven by production deployments, platform adoption, reduction of architectural debt, and high-impact software assets—never billable hours or utilization percentages.
  • Comprehensive Benefits (USA): Competitive base salary, significant equity participation, 401(k) matching, comprehensive medical/dental/vision coverage, and flexible remote work allowances.

Aerospike is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to an environment free from discrimination based on race, religion, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, disability, or veteran status.

Your future team

Qualifications

Deadlines are real; overtime isn’t a lifestyle. We staff sensibly, treat extra hours as the rare exception, and back that up with true schedule autonomy and remote flexibility—so your evenings stay yours.

jobs.description:
The International Rescue Committee (IRC) responds to the world's worst humanitarian crises, helping to restore health, safety, education, economic wellbeing, and power to people devastated by conflict and disaster. Founded in 1933 at the call of Albert Einstein, the IRC is one of the world's largest international humanitarian non-governmental organizations (INGO), at work in more than 40 countries and 29 U.S. cities helping people to survive, reclaim control of their future and strengthen their communities. A force for humanity, IRC employees deliver lasting impact by restoring safety, dignity and hope to millions. If you're a solutions-driven, passionate change-maker, come join us in positively impacting the lives of millions of people world-wide for a better future.

DEPARTMENT: U.S. Resettlement, Asylum, and Integration (RAI)

TEAM: Virtual Services

LOCATION: Fully virtual

RECRUITMENT WINDOW: Fall

START DATE: October 15, 2026

DURATION: At minimum through March 31, 2027 but can be extended further

SUPERVISED BY: Virtual Matching Grant & Virtual Program of Initial Resettlement Coordinator


The International Rescue Committee (IRC) helps people affected by humanitarian crises survive, recover, and rebuild their lives. In the United States, the IRC supports refugees, asylees, and other immigrants through resettlement, employment, workforce development, and integration services delivered across its network of offices. This fully remote internship sits specifically on the Virtual Services team at IRC headquarters.


Matching Grant (MG) is a federally funded economic self-sufficiency program that helps refugees, asylees, and humanitarian parolees achieve self-sufficiency through employment. The Virtual Program of Initial Resettlement (VPIR) supports newly arrived clients with core resettlement services during their first months in the United States. This internship will provide structured learning about Matching Grant's employment services — including job search assistance, employer outreach, and career counseling — while also offering exposure to VPIR service delivery.


SCOPE OF SERVICE:

Under the supervision of the VMG/VPIR Coordinator, the intern will learn about and participate in guided activities related to the Coordinator's employment services and resettlement caseload. The intern will receive mentorship and guidance from experienced professionals and participate in activities designed for educational development. The intern's activities are designed for educational benefit and are not intended to replace or supplement the work of the Coordinator. The Coordinator will provide regular feedback, coaching, and evaluation based on the intern's learning progress, not productivity.


EDUCATIONAL BENEFIT:

The Virtual Services Intern will gain insight into how employment services and initial resettlement support are delivered to a virtual caseload, how job readiness training is structured, and how employment placement contributes to refugees' economic self-sufficiency. The internship is designed to build the intern's knowledge and professional skills in this field.


LEARNING OBJECTIVES:

  • The intern will gain exposure to and guided practice in employment services, including job search support, employer engagement, and career counseling.
  • The intern will deepen understanding of the Matching Grant program and refugee economic self-sufficiency.
  • The intern will gain exposure to the refugee resettlement process and the public benefits system.
  • The intern will develop skills in case management databases, digital communication tools, and program data reporting.

SUPERVISED LEARNING ACTIVITIES INCLUDE:

  • Observe and participate in guided client job search activities led by the VMG/VPIR Coordinator, including learning how job openings are identified, how resumes and applications are prepared, and how interview skills are practiced.
  • Observe employer outreach efforts led by the Coordinator and participate in guided exercises on identifying job leads and documenting employer partnerships.
  • Observe basic career counseling and coaching provided by the Coordinator, and practice under supervision how to help clients identify employment goals and next steps.
  • Participate in guided learning on pre-arrival and early resettlement tasks under the Virtual Program of Initial Resettlement, including supervised research on housing and community resources.
  • Observe one-on-one job readiness training sessions facilitated by the Coordinator, covering topics such as resume-building, interview preparation, and workplace expectations.
  • Participate in supervised exercises creating community asset maps with clients to learn how to identify local employment, education, and support resources.
  • Learn to document client interactions in case management databases through guided practice, with the Coordinator reviewing entries and providing feedback.
  • Participate in guided learning on data management, including data entry, data cleaning, and program reporting, with feedback from the Coordinator.
  • This internship is intended to complement academic coursework and may qualify for academic credit, depending on university requirements.

TRAINING ACTIVITIES:

  • Observation
  • Participation in team meetings
  • Guided assignments
  • Supervised practice

DESIRED SKILLS AND ABILITIES:

  • Bachelor's degree required; current graduate coursework toward a master's degree preferred.
  • Interest in and/or experience with job search assistance, employer outreach, or career counseling.
  • Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to build relationships with clients, colleagues, and external partners.
  • Excellent written and oral communication skills.
  • Self-motivated, with strong organizational skills and the ability to engage in self-directed learning in a remote setting.
  • High attention to detail and accuracy.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Outlook) and comfort with digital tools for outreach, data entry, and communication.

TIME COMMITMENT:

  • This internship is fully virtual; the intern must use their own laptop/equipment.
  • Intern must have a private workspace where they can effectively participate in learning activities during regularly scheduled hours.
  • Minimum of 15 hours per week of availability; hours must fall within business hours (9am–5pm), Monday–Friday, in any U.S. time zone.
  • Onboarding and ongoing trainings are required to align with the IRC Way & organizational policies to safeguard our clients and programs.
  • Participate reliably and consistently in scheduled learning sessions and team meetings.

ELIGIBILITY & ONBOARDING REQUIREMENTS:

  • Interns must be located in the U.S. during the duration of the internship.
  • All positions are contingent upon clearing an IRC background check through HireRight before service.
  • Review and sign IRC intern policy documents and commitment paperwork.
  • IRC onboarding and training:
    • IRC Way, Every Day
    • RAI Safety and Security
    • Fundamentals of Safeguarding
    • Information Security Awareness Training
    • Additional quarterly organizational trainings
  • Program-specific training:
    • Virtual Services Team Orientation
    • Introduction to Matching Grant & VPIR Programs
    • Role-specific training

Interested applicants should apply online including a resume and cover letter outlining their interest in the position and relevant skills. Applications will be reviewed, and, if selected, candidates will be contacted for an interview.


This internship is structured for educational benefit and professional development. It does not constitute an employment relationship or guarantee future employment.

Professional Standards: All International Rescue Committee workers must adhere to the core values and principles outlined in IRC Way - Standards for Professional Conduct. Our Standards are Integrity, Service, Equality and Accountability. In accordance with these values, the IRC operates and enforces policies on Safeguarding, Conflicts of Interest, Fiscal Integrity, and Reporting Wrongdoing and Protection from Retaliation. IRC is committed to take all necessary preventive measures and create an environment where people feel safe, and to take all necessary actions and corrective measures when harm occurs. IRC builds teams of professionals who promote critical reflection, power sharing, debate, and objectivity to deliver the best possible services to our clients.

Expand your expertise through enterprise reporting and automation technologies, including Amazon Connect Reporting, Amazon QuickSight, AWS-hosted data environments, SQL databases, and business intelligence tools.

New Skills

jobs.title: Senior Program Manager, Maximum Impact Incubator
jobs.excerpt: OverviewThe Clinton Health Access Initiative, Inc.
jobs.description:
Overview

The Clinton Health Access Initiative, Inc. (CHAI) is a global health organization committed to our mission of saving lives and reducing the burden of disease in low-and middle-income countries. We work at the invitation of governments to support them and the private sector to create and sustain high-quality health systems.

CHAI was founded in 2002 in response to the HIV/AIDS epidemic with the goal of dramatically reducing the price of life-saving drugs and increasing access to these medicines in the countries with the highest burden of the disease. Over the following two decades, CHAI has expanded its focus. Today, along with HIV, we work with our partners to prevent and treat infectious diseases such as COVID-19, malaria, tuberculosis, and hepatitis. Our work has also expanded into cancer, diabetes, hypertension, and other non-communicable diseases, and we work to accelerate the rollout of lifesaving vaccines, reduce maternal and child mortality, combat chronic malnutrition, and increase access to assistive technology. We are investing in horizontal approaches to strengthen health systems through programs in human resources for health, digital health, and health financing. With each new and innovative program, our strategy is grounded in maximizing sustainable impact at scale, ensuring that governments lead the solutions, that programs are designed to scale nationally, and learnings are shared globally.

At CHAI, our people are our greatest asset, and none of this work would be possible without their talent, time, dedication, and passion for our mission and values. We are a highly diverse team of enthusiastic individuals across 40 countries with a broad range of skill sets and life experiences. CHAI is deeply grounded in the countries we work in, with the majority of our staff based in program countries. Learn more about our exciting work:

CHAI is an Equal Opportunity Employer, and is committed to providing an environment of fairness, and mutual respect where all applicants have access to equal employment opportunities. CHAI values diversity and inclusion, and recognizes that our mission is best advanced by the leadership and contributions of people with diverse experience, backgrounds, and culture.

Position Overview

The Maximum Impact Incubator (MII) aims to utilize econometrics and epidemiology to incubate programs across CHAI's entire portfolio that generate significant health impact through highly cost-effective programming. The Maximum Impact Incubator team has the exciting and challenging aim of working with CHAI’s country and program teams to develop the most cost-effective and scalable opportunities for new programs aligned with the Effective Altruism (EA) philosophy of maximizing the benefit of available resources.

As a Senior Program Manager on the MII team, you will play a key role in ensuring the programs graduated from the incubator run smoothly and deliver on agreed implementation, research, and learning objectives, including supporting program launch, implementation, coordination, and donor management. After the MII team completes its investigation of new programs, which includes assessing a program’s cost-effectiveness, potential research objectives and learning objectives, and programs receive grant funding from EA-aligned donors, these programs “graduate” from the incubator. During the implementation phase, graduated grants are owned and implemented by the relevant CHAI program and country team (e.g., a program delivering Zinc/ORS to treat childhood diarrhoea in Nigeria would be owned by CHAI’s Child Health and Nigeria teams during implementation); the incubator’s role is to manage the donor relationship and to serve as the institutional memory of the original vision that was agreed between the donor, MII and the program and country teams during the MII-led investigation.

The Senior Program Manager will be the steward of that intent: (1) supporting the handover and launch of newly graduating projects to the implementation teams, (2) ensuring implementing teams have a shared understanding of the cost-effectiveness evidence base of the program, delivery expectations and the tools needed to track delivery, (3) providing a critical technical advisory role to teams on the appropriate monitoring processes, study designs and research concepts to address questions in the donor’s monitoring and learning frameworks and to conduct impact evaluations or other evaluation methods required by the donor, and (4) monitoring implementation to ensure it remains aligned with the original concept, and acting as a bridge between implementation reality and grant commitments, flagging early if work plans shift, and keeping the donor accurately and proactively informed.

This role may require ~20% travel internationally and domestically. The Senior Program Manager is expected to have a reasonable ability to travel.

Responsibilities

Preparing and transitioning newly graduated projects (15%)

  • Before a project graduates, confirm that MII, program and country teams and donors are fully aligned on the concept and delivery expectations, and teams are ready to deliver so that any gaps are resolved before implementation
  • Ensure the implementing team has a strong understanding of the back-of-the-envelope calculation (BOTEC) cost-effectiveness model and the evidence behind it
  • Support the transition of newly graduated projects from investigation to implementation, including co-leading internal project kickoff (roles and responsibilities, work plan, budget, and M&E plan)
  • Work with the implementing team ahead of graduation to make sure the BOTEC, budget, and work plan are aligned, and that key risks and government dependencies are identified up front
  • Contribute to developing and testing MII SOPs, tools, and templates for launching and supporting graduated projects, including clear roles and responsibilities between MII, program and country teams
  • Support implementing teams to set up monitoring and evaluation processes as to address donor’s monitoring and learning frameworks and conduct impact evaluations or other evaluation methods required by the donor

Donor management and stewardship of graduated projects (85%)

  • Once projects have graduated, coordinate donor requests and internal workstreams on graduated programs, including but not limited to deliverable reviews, preparations for and follow up from meetings including documenting key decisions and requests from the donor, and contract reviews, serving as a quality check to ensure they are accurate, clear, consistent with one another (e.g., BOTEC, budget, and work plan), faithful to what was agreed, and acting as the primary point of contact between the donor and the implementing teams
  • Set up the systems and serve as the institutional memory for each graduated grant:
    • Maintain a clear record of what the donor funded and why (concept, BOTEC assumptions, key commitments, and decisions made along the way)
    • Bring that context to implementing teams, particularly through staff transitions
  • Convene a regular coordination forum that brings together MII, global program, and country teams
  • Track progress against the workplan, budget, and critical milestones agreed with the donor, compare implementation with the original design and donor expectations, and raise discrepancies, delays, or changes to the agreed design promptly with program leadership so they can be resolved and communicated to the donor in a timely way
  • Track implementation dependencies outside CHAI’s control (e.g., national or global guideline changes, government endorsement of new products, subnational approvals) against check-in milestones, and ensure the donor is proactively updated when key assumptions change
  • Advise on technical aspects of graduated programs, particularly impact evaluations and other research and learning processes, in collaboration with CHAI’s Analytics and Implementation Research (AIR) team

Qualifications

  • Masters or higher degree in economics, public health, epidemiology, nursing, or a related field

  • Architect & Scale Modern Data Infrastructure:Design, optimize, and maintain high-performance cloud data warehouses (BigQuery, Snowflake) and robust ETL/ELT pipelines to unify multi-channel e-commerce, CRM, and operational datasets.

  • Lead Enterprise Reporting & Dashboards:Plan, deliver, and maintain intuitive, scalable BI dashboards and visual models (Tableau, Looker, Power BI) tailored for executive leadership, client-facing teams, and departmental leads.

  • Champion Financial & Operational Data Integrity:Establish and execute rigorous audit protocols to guarantee 100% accuracy in financial reporting, revenue modeling, and commercial KPIs.

  • Translate Data into Commercial Strategy:Partner cross-functionally with Sales, Marketing, Fulfillment, and Client Strategy to extract predictive insights, identify growth levers, and deliver compelling data storytelling.

  • Cultivate BI Team & Best Practices:Provide hands-on mentorship, code reviews, and structured project management for analytics initiatives, fostering a high-velocity, continuous-learning culture.

  • Drive Data Governance & Security:Oversee enterprise data governance, access controls, compliance, and strict confidentiality protocols to safeguard intellectual property and sensitive client data.

Your Qualifications:

  • Education & Experience: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Information Systems, Business Analytics, Finance or a related quantitative field, paired with 5+ years of progressive data analytics/BI experience (including 2+ years leading projects or teams).

  • Ecommerce Experience:Shopify, Klaviyo, Google Analytics, and other similar sales and behavior channels are preferred.

  • Advanced SQL & Data Warehousing Mastery:Fluent, expert-level SQL capability with demonstrated hands-on experience structuring, modeling, and optimizing enterprise data in BigQuery or Snowflake environments.

  • Scripting & API Integration Skills:Proficient in Python or R for data pipeline scripting, automation, statistical modeling, and ingesting data through third-party APIs (e.g., e-commerce, marketing platforms).

  • Data Storytelling & Financial Literacy:Proven ability to synthesize complex quantitative data into clear executive summaries, with strong business acumen and experience auditing financial data and e-commerce metrics.

  • Scrappy & Entrepreneurial Mindset:A self-starter who excels at balancing high-level architectural strategy with roll-up-your-sleeves execution in dynamic, growth-oriented environments.

  • Cross-Functional Communication:Exceptional verbal and written communication skills with a track record of building trusted partnerships across technical and executive non-technical stakeholders alike.

What we offer:

  • Energetic, collaborative work environment in Over-the-Rhine

  • Competitive pay and benefits: health, dental, vision, and life insurance

  • Unlimited PTO

  • 401k with company match

  • Personal and professional development opportunities

  • A fast-paced eCommerce retail environment where you can learn and grow while working with major brands


FYUL is the engine that powers on-demand commerce at global scale.

Formed in 2024 through the merger of Printful, Printify, and Snow Commerce, we bring together tech, talent, and infrastructure to help people turn ideas into beautiful products.

From solo creators to entertainment giants, FYUL powers merch that connects with millions, backed by advanced tech, premium production, and global reach.

We're a fast-growing global company working toward powering great brands, great experiences, and great people.

Snow Commerce is a leading provider of eCommerce strategy, design, and digital marketing, helping some of the world’s most exciting brands succeed online. Our partners include Paramount, Netflix, Bauerfeind, NBCUniversal, Warner Bros., and more. Learn more at .
