  • Own the technical case for major equipment replacement and modification and drive it into asset lifecycle and roadmap planning with Asset Management, shaping vendor selection, obsolescence management, and long-range capital planning.
  • Monitor maritime legislation, Classification Society rules, Flag State requirements, and relevant industry standards; coordinate assessment of fleet impact; and support implementation of required changes, including review of technical documentation and submissions to Classification Societies and Flag States.
  • Develop Technical Services capability through coaching, knowledge transfer, delegation, and succession planning, and advise on the technical capability and development of engineering personnel.
  • Support recruitment and placement activities with specialty consultants for engineering candidates
  • Maintain effective working relationships with vessel leadership, shipyards, contractors, suppliers, Classification Societies, Flag States, and external technical partners, and maintain current knowledge of the company Safety Management System, planned maintenance practices, and applicable technical procedures.
  • Other duties as assigned

Ideal Candidate:

  • Deep knowledge of vessel technical operations, maintenance, repair, dry docking, defect management, and technical support within a maritime environment.
  • Strong working knowledge of ship machinery and systems, with the ability to understand technical interactions across engineering, electrical, deck, hospital, and accommodation disciplines.
  • Strong understanding of maritime regulations, Classification Society rules, Flag State requirements, statutory surveys, and technical compliance processes.
  • Sound engineering judgment with the ability to assess technical risk, evaluate alternatives, and make practical recommendations in safety-critical and operationally constrained environments.
  • Knowledge of planned maintenance systems, maintenance strategy, asset lifecycle principles, obsolescence management, and Management of Change.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including the ability to identify root causes, evaluate technical evidence, and develop effective corrective actions.
  • Ability to interpret and critically evaluate technical drawings, specifications, manuals, engineering documentation, survey requirements, and regulatory information.
  • Strong leadership capability, including developing technical specialists, setting expectations, building capability, and supporting succession within a multidisciplinary team.
  • Strong cross-functional coordination skills with the ability to align technical, operational, regulatory, and commercial stakeholders around complex technical issues.
  • Strong communication, facilitation, and relationship-management skills in an international and multicultural environment.
  • Ability to balance urgent operational requirements with long-term technical reliability, maintenance priorities, and fleet needs.
  • Ability to exercise sound judgment and decision-making with incomplete information, competing priorities, and operational constraints.
  • Willingness and ability to travel internationally, including extended periods onboard vessels and at shipyards.

Education and Experience

At SPD Technology, we bring together a team of like-minded people who are driven by the desire to bring value through their work, united in their commitment to high performance and delivering custom, cutting-edge tech solutions that drive clients’ growth. About the role

PitchBook’s Machine Learning Engineer is responsible for using machine learning, statistical modeling, and natural language processing (NLP) to collect a high-volume of data for the PitchBook Platform and surface insights for the capital markets. This role will also serve as a resource and mentor for junior members of the team. A strong motivation to succeed is critical and everyone has the opportunity to shape the long-term direction of our team.

PitchBook — a platform for investment professionals. Our software provides access to data and the analytical tools to get answers fast and discover promising opportunities. Uncovers actionable insights and trends hidden within the financial data of more than three million companies. Users all over the world include large corporations, start-ups, venture capital and private equity firms, investment banks, and many others. Team

1 EM, 6 ML Engineers

Use PyTorch, Scikit-Learn, and Spacy to build NLP pipelines. Implement vector databases for high-dimensional data embeddings and develop hybrid models to extract insights from diverse data sources.

    • Proficient in Python and machine and deep learning frameworks like TensorFlow, PyTorch, ScikitLearn, Spacy or other.
    • Experienced in natural language processing and modern LLM based techniques.
    • Experience with full ML lifecycle, data preprocessing, training, evaluation stages and monitoring techniques
    • Skilled with SQL and data extraction methods.

Reveal great tech solutions

Join the team of experts who create custom, cutting-edge tech solutions for world-renowned businesses, fueling client growth. Unleash your potential, tackle new challenges, and be part of a team that values your skills and contributions. Benefit from performance and merit reviews, elevate your skills with personal development plans, and individual learnings through the corporate library, public speaking support, and more.

Work with a team of one mind who cares about what they do and how they do. Collaborate with top-notch experts who are always ready to help and support you through any challenges. What success looks like in this role:

Job Title: GRC - Prin Cybersecurity Analyst

Location: Home Based India

Who we are:

Unisys is a global information technology company that builds high-performance, security-centric solutions for the most digitally demanding businesses and governments on Earth. Unisys’ offerings include security software and services; digital transformation and workplace services; industry applications and services; and innovative software operating environments for high-intensity enterprise computing. Unisys builds better outcomes securely for its clients across the Government, Financial Services and Commercial markets. For more information, visit .

Our Vision: Enhancing people’s lives through secure, reliable advanced technology.

Our Core Beliefs:

  • Curiosity: We embrace the unknown and continuous learning.
  • Creativity: We look past routine ways of doing things.
  • Client-Centricity: Our clients’ success is our success.
  • Integrity: We act ethically and honestly.

Position Summary:

Unisys is looking for a candidate who will be responsible for managing the internal security audit program including planning, scheduling and conducting the audit across the organisation. The candidate will be required to provide regular updates regarding the status of the audits to senior management, highlight challenges and actions being taken to address them.

This role will also be responsible for maintaining the cloud compliance program. This includes working with various internal teams to ensure compliance to Unisys cloud security policies and supporting the continuous improvement of the cloud compliance.

This role involves communication with management stakeholders and various GIS, CIT and Business Unit teams.

Working relationship with Internal and External Teams

  • Work with GIS and CIT teams – Infrastructure, Applications, Security Architecture, GIS Leadership team, Security Operations team,
  • Work with BISO’s of the four Business units
  • External – Certifying agencies, vendors, client auditors, client account teams

Key Responsibilities:

Manage Security Audits – 70%

  • Manage internal security audit programs based on requirements from International Standards such as ISO, NIST, PCI, SSAE 18 etc.
  • Prepare, review and maintain annual audit calendar, audit plans, audit management documentation & audit lifecycle
  • Schedule and plan audits, perform audit work, including plan preparation, field notes, document findings, and confirm completion of associated remediation actions.
  • Perform Audits based on criteria defined in ISO 27001, ISO 9001, ISO 22301, ISO 20000, NIST, SSAE18 SOC1/SOC2, SOX, PCI-DSS, etc.
  • Perform audits on various internal processes not limited to HR, facilities, endpoint services, and various business processes based on ISO standards
  • Perform Technical audits for various domains of Security – Few examples include Vulnerability and Patch management, Identity and Access Management, Application Development, DevSecOps, Crisis Management and BC/DR.
  • Work with GIS teams to identify scope of infrastructure and applications services to be covered by technical audits.
  • Plan, schedule, and conduct technical audits.
  • Prepare status reports and review with stakeholders on a regular basis

Cloud Compliance – 20%

  • Establish and maintain Cloud Compliance program to determine compliance to Unisys Cloud Security policies and industry frameworks like CIS Benchmarks, NIST etc.
  • Work with GIS Cloud security teams to define and implement cloud security controls .
  • Conduct regular compliance review and support implementation of remediation actions
  • Review compliance status with GIS and CIT leadership on a regular basis.
  • Drive continuous improvement and leverage automation to improve effectiveness and efficiency of cloud security program.
  • Continuously monitor the external environment for new technology/tools/platform and provide recommendations to enhance the cloud security program.
  • Conduct Cloud User access reviews, track remediation and report results.

Other responsibilities –10%

  • Drive GRC tool selection and implementation efforts for the organisation by having experience working with various GRC tools
  • Comfortable working with various AI tools and support secure AI adoption by supporting AI security efforts
  • Work with AI governance to ensure AI security requirements are covered
  • Support global privacy compliance efforts and ensure privacy is considered within the GIS internal processes

You will be successful in this role if you have:

Knowledge and Qualifications:

  • Bachelors/ Master’s Degree in Engineering in Computer Science.
  • Must have an overall experience of 12-15 years with atleast 5 years technical experience working on infrastructure or application systems.
  • Must have a minimum of 5-8 years relevant experience in internal security audits based on the Industry standards.
  • Must have done technical audits. Should have had and minimum of 2 years experience in Cloud compliance and governance.
  • Must have CISA certification and CCSP or equivalent. CISSP certification would be preferable.
  • Must have working knowledge of ITGC and SSAE18 SOC1/SOC2. Working knowledge of SOX, PCI-DSS, NIST 800=53, CIS Benchmarks would be preferable.
  • Knowledge and experience in AI security and AI security audits
  • Experience working with various GRC tools and GRC automation
  • Must have working knowledge on atleast one CSP – Azure, AWS or GCP. Security-related certifications like AZ 500 would be preferable.
  • Excellent oral, written and presentation skills.
  • Excellent interpersonal and teamwork capabilities.
  • Ability to indirectly manage by influencing larger groups.
  • Ability to work individually but also to collaborate in a virtual team, with vendors and clients.
  • Good change management and project management skills.

Loan Coordinator / Lender Liaison – Mortgage Operations | Remote

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Business Hours
Availability: 30+ Hours per Week

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring an experienced Loan Coordinator / Lender Liaison to manage active loan files and ensure they move efficiently from submission through closing.

You’ll serve as the primary coordination point between lenders, underwriters, and internal teams, maintaining clear visibility across every active loan while ensuring documentation, conditions, follow-ups, approvals, and deadlines remain on track.

This role is ideal for someone with hands-on experience in mortgage operations, loan processing, lender coordination, or real estate financing who understands how to keep deadline-sensitive transactions moving.

If you’re highly organized, proactive with follow-ups, and comfortable managing multiple loan files simultaneously, this role is a strong fit.

What You’ll Own

Lender & Underwriter Communication

  • Serve as the primary point of contact with lending partners
  • Maintain consistent communication throughout the loan lifecycle
  • Follow up on:
    • Outstanding documentation
    • Underwriting conditions
    • Lender requests
    • Pending approvals
  • Communicate loan updates clearly to internal stakeholders
  • Respond promptly to lender and underwriter requests
  • Escalate issues proactively to prevent funding or closing delays
  • Maintain professional relationships with lending partners

Loan Pipeline Management

  • Track active loan files from submission through closing
  • Review loan reports and lender updates daily
  • Maintain accurate visibility into:
    • Current loan status
    • Outstanding conditions
    • Required documentation
    • Upcoming deadlines
    • Next steps
  • Identify bottlenecks before they impact closing timelines
  • Ensure every active loan has clear ownership and follow-up
  • Prioritize files based on deadlines and closing requirements
  • Keep loan statuses accurate and current across internal systems

Internal Team Coordination

  • Coordinate with internal teams to gather required documentation
  • Manage responses to lender and underwriting requests
  • Support timely submission of loan packages and updates
  • Proactively follow up on outstanding internal items
  • Keep stakeholders aligned on deadlines, requirements, and closing timelines
  • Ensure requested documentation reaches lenders promptly
  • Maintain clear ownership of outstanding action items

Documentation & File Management

  • Maintain complete and organized loan files
  • Ensure lender correspondence and documentation are properly recorded
  • Keep CRM and loan management systems accurate and current
  • Verify file completeness before important milestones
  • Maintain clear records throughout the lending process
  • Track documentation requirements and outstanding conditions
  • Ensure critical information can be quickly located when needed

Closing Coordination

  • Closely monitor loans approaching closing
  • Confirm outstanding conditions are addressed on time
  • Coordinate final requirements between lenders and internal stakeholders
  • Maintain visibility into expected closing and funding timelines
  • Follow up on last-mile documentation and approvals
  • Help prevent last-minute delays caused by missing information or communication gaps
  • Escalate potential closing risks early

Process Improvement

  • Identify inefficiencies in loan processing and lender communication
  • Recommend improvements that reduce:
    • Processing delays
    • Communication gaps
    • Missed follow-ups
    • Loan cycle times
  • Help develop standardized workflows for pipeline management and lender coordination
  • Improve visibility and accountability across active loan files

Requirements

  • Proven experience in:
    • Loan Coordination
    • Loan Processing
    • Mortgage Operations
    • Lender Liaison roles
    • Similar lending positions
  • Strong understanding of the U.S. mortgage or lending process
  • Experience managing loan files from submission through closing
  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills
  • Strong organizational and project management skills
  • Ability to manage multiple active loans simultaneously
  • Experience with:
    • CRM systems
    • Google Docs
    • Google Sheets
    • Google Calendar
  • Strong attention to detail and deadline management
  • Ability to proactively manage lender and underwriting follow-ups
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment
  • Reliable internet connection
  • Availability for 30+ hours per week

Nice to Have

  • Experience with:
    • DSCR loans
    • Non-QM loans
    • Investment-property financing
  • Experience supporting real estate investors or investment-property transactions
  • Familiarity with:
    • Encompass
    • LendingPad
    • Jungo
    • Salesforce
    • Other loan management systems
  • Background in real estate acquisitions, dispositions, or operations
  • Previous experience supporting U.S.-based:
    • Mortgage lenders
    • Mortgage brokers
    • Real estate investment firms

Tools & Technology

Encompass | LendingPad | Jungo | Salesforce | CRM Systems | Google Docs | Google Sheets | Google Calendar | Loan Management Systems

What Makes You a Strong Fit

You’ll likely thrive in this role if you:

  • Have successfully managed loans from submission through closing
  • Understand lender and underwriting workflows
  • Proactively follow up rather than waiting for reminders
  • Can manage multiple active files without losing accuracy
  • Stay organized when priorities and deadlines change quickly
  • Communicate confidently with lenders, underwriters, and internal stakeholders
  • Notice missing documentation and potential delays early
  • Take ownership of keeping every loan moving forward
  • Are comfortable escalating risks before they impact closing
  • Maintain accurate records throughout the entire loan lifecycle

What a Typical Day Looks Like

You may start your day by reviewing every active loan to identify new lender updates, outstanding conditions, missing documentation, and approaching deadlines.

Throughout the day, you’ll communicate with lenders and underwriters, follow up on outstanding conditions, coordinate documentation with internal teams, update loan statuses and CRM records, and track upcoming closing milestones.

You’ll also resolve or escalate potential bottlenecks and ensure loans approaching closing have their outstanding requirements completed.

In short: you keep every loan organized, every stakeholder informed, and every deadline moving toward a successful closing.

Key Metrics for Success

  • Loans progressing through the pipeline on schedule
  • Reduced delays caused by missing documentation or follow-ups
  • Accurate and up-to-date loan status tracking
  • Fast turnaround on lender and underwriting requests
  • Zero missed critical loan deadlines
  • Complete and organized loan documentation
  • Consistent stakeholder communication
  • Reduced number of stalled loan files
  • Improved loan cycle times and closing efficiency

Why This Role Stands Out

  • Direct ownership of active loan pipelines
  • High visibility across lending and real estate operations
  • Opportunity to work directly with lenders, underwriters, and internal stakeholders
  • Hands-on exposure to the complete loan lifecycle
  • Opportunity to develop expertise in:
    • Mortgage Operations
    • Investment-Property Lending
    • DSCR / Non-QM Financing
    • Real Estate Operations
  • Fully remote working environment
  • Career growth opportunities into:
    • Senior Loan Coordinator
    • Loan Processor
    • Mortgage Operations Manager
    • Lending Operations Manager

Interview Process

  1. Initial Application
  2. Spark Hire One-Way Video Interview
  3. Recruiter Screening
  4. Client Interview
  5. Offer Stage

Spark Hire Video Interview – Required

As part of the application process, all candidates are required to complete a one-way video interview through Spark Hire.

After completing the first step of your application, you’ll receive a Spark Hire invitation by email with instructions to record and submit your video responses.

Completion of the Spark Hire video is required to be considered for the next stage. Please check your inbox as well as your spam or junk folder for the invitation.

Apply Now

If you have experience in loan processing, mortgage operations, lender coordination, or real estate financing and know how to keep multiple loan files moving from submission through closing, we’d love to hear from you.

Apply today and take ownership of the lender communication, documentation, pipeline tracking, and closing coordination that keeps loans progressing efficiently.

Job titleSenior Foundation Relations ManagerReports toSenior Director, Foundation RelationsFLSA StatusNon-ExemptPosition
Alliance for Justice (AFJ) is a national association of over 140 organizations representing a broad array of groups committed to progressive values and the creation of an equitable, just, and free society. AFJ’s programs comprisefour core pillars:
  • Our Bolder Advocacy program builds progressive power by providing nonprofit advocates with the training, technical assistance, and resources they need to comply with the federal and state laws associated with nonprofit advocacy. Bolder Advocacy is the nation’s leading resource for foundations and nonprofits who want to engage more actively and knowledgeably in the policymaking process.
  • AFJ Law deepens our support of nonprofits’ advocacy, strengthen the progressive movement’s ability to advocate within the bounds of IRS restrictions on tax-exempt organizations, and ensure compliance to keep their organizations safe. AFJ Law goes beyond providing technical assistance to providing legal advice on nonprofit clients’ activities.
  • Our Justice Program works to ensure that our state and federal courts protect our democracy and our core rights and values, preserve human rights, and provide access to justice for all. We research federal judicial nominees, educate the public and elected leaders about them, and advocate for demographically and professionally diverse nominees, who will protect our rights.
  • Our Outreach & Membership team deepens and expands the engagement of AFJ’s core constituencies, including supporting our member organizations with Bolder Advocacy, judicial nominations, and capacity building resources to advance their missions. We also educate and mobilize members, partners, and advocates with the tools and AFJ resources they need to advocate for courts that protect the rights of all us and defend nonprofits’ role in protecting our democracy.

AFJAction promotes a national conversation about the importance of the courts and other key AFJ issues through advocacy, research, and mobilizing progressive advocates and voters. It also serves as the leading expert on the legal framework for 501(c)(4) nonprofit advocacy efforts because we believe it will take all of us to defend our democracy.

Job Description


AFJ's Senior Foundation Relations Manager works closely with Senior Director, Foundation Relations to ensure AFJ meets its grant revenue goals through the timely submission of proposals and reports, a focus on growing and deepening relationships with AFJ's foundations and developing a prospective foundation pipeline. This role isalso responsible for many of the administrative management tasks for AFJ's foundation relationships. This role will report directly to the Senior Director, Foundation Relations.

Duties and ResponsibilitiesGrant Writing:

  • Support Senior Director, Foundation Relations in the completion of LOI, report and proposal deadlines. Build templates of LOI, reports, and proposals for entire foundation relations portfolio; create first drafts for Senior Director, Foundation Relations as directed; provide proofing and formatting for final drafts priorto submission; and submit as requested.
  • Manage a portfolio of funders $75k/per year and below to maximize the relationship with support from theSenior Director, Foundation Relations as needed. Present ideas for relationship building and grant growth.Responsible for management of this portfolio.
  • Along with the Senior Director, Foundation Relations liaise with Finance to receive the required budgets for reports and proposals.
  • Pull data on grant deliverables working with program teams as needed for reports and internal grant check-ins.
  • Research and prepare briefing memos on foundations as requested - prior to meetings and/or to develop pipeline of prospects.
  • Through ClickUp, manage grant deadlines working with the Senior Director, Foundation Relations to map out project plan timelines.

jobs.title: Head of Engineering, Field Verification
jobs.excerpt: Who we areMoniepoint Inc.  is Africa’s all-in-one financial platform, helping 20 million businesses and individuals access seamless payments, banking, credit, cross-border, and business management tools each month.
jobs.description:
Who we are

Moniepoint Inc. is Africa’s all-in-one financial platform, helping 20 million businesses and individuals access seamless payments, banking, credit, cross-border, and business management tools each month.

As Nigeria’s largest merchant acquirer, we power most of the country’s point-of-sale (POS) transactions. Through our subsidiaries, Moniepoint Inc. processes over $250 billion in digital payment transaction value annually.

Why South Africa

South Africa has one of the strongest engineering communities anywhere in the world, and we are deliberately growing our technology organisation in the country. We already have several team members based here. The work is fully remote, and the mission we are working on is a good deal closer to home than it is for our teams elsewhere.

So, now we are looking for our Head of Engineering, Field Verification to join us in South Africa.

About the role

Field Verification is how Moniepoint knows that the people and businesses on our platform are real. Every Moniepoint customer, retail and business, requires a completed field verification as part of KYC. The platform coordinates physical, in-person checks — verifying individuals, business owners, business addresses and loan guarantors — and it serves nearly every part of the company: onboarding, loans, compliance and the fraud team.

The system works today. A back office gives each business unit visibility and control over its own verification requests. A mobile-friendly web app puts the work in the hands of Field Verification Officers and the cluster leads who manage them across local government areas. An API layer lets other business units push verification requests in and receive results back by webhook, and an assignment algorithm routes each request to an officer close enough to carry it out.

We want to be straightforward about the rest. This domain has never had a dedicated engineering leader, and that is the single biggest constraint on it. The team is one lean, cross-functional squad — an Engineering Manager, four engineers and a QA — carrying verification volume for the entire customer base. They have done that impressively well, but running lean means running in keep-the-lights-on mode, and a long list of things that would make this platform substantially better has been waiting for someone to own it.

That list is the role. Trip and route management, so an officer can plan an optimal day across several sites rather than making a separate journey for each one — today we pay for a round trip per verification, and the logistics are nowhere near optimal. Capacity management. A native mobile app, wanted for a long time and never resourced. Liveness and identity verification tooling, exposed as APIs the rest of the business can build on. And as Moniepoint expands into markets where identity verification is as difficult as it is in Nigeria, Kenya among them, a platform that works beyond a single country.

There is a great deal of room to build here. Whoever takes this on will set the direction rather than inherit someone else's plan, on a system that already carries real weight for the business.

As Head of Engineering, Field Verification, your responsibilities will include:

  • Owning the technical strategy, architecture and roadmap for the Field Verification platform end to end, and setting direction for a domain that has been running without dedicated engineering leadership.
  • Moving the platform from keep-the-lights-on operation to deliberate, prioritised development.
  • Leading and growing the existing cross-functional team, and building the organisation out as scope expands.
  • Building the operational efficiency layer — trip and route optimisation, task allocation and capacity management for field officers.
  • Owning the platform's client-facing surface: the APIs and webhooks that other business units integrate with, and the back office those units rely on.
  • Delivering a native mobile experience for field officers.
  • Ensuring verification data is structured, auditable and fit for compliance scrutiny.
  • Building for multi-country expansion as Moniepoint enters new markets.
  • Partnering closely with Product and with the business units that depend on the platform — onboarding, loans, compliance and fraud.
  • Defining architecture standards, engineering processes and quality metrics, and hiring and developing engineers and Engineering Managers.

Who you are

  • You have built things yourself, and grew into leadership from there. We are explicit about this: we are not looking for someone who moved into management early and has led from a distance since. We want an engineer who became a leader.
  • You are capable across disciplines. Backend, web and mobile. This platform spans all three and you will need credibility in each — a specialist in one layer will struggle here.
  • You have built platforms, not just products. Systems used by several distinct groups of users and internal business units, with the flexibility to serve requirements you did not anticipate.
  • You are a problem solver first. We would rather have someone adaptable than someone with the exact domain experience. Having built across different industries — fintech, e-commerce, logistics or otherwise — is a positive signal, not a scattered CV.
  • You have 10+ years of overall software engineering experience, with substantial hands-on production engineering and strong backend depth. Our backend environment is Java and Spring Boot.
  • You have at least 5 years of engineering leadership, including managing Engineering Managers.
  • You collaborate well with product and business stakeholders, and can translate operational requirements into engineering solutions.
  • Experience working with location and geospatial data is a strong plus, including map integrations.
  • Experience with route, trip or delivery optimisation is a strong plus.
  • Experience building for compliance — where data must be structured to evidence what was done and when — is a strong plus.
  • Experience with identity, KYC or verification platforms is a plus. None of these four are requirements.

Cultural Alignment

As well, we assess every candidate across eight dimensions that define how great leaders operate at Moniepoint. We look for evidence of all eight throughout the process, not just in a single conversation.

  • Customer Obsession: Build deep empathy for users. Solve problems intuitively, and fix root causes, not just tickets.
  • Craft: Master the fundamentals. Reason from first principles, make trade-offs explicit, and raise the bar on quality.
  • Systemisation: Turn repeating decisions into scalable mechanisms. Reduce cognitive load and raise engineering quality.

We look for people here who understand first-hand what it means for financial services to be difficult to access, and who want to work on problems at a genuine international scale - changing how banking works across emerging markets.

So, now we are looking for our Head of Engineering, Field Verification to join us in Pakistan.

About the role

Field Verification is how Moniepoint knows that the people and businesses on our platform are real. Every Moniepoint customer, retail and business, requires a completed field verification as part of KYC. The platform coordinates physical, in-person checks — verifying individuals, business owners, business addresses and loan guarantors — and it serves nearly every part of the company: onboarding, loans, compliance and the fraud team.

The system works today. A back office gives each business unit visibility and control over its own verification requests. A mobile-friendly web app puts the work in the hands of Field Verification Officers and the cluster leads who manage them across local government areas. An API layer lets other business units push verification requests in and receive results back by webhook, and an assignment algorithm routes each request to an officer close enough to carry it out.

We want to be straightforward about the rest. This domain has never had a dedicated engineering leader, and that is the single biggest constraint on it. The team is one lean, cross-functional squad — an Engineering Manager, four engineers and a QA — carrying verification volume for the entire customer base. They have done that impressively well, but running lean means running in keep-the-lights-on mode, and a long list of things that would make this platform substantially better has been waiting for someone to own it.

That list is the role. Trip and route management, so an officer can plan an optimal day across several sites rather than making a separate journey for each one — today we pay for a round trip per verification, and the logistics are nowhere near optimal.   • Defining architecture standards, engineering processes and quality metrics, and hiring and developing engineers and Engineering Managers.

jobs.excerpt: In 1967, John Shepherd-Barron reached his bank minutes after closing and could not get at his own money.
jobs.description:
In 1967, John Shepherd-Barron reached his bank minutes after closing and could not get at his own money. In the bath that evening, he thought of a chocolate bar dispenser and swapped the chocolate for cash. On 27 June, outside a Barclays branch on Enfield High Street, an actor named Reg Varney drew £10 from the world's first cash machine. It took a four-digit code (six, until his wife told him nobody remembers six). The bank's hours had stopped being the customer's problem.

Nearly sixty years later, the bar has moved, but the test hasn't: a personal financial product is judged on whether it fits the life of the person using it. People do not read documentation, forgive a confusing screen, or care how the ledger works. They want one place that makes sense of everything — spending, saving, planning, investing — and that anticipates rather than reports: where they stand, what deserves attention, what to do next. Mercury is building personal banking* to that standard.

Personal Banking is how Mercury earns a place in someone's financial life. We're looking for a Head of Product to own it end-to-end: setting product strategy, leading a team of product managers, driving growth and engagement, and owning business performance.

*Mercury is a fintech company, not an FDIC-insured bank. Banking services provided through Choice Financial Group and Column N.A., Members FDIC.

Key responsibilities:

  • Build a personal banking experience so good that people tell their friends and colleagues about it
  • Own the metrics, product strategy and the propositions we take to our customers, covering personal money management, banking, savings, investments, money movement, and in the future, lending
  • Set the craft bar: sweat the details — copy, latency, empty states — that decide whether a consumer product feels inevitable rather than adequate
  • Drive the use of AI in products where it makes the experience meaningfully better
  • Build and scale the org: recruit and lead a high-performing PM team, instill strong build discipline, develop future leaders, and set a cadence and culture that drives pace and quality
  • Grow the business: own acquisition, activation, retention, and the loops that compound, including how personal banking connects to the businesses Mercury already serves
  • Make reliability and trust product features: own uptime, correctness, latency, and support outcomes, and be measured on them
  • Align the ecosystem: bring product, engineering, design, data, risk, compliance, legal, marketing, support, and partners behind one cohesive strategy

Some things that might make you successful in a role like this:

  • A consumer product leader with taste: you have built products millions of people chose to use, and can point to the decisions that made them work
  • You have shipped AI-led products to real consumers and have opinions about what AI makes possible and where it fails
  • An exceptionally high bar for craft, and a customer-centered, data-driven, and experimentation-oriented approach
  • 10+ years building consumer products, including time owning a product's growth and economics, not only its roadmap

  • Experience launching and scaling 0-1 products, alongside operating a large product with real customers on it

  • Nice to have: banking, payments, or fintech experience. We can teach you the rails; we cannot teach product judgment

Lyra Clinical Associates partners with Lyra Health, a leading provider of evidence-based mental health care, serving more than 20 million people globally in partnership with employers and more than 100 million through health plan and partner relationships. The company has delivered more than 15 million sessions of mental health care, published more than 35 peer-reviewed studies, and delivered unmatched outcomes in terms of access, clinical effectiveness, and cost efficiency. Lyra members have access to care in one day, and nine out of ten improve with the support of providers like you. Lyra is transforming access to life-changing mental health care through Lyra Empower, the only fully integrated, AI-powered platform combining the highest-quality care and technology solutions. You will be contracted by Lyra Clinical Associates.

About the Opportunity

Lyra’s provider network is composed of in-person and virtual therapists, physicians, and coaches across the US. With our advanced matching technology, supportive provider platform, and opportunities for training and clinical consultation, being part of our network is an incredible chance to do what you love (like patient care) with support for the things you don’t love (like self promotion and scheduling).
We are looking for contract psychiatrists who are passionate about whole-person, whole family mental health care and working within a connected network to provide patients with easily accessible, culturally responsive, high-quality mental health care.
As a contract psychiatrist, you’ll provide evidence-based treatment via live 60-minute video intake appointments and regular follow-up appointments. You'll conduct psychiatric evaluations and provide medication management. Lyra makes it easy to refer patients to evidence-based therapy and coaching services in tandem with your care.
You will provide care to individuals from a multitude of different backgrounds and experiences, as well as those with varying needs and abilities. We strive to continue to meet their unique needs by delivering culturally-responsive care—an approach that is mindful of the impact of cultural background on each person’s care experience.

Responsibilities:

  • Clinical Assessment and Diagnostic Skills - Conduct comprehensive psychiatric evaluations, formulate accurate diagnoses, and create individualized treatment plans tailored to each developmental stage.
  • Evidence-Based Treatment - Utilize proven therapeutic techniques and medication management strategies to address conditions such as anxiety, depression, ADHD, and mood disorders, ensuring safe and appropriate interventions.
  • Family-Centered Approach - Foster a collaborative treatment environment, educating families on mental health issues, involving them in care planning, and providing guidance on supportive measures at home.
  • Virtual Care Delivery - Conduct virtual psychiatric sessions, ensuring a high-quality and supportive experience, and leverage technology to maintain regular communication with members and families.
  • Collaborative Teamwork - Actively participate in team meetings, contribute to collaborative care planning, and provide consultative support to other team members for comprehensive member care.
  • Data-Driven Practice and Documentation - Maintain accurate, timely documentation of assessments, care plans, and progress notes. Use data analytics to assess outcomes and continuously improve care quality.
  • Ethics and Compliance - Ensure compliance with all regulatory and quality standards, engage in ongoing professional development, and commit to ethical, patient-centered care practices.

Requirements:

  • Board-certified or -eligible Child and Adolescent Psychiatrist with an active license in at least one state
  • Experience providing telehealth therapy services in a virtual environment (video and teletherapy) preferred but not required
  • Computer and live video tools literacy (e.g., Zoom, Google Meets, DoxyMe, Skype, etc.)
  • Demonstrated family engagement skills and experience working with children, adolescents, and young adults
  • Commitment to and familiarity with JCAHO guidelines and competency in practicing within an accredited framework to ensure safety, quality, and compliance

Here are some of the advantages of joining the Lyra provider network:

  • Set your own schedule without a minimum hours requirement
  • Focus less on the administrative burden of billing with Lyra’s paperless billing and quick payment turnaround
  • Access to a custom-built calendar for new patients to connect seamlessly

  • Have peace of mind with Lyra’s 24/7 Care Navigation team for client crisis support

jobs.excerpt: Evergreen Services Group is a San Francisco-based holding company that acquires and operates B2B services companies across North America.
jobs.description:
Evergreen Services Group is a San Francisco-based holding company that acquires and operates B2B services companies across North America. Since its founding in late 2017, Evergreen has completed 100+ acquisitions across Managed IT Services, Cybersecurity, ERP Software Partners and Government Services. We are driven by a people-first mission to be the best home for businesses and their leaders, by marrying capital allocation with inspired operations.

The Evergreen holding company team is comprised of 40+ professionals based in San Francisco who are focused on capital allocation, M&A, executive level hiring, strategic board leadership, and finance and accounting. Evergreen is a uniquely long-term oriented holding company that seeks to hold and grow businesses indefinitely rather than follow the 5-7 year holding period of a typical private equity fund. This allows us to take a truly long-term view on performance and people. Evergreen is backed by Alpine Investors, a leading private equity firm focused on the services and software industries with $16B+ in AUM.

Job Description:

As we continue to grow through acquisition, we're looking for a Technical Accounting Manager to own the acquisition accounting and integration onboarding work that comes with every deal — from opening balance sheet review, cash-to-GAAP transition, and through complex standalone technical positions prepared on behalf of the consolidated group.

This role sits at the intersection of deep technical GAAP expertise and program leadership. You'll be the person who makes sure every acquisition is accounted for correctly on day one, and who runs the onboarding program that integrates newly acquired companies into our accounting and reporting function. You'll partner closely with the Assistant Controller, Grove accounting teams, advisory and valuation partners, and external auditors, as the go-to technical resource for the broader F&A organization.

Key Responsibilities

M&A Onboarding & ASC 805 Purchase Accounting

  • Lead the review of ASC 805 opening balance sheets and purchase price allocations for all acquisitions
  • Coordinate with third-party valuation providers and review their fair value analyses for reasonableness and consistency with GAAP
  • Own and continuously improve the onboarding program for newly acquired operating companies, including the playbook, timeline, and standard deliverables used across every transaction
  • Serve as the technical accounting lead throughout the acquisition lifecycle — from diligence support through close and post-close reporting
  • Build repeatable frameworks and templates that scale as deal volume increases

Technical Accounting & Complex Matters

  • Draft and own technical accounting memos covering complex, judgment-heavy areas, including ASC 805, and:
  • Carve-out and push-down accounting for necessary standalone financials
  • Complex revenue recognition under ASC 606, including new revenue streams, new industries, and multi-currency/foreign operations as the portfolio expands internationally
  • Goodwill, reporting unit determination, and going concern assessments
  • PCC (Private Company Council) election evaluations and unwinds
  • Other non-routine transactions as they arise (debt modification, equity/PIU arrangements, foreign currency, etc.)
  • Serve as the go-to technical resource for Grove accounting teams on GAAP questions arising from acquisitions
  • Support the external audit process on all M&A-related technical positions

What We're Looking For

  • An owner who rolls up their sleeves; this is a hands-on technical role, not purely oversight
  • A leader who influences without direct authority — this role has no direct reports today, but you'll set the technical agenda for every deal, direct cross-functional teams (Grove accounting, valuation advisors, auditors) through each onboarding cycle, and mentor accounting team members across the portfolio on complex GAAP matters
  • Thrives in ambiguity — comfortable building process in a fast-paced, high-deal-volume environment
  • Translates complex accounting into language non-accounting stakeholders can act on, while demonstrating strong executive presence with auditors and leadership

Qualifications

Required Experience

  • 7+ years of progressive accounting experience, with a background in public accounting (Big 4 or mid-size firm preferred), consulting, and/or industry
  • Extensive experience preparing and reviewing ASC 805 materials, and comfort navigating other complex technical matters (ASC 606, 350, 810, 718)

Preferred Qualifications

  • Prior experience in a PE-backed, multi-entity, or high-acquisition-volume environment is a plus
  • CPA required
  • Experience with Business Central, OneStream, Power BI, and/or FloQast a plus

Compensation

The base salary range for this role is $140,000–$165,000, plus an annual bonus of up to 20% of base salary. Final compensation will be determined based on experience, qualifications, and location.

In addition to base salary and bonus, this role includes a benefits package including full medical and dental coverage, unlimited PTO, 401(k) match, family planning support, and much more.

We encourage you to apply even if you feel that you do not meet all of the above qualifications. Frequently cited statistics show that women and underrepresented groups apply to jobs only if they meet 100% of the qualifications. Evergreen encourages you to break that statistic and to apply. No one ever meets 100% of the requirements. We look forward to your application!

DIVERSITY, EQUITY, & INCLUSION AT EVERGREEN

At Evergreen, we acknowledge that an emphasis on diversity, equity, and inclusion (“DE&I”) is essential to hiring phenomenal people. To create the best home for businesses and spark success at our firm and throughout our portfolio, we aim to establish an environment where every person is welcomed, accepted, and empowered to excel in their role. These beliefs run true to our People-first philosophy, which emphasizes attributes over experience, we strive to recruit and work with those from a range of backgrounds, which drives creativity and innovation. At Evergreen, we recognize that we must continue to improve and expand and we are enthusiastic about maintaining Evergreen as one of the best places to work by ensuring a culture of inclusion and allowing everyone an unbiased opportunity to grow.

Compensation

A competitive compensation package will be offered alongside a benefits package including full medical and dental coverage, unlimited PTO, 401(k) match, family planning support, and much more.

Evergreen Services Group is proud to be an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion (including religious dress and grooming practices), sex (including pregnancy, childbirth and related medical conditions, breastfeeding, and conditions related to breastfeeding), gender, gender identity, gender expression, national origin, ancestry, age (40 or over), physical or medical disability, medical condition, marital status, registered domestic partner status, sexual orientation, genetic information, military and/or veteran status, or any other basis prohibited by applicable state or federal law. At OpenUp, our mission is to make mental well-being accessible to everyone. We support companies, their employees, and their families with proactive and practical mental health services. OpenUp is ranked in the Top 3 on LinkedIn’s Top Startups list for 2023, 2024 & 2025. We are expanding our international teams and we are searching for like-minded talent. About the assignment

To fuel our growth, we are looking for entrepreneurial, purpose-driven experts who share our vision of making mental well-being direct, approachable, and impactful.

At OpenUp, we focus on prevention. We don’t diagnose; we provide guidance for life’s everyday challenges - whether it’s work-related stress, self-confidence, relationship dynamics, or finding direction in uncertain times.

We offer planned and on-demand video consults seven days a week, ensuring people can access support when they need it most - no long waits, no barriers. In each session (usually 25 minutes), you’ll help clients set clear, actionable goals and guide them toward meaningful first steps.

Our mission is to help people build skills and autonomy, so they feel confident to continue their journey independently. Many clients find they gain what they need in just a few focused conversations - thanks to your structured, goal-oriented support.

You’ll engage with a wide variety of people, from diverse cultural backgrounds and industries, and you’ll have opportunities to grow through weekly intervision sessions and ongoing development. We work together to make mental well-being accessible, practical, and empowering for everyone.

About you

You’re a psychologist (MSc) who’s passionate about making a difference- both locally and internationally. You enjoy working in a dynamic, fast-paced environment and are eager to contribute to a meaningful mission.

We welcome experts who meet the following criteria:

  • You have native-level fluency in Dutch.
  • Strong English communication skills (written and spoken) and confident in delivering consultations in English.
  • Master's degree in Psychology.
  • Minimum of 4 years’ experience providing 1:1 consultations after obtaining a Master’s degree in Psychology.

  • Tech-savvy, with a self-reliant approach to digital platforms and systems.
  • You have a laptop/computer with Windows 11, OR MacOS Sonoma 14, AND an antivirus turned on in your device.
  • Entrepreneurial, proactive, and open to continuous learning.
  • A team player who thrives independently and takes ownership of personal and professional growth.
  • A natural connector: you create a safe, supportive space for clients and act decisively to help them move forward.
  • You live the "practice what you preach" mindset, showing integrity and reflection in how you approach both clients and colleagues.

Freelance experience is a plus, as we value self-starters who are confident in managing their own practice.

What you can expect

Join us at a time of exciting growth, where your expertise and ideas are valued. Here’s what you can expect:

  • A freelance contract for 10-15 hours per week.
  • A diverse and international team with expertise in work and organizational psychology, health psychology, lifestyle medicine, and more.
  • A culture of reflection, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
  • Weekly check-ins, intervision sessions, and skill-building opportunities.
  • Two dedicated training half-days each year to reflect on your practice and develop your skills further.

Next steps

Inspired to be part of OpenUp? We’d love to hear your story. Apply via our website and we’ll get in touch soon.

If you have questions, please visit our FAQ page or reach out directly.

At OpenUp, everyone is welcome to apply regardless of age, gender, background, nationality, or any other characteristic. What matters to us is high performance, a real drive to make an impact and the ambition to become the European market leader. If you're ready to OpenUp, join us!

We are also focused on incubating protocols that can support both tokenized real-world assets and traditional crypto.
Founded by folks from Goldman Sachs Digital Assets Team, we’re backed by some of the best investors in the world including Founders Fund, Coinbase Ventures, Pantera Capital, Tiger Global, and more. We are currently the leaders in the space in terms of AUM and are well capitalized to continue growing the firm. We're fully remote, with team members across the U.S.

About the role

Ondo Finance is looking for a Growth PM to own user-facing product strategy across our unified platform interface, Ondo Finance App. This role is the growth counterpart to our platform PMs — and will be the primary driver of user acquisition, activation, and retention across Ondo's expanding product suite (Stocks, Treasuries, Portfolios, and more).

You will work at the intersection of product, design, engineering, and marketing to build world-class user journeys for a new generation of on-chain financial products.

What You'll Own

  • User acquisition: Identify and build product-led growth loops, referral mechanisms, onboarding flows, and entry points that bring new users into the Ondo ecosystem
  • Activation: Design and optimize the end-to-end onboarding experience — from first visit to first meaningful transaction — across Ondo Finance Web App and eventually mobile
  • Retention & engagement: Build features and feedback loops that keep users active, informed, and deepening their relationship with Ondo's product lines
  • User journey design: Map and continuously improve user journeys across all Ondo products surfaced through Ondo Finance Web App
  • Experimentation: Drive a structured A/B testing and experimentation culture; define success metrics and own the growth analytics stack alongside data and engineering
  • Cross-product growth: Collaborate with product line PMs to ensure growth initiatives are coordinated and reinforced across product surfaces

Requirements

  • 4–7+ years of product management experience with a clear focus on consumer-facing or growth-oriented products
  • Experience in fintech, crypto, or financial products — particularly products involving real-world assets, trading, or investment platforms
  • Personal experience using financial products similar to ours, with a genuine desire to walk in the customer's shoes
  • Demonstrated track record of owning and improving acquisition, activation, and/or retention metrics at scale
  • Strong product instincts — you care deeply about user experience and are willing to do whatever it takes to make the product successful
  • Excellent written and verbal communication; able to write sharp, well-reasoned PRDs and present clearly to engineers and leadership
  • Data-driven mindset with hands-on experience defining KPIs, running experiments, and translating data into product decisions
  • US-hours based (preference per current team structure)

Nice to have

  • Familiarity with on-chain / Web3 user onboarding challenges (wallet setup, KYC flows, etc.)
  • Experience working on a unified platform serving multiple financial product lines
  • Prior exposure to developer-facing or API-adjacent products

What we offer

  • Competitive compensation including salary, future token rights, and/or equity (according to your preferences) — we're well-funded and believe that great talent deserves great compensation
  • Full benefits (medical, vision, and dental) and flexible vacation policy (PTO)
  • Small remote-first team across many countries — you'll be an early team member helping shape our vision, culture, and design practices

Priority Commerce is a leading financial technology company on a mission to deliver a personalized, easy-to-adopt financial toolset that accelerates cash flow and optimizes working capital for businesses. Our vision is to eliminate the barriers to unlocking revenue - empowering businesses to grow faster and operate smarter.

We achieve this through the Priority Commerce Engine, an innovative platform that combines payables, acquiring, and banking and treasury solutions. This unified approach allows businesses to streamline financial operations, reduce unnecessary costs, and uncover new revenue opportunities.

At Priority Commerce, we're driven by results. We expect our people tobe known for results- bringing expertise, momentum, and relentless focus to every challenge, helping our clients and each other thrive.

About the Role:

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to own Priority Commerce Engine (PCE) Platform & APIs, setting product direction, leading the roadmap, and shaping how Priority’s financial capabilities are exposed consistently across products, partners, and developer experiences. This is a hands-on role for someone who can move comfortably between strategy and execution. You will turn complex platform problems into clear product requirements, API behavior, lifecycle models, and roadmap decisions. You will work across payments, onboarding, transactions, accounts, banking, treasury, and financial operations, partnering closely with Product, Engineering, and Architecture. The ideal candidate combines strong API and platform product experience with deep banking or payments expertise, strong product judgment, and the ability to lead through influence across multiple teams.

  • Financial Capability APIs: Lead product direction across transactions, money movement, onboarding, entities, accounts, banking, treasury, balances, and financial operations.

  • Platform Capability Expansion: Assess new and evolving capabilities and determine their implications for PCE Platform & APIs.

  • API Lifecycle and Evolution: Own compatibility, versioning, migration, coexistence, and deprecation across the API portfolio.

  • Cross-Product Platform Strategy: Identify recurring needs across products, partners, and developer experiences and determine which warrant common Platform capabilities.

  • requirements exposed through PCE APIs, partnering with Engineering and Architecture

  • on technical design.

  • Lead Platform and API initiatives spanning transactions, money movement, onboarding,

  • entities, accounts, banking, treasury, and financial operations.

  • Take ambiguous, cross-functional Platform problems and drive them to clear

  • requirements, trade-offs, and product decisions.

  • Maintain visibility into new and evolving capabilities and determine their implications for

  • the Platform roadmap.

  • Identify recurring integration needs and determine when they warrant common Platform

  • capabilities versus product-specific solutions.

  • Own the Product direction for API compatibility, versioning, migration, coexistence, and deprecation.

  • Partner with Developer Enablement and Embedded Product teams to ensure Platform capabilities are ready for adoption across developer and embedded experiences.

  • Define and track Platform outcomes such as API adoption, cross-product usage, migration progress, and integration consistency.

  • Stay hands-on through execution, using AI and modern product tools to accelerate analysis, requirements, stories, acceptance criteria, and documentation, and working closely with Engineering and Program or Project Management to move initiatives through delivery.

  • Communicate Platform strategy, priorities, dependencies, and trade-offs clearly to Product, Engineering, Architecture, and executive stakeholders.

  • Prioritize Platform investments based on customer value, business impact, cross-product

  • leverage, dependencies, risk, and long-term Platform value.

What Success Looks Like:

  • First 90 days: You understand PCE’s major API domains, consumers, current roadmap, and Platform opportunities, and have developed a clear point of view on priorities and gaps.

  • 6 months: The Platform roadmap is executing predictably, API product definitions and lifecycle decisions are clearer, and alignment across Product, Engineering, and Architecture has improved.

  • 12 months: PCE APIs are increasingly adopted across products and integrations, Platform decisions are being made proactively, and new capabilities can be introduced with greater consistency and less one-off integration work.

Candidate Requirements:

  • Roughly 7 to 10 years of relevant Product Management experience, including meaningful ownership of platform, API, integration, or technically complex products. This is a guide, not a gate. We hire on demonstrated impact.

  • Deep banking and/or payments expertise, with practical understanding of transactions, money movement, accounts, balances, settlement, onboarding, and financial operations.

  • Hands-on experience owning API or platform products that support multiple applications, partners, or external integrations.

  • Strong understanding of REST APIs, events, asynchronous workflows, lifecycle modeling, versioning, backward compatibility, and integration patterns.

  • Demonstrated ability to translate complex financial capabilities into clear product requirements and API behavior.

  • Strong product judgment and experience independently taking ambiguous, cross-functional problems from discovery through delivery.

  • Experience evolving APIs over time, including migration, compatibility, modernization, and adoption.

  • Fluency working with Engineering and Architecture on technical trade-offs and influencing teams without direct authority.

  • Strong roadmap, prioritization, communication, and executive stakeholder-management skills.

  • Fluency with AI-assisted Product workflows and a hands-on approach to requirements, stories, acceptance criteria, analysis, and documentation when needed.

Nice to Have

  • Experience across multiple financial domains such as merchant acquiring, banking, treasury, payables, onboarding or underwriting, ledgering, reconciliation, or money movement.

  • Experience with payment rails such as ACH, RTP/FedNow, cards, wires, or checks.

  • Experience building API platforms that support multiple processors, financial institutions, providers, or business domains.

  • Experience with OpenAPI, webhooks, API gateways, idempotency, SDK ecosystems, developer platforms, or API observability.

  • Experience managing API migrations or deprecations across multiple consumers.

  • Experience working in regulated financial environments.

Work Environment & Culture:

We believe that performance and experience go hand in hand -an exceptional employee experience is earned through contribution. We are a results-driven team, grounded in our core values: ownership, authenticity, service, trust, innovation, and camaraderie.

Our culture is built for those who want to make an impact. We challenge each other to grow, celebrate progress, and support one another through shared goals and real connection. Whether you're building technology, serving clients, or supporting internal teams, you’ll be part of a company that empowers you to perform at your best and be known for results.

Compensation and Benefits:$116k - $167k USD/ $100k - $137k CAD

This role manages high-value supplier relationships and negotiates enterprise-wide agreements while participating in acquisition strategy for pozzolanic materials and supporting global supply chain efforts for these materials. The position shifts purchasing from a reactive activity to a proactive, data-driven strategy. Supplier Relationship Management (SRM)

Contract & Price Negotiation

⚡ In 6 months:

  • A clear product marketing content engine is established with reusable assets across video, one-pagers, product web pages, slides, and blogs

About the Role
We are looking for a Senior UI/UX Designer – AI to help define the next generation of intelligent experiences across Intermedia's products.
In this role, you will design experiences that make artificial intelligence useful, intuitive, trustworthy, and approachable for business users. You will work at the intersection of UX strategy, interaction design, generative AI, conversational experiences, and enterprise software, turning sophisticated AI capabilities into simple experiences that solve real customer problems.
You will partner closely with Product Managers, Product Owners, AI/ML teams, Engineering, Research, and other designers throughout the complete product lifecycle—from customer and market research through concepts, prototyping, development, launch, and post-launch analysis.
This is not simply a role for adding AI features to existing interfaces. You will help define how users interact with AI across our products, including copilots, assistants, conversational interfaces, recommendations, summarization, intelligent automation, and agentic experiences.

Key Responsibilities

Responsibilities
AI Experience Design
  • Design intuitive user experiences for AI-powered capabilities across web, desktop, mobile, and administrative interfaces.
  • Explore new interaction models for generative AI, including conversational interfaces, copilots, AI assistants, intelligent recommendations, content generation, summarization, and AI-driven workflow automation.
  • Design experiences for emerging agentic AI capabilities where AI systems can reason, recommend actions, execute tasks, and coordinate multi-step workflows on behalf of users.
  • Translate complex AI functionality into simple, understandable interactions appropriate for everyday business users.
  • Determine when AI should proactively assist users versus when users should explicitly initiate or control AI functionality.
  • Design effective patterns for prompts, suggestions, generated content, AI actions, confirmations, feedback, and human intervention.
  • Create experiences that communicate what an AI system is doing, why it made a recommendation, and what actions it has taken or intends to take.

UX & Product Design
  • Own design initiatives from discovery and concept development through prototyping, implementation, launch, and post-launch optimization.
  • Conduct user research, usability studies, interviews, competitive analysis, and workflow analysis to understand customer needs and behaviors.
  • Translate customer problems and product requirements into user journeys, workflows, wireframes, prototypes, and high-fidelity designs.
  • Develop and validate design hypotheses through rapid prototyping and user testing.
  • Identify opportunities to simplify complex workflows through thoughtful UX and intelligent automation.
  • Use qualitative and quantitative data to evaluate experiences and recommend improvements.
  • Work closely with Product Management to ensure designs address meaningful customer problems and measurable business outcomes.

AI Trust & Responsible Design
  • Design AI experiences that establish appropriate levels of trust, transparency, and user control.
  • Clearly distinguish AI-generated information and actions where appropriate.
  • Design graceful experiences for uncertainty, incomplete information, errors, hallucinations, and situations where the AI cannot confidently complete a request.
  • Create effective confirmation, undo, escalation, and human-in-the-loop patterns for AI-driven actions.
  • Design feedback mechanisms that allow users to evaluate, correct, or improve AI-generated results.
  • Partner with Product, Engineering, Security, Privacy, and Legal teams to incorporate responsible AI principles into the user experience.
  • Help establish UX guidelines for consistent and responsible use of AI throughout Intermedia products.

Design Systems
  • Contribute to and evolve Intermedia's design system to support AI-powered experiences.
  • Define reusable patterns and components for conversational interfaces, AI recommendations, generated content, AI actions, status indicators, feedback mechanisms, and agentic workflows.
  • Ensure new AI capabilities integrate naturally with established product experiences rather than feeling like disconnected features.
  • Maintain consistency across products while identifying where emerging AI interactions require new design paradigms.
  • Partner with designers and developers to ensure design-system components are practical, scalable, accessible, and consistently implemented.

Collaboration & Leadership
  • Partner closely with Product Managers, Product Owners, AI/ML engineers, software engineers, architects, researchers, and other designers.
  • Facilitate design workshops and collaborative discovery sessions to explore customer problems and AI opportunities.
  • Clearly communicate design rationale, research findings, user needs, and tradeoffs to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Challenge assumptions and advocate for customer-centered solutions when technology or implementation considerations begin driving the experience.
  • Provide design leadership and mentorship to other designers and help raise the overall quality of UX across the organization.
  • Collaborate effectively across multiple teams and product areas to create coherent end-to-end customer experiences.
  • Stay current with emerging AI technologies, interaction patterns, and design practices and translate relevant developments into practical product experiences.

Our Expectations
  • 5+ years of professional UI/UX, Product Design, or Interaction Design experience, ideally designing complex SaaS or enterprise software.
  • A strong portfolio demonstrating end-to-end product design, complex workflows, interaction design, and thoughtful problem solving.
  • Excellent knowledge of usability, UX/UI, interaction design, information architecture, accessibility, and human factors principles.
  • Strong ability to analyze complex requirements and turn them into simple, elegant solutions.
  • Experience conducting or participating in user research and usability testing.
  • Strong proficiency with Figma, prototyping tools, and modern design-system practices.
  • Experience working closely with Product Management and Engineering in an Agile software-development environment.
  • Strong communication, presentation, collaboration, and stakeholder-management skills.
  • Ability to work effectively with ambiguity and rapidly evolving requirements.
  • Strong attention to detail while maintaining an understanding of the broader product and customer experience.

AI Experience & Knowledge

We don't expect you to be an AI engineer, but we do expect curiosity and practical fluency with modern AI technologies.

The ideal candidate has:
  • Experience designing products or features powered by generative AI, machine learning, or intelligent automation.
  • Understanding of large language models (LLMs) and the opportunities and limitations they introduce into product experiences.
  • Familiarity with conversational UX and natural-language interfaces.
  • Understanding of concepts such as prompts, context, AI-generated content, confidence and uncertainty, hallucinations, and AI feedback loops.
  • Familiarity with AI agents and emerging patterns for designing systems that can perform multi-step actions on behalf of users.
  • Experience thinking through trust, transparency, explainability, privacy, and user control in AI experiences.
  • A strong interest in experimenting with new AI tools and interaction models.

Advantages
  • Experience designing enterprise communications, collaboration, contact center, productivity, or workflow-automation products.
  • Experience designing AI copilots, assistants, conversational interfaces, or agentic workflows.
  • Experience developing or contributing to large-scale design systems.
  • Experience with voice and multimodal interfaces.
  • Understanding of accessibility standards and inclusive design.
  • Familiarity with HTML/CSS and the technical constraints of modern web applications.
  • Experience using AI-assisted design and prototyping tools.
  • Experience working with globally distributed Product and Engineering teams.

What Success Looks Like
As a Senior UI/UX Designer – AI, you will help ensure that AI at Intermedia is not simply powerful technology—it is a valuable and trusted customer experience.

Success means:
  • Customers immediately understand how AI can help them.
  • Complex AI capabilities feel simple and natural to use.
  • Users remain informed and in control when AI recommends or takes actions.
  • AI features integrate seamlessly into existing customer workflows.
  • Common AI interaction patterns become consistent across Intermedia products.
  • Research and customer feedback meaningfully influence AI product decisions.
  • Product and Engineering teams view Design as a strategic partner in determining what AI experiences should be built, not simply how they should look.

Ultimately, you will help establish the design language and interaction principles that shape how customers experience AI across Intermedia's portfolio.
