jobs.title: E-Commerce Manager (DTC)
jobs.excerpt: Real opportunities.  Real impact.  Your career, redefined.
jobs.description:
Real opportunities. Real impact. Your career, redefined.

(NOTE: A human reviews every application at Oceans, so please apply for only one position and only once a year—if you're a better fit for another role, we’ll route your application accordingly and if we’re not quite ready for you, we’ll reach back out later.)

At Oceans, we help the best and brightest of Sri Lanka to take advantage of opportunities that otherwise wouldn’t be available to them, while supporting entrepreneurs around the world. Our community (we call them Divers) don’t do surface work—they go deep to solve complex challenges and make a real impact. And in doing so, they support bold ideas, expand their skills, broaden their expertise, and grow their careers, all without having to leave family and friends.

As an E-Commerce Manager (DTC), you will play a critical role in owning and growing a major e-commerce marketplace, with a primary focus on Amazon and a secondary focus on Shopify. You'll be responsible for the full channel—from product detail pages and advertising through inventory, forecasting, fulfillment, and performance management.

This role is ideal for someone who combines strong marketplace expertise with commercial and operational thinking. You'll need to understand how traffic, product pages, conversion, advertising, inventory, replenishment, and revenue connect, while taking ownership of the details that keep the channel healthy and growing.

Accountability

Your success as the E-Commerce Manager (DTC) will be defined by your ability to own the e-commerce channel end to end, identify opportunities and issues proactively, and ensure that marketing, inventory, and operational decisions work together to support growth.

Here's how you'll make an impact:

End-to-End E-Commerce Management

  • Own day-to-day marketplace operations with a primary focus on Amazon.
  • Act as the subject matter expert for the Amazon channel.
  • Monitor channel performance and proactively identify issues and opportunities.
  • Maintain visibility across traffic, product detail pages, conversion, sales, inventory, and replenishment.
  • Understand how changes across the channel affect overall revenue performance.
  • Ensure the marketplace remains healthy, accurate, and operationally reliable.

Product Detail Page & Listing Optimization

  • Manage and optimize product listings and product detail pages.
  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date product information.
  • Improve product discoverability and conversion through effective listing optimization.
  • Monitor listing health and SKU performance.
  • Identify opportunities to improve product content and marketplace performance.
  • Bring strong marketplace expertise and proactively recommend improvements.

Amazon Advertising

  • Set up, monitor, and optimize Amazon advertising campaigns.
  • Monitor advertising performance and identify underperforming campaigns.
  • Manage advertising activity against broader sales objectives.
  • Identify opportunities to improve efficiency and performance.
  • Use advertising data to understand traffic and conversion performance.
  • Ensure advertising decisions are aligned with overall channel performance.

FBA Inventory & Replenishment

  • Monitor FBA inventory levels and replenishment requirements.
  • Identify stockout risks and potential inventory constraints.
  • Coordinate replenishment with relevant operational stakeholders.
  • Monitor lead times, aging inventory, and expected demand.
  • Maintain visibility into inventory movement and upcoming requirements.
  • Document important inventory and replenishment changes.
  • Ensure recurring inventory deadlines are met.

Forecasting & Demand Planning

  • Build and maintain monthly forecasts using actual performance, historical data, inventory, demand, sales activity, and relevant trends.
  • Monitor expected demand against available inventory and fulfillment capacity.
  • Update forecasts as business conditions change.
  • Clearly document assumptions behind forecasts.
  • Identify potential gaps between expected demand and available inventory.
  • Use forecasting to support better replenishment and channel decisions.

Month-End Reconciliation & Reporting

  • Reconcile sales, inventory movement, current inventory, forecast assumptions, and replenishment activity.
  • Monitor variances between expected and actual performance.
  • Investigate and explain material differences.
  • Provide clear visibility into where performance landed and why.
  • Use reconciliation findings to inform future forecasts and operational decisions.

Revenue Performance Management

  • Monitor progress against monthly revenue objectives.
  • Identify whether the channel is on track and, if not, understand why.
  • Determine which levers can improve performance, including advertising, product detail pages, inventory, replenishment, forecasting, and operations.
  • Turn channel performance data into clear recommendations and actions.
  • Maintain a commercial understanding of how operational decisions affect revenue.

Shopify & Cross-Functional Operations

  • Support Shopify operations as a secondary channel.
  • Maintain awareness of storefront and e-commerce activity outside Amazon.
  • Coordinate with operations, sales, and other relevant stakeholders.
  • Support inventory, forecasting, replenishment, fulfillment, and marketplace-related activities.
  • Ensure information and operational requirements are communicated clearly across functions.

Colleagues

You'll work closely with operations, sales, fulfillment, and other cross-functional stakeholders to ensure that marketplace activity, inventory, forecasting, and operational execution remain aligned. You'll act as the operational owner of the e-commerce channel, bringing visibility to performance and proactively identifying what needs to change to keep the business moving forward.

At Oceans Talent, you'll also receive guidance and support from your Operations Manager, who will help you succeed in the role and ensure that you're continuously growing and developing in your career.

Skills and Qualifications

At Oceans Talent, we believe in T-shaped individuals—those who bring deep expertise in one area paired with broad curiosity across the business. As the E-Commerce Manager (DTC), your vertical focus will be on Amazon marketplace management and e-commerce growth, while your horizontal focus will include advertising, inventory, forecasting, fulfillment, analytics, Shopify, and cross-functional operations.

To excel in this role, you should have:

  • Experience: 3+ years of hands-on experience managing Amazon e-commerce operations, including Seller Central, FBA, marketplace growth, inventory, forecasting, and advertising.
  • Amazon: Meaningful hands-on experience independently operating Seller Central, beyond basic listing or administrative work.
  • FBA: Strong understanding of FBA operations, inventory management, and replenishment.
  • Marketplace Growth: Experience managing and improving e-commerce marketplace performance.
  • PDP Optimization: Strong understanding of product detail page and listing optimization.
  • Amazon Advertising: Hands-on experience with Amazon Ads and campaign optimization.
  • Forecasting: Experience building forecasts using historical performance, demand, inventory, and sales data.
  • Inventory & Reconciliation: Experience managing inventory movement, replenishment, and month-end reconciliation.
  • Analytics: Strong spreadsheet and analytical skills, with the ability to turn operational data into recommendations.
  • Physical Products: Experience working with physical-product e-commerce businesses.
  • Operations: Strong understanding of the connection between marketplace activity, inventory, fulfillment, and revenue.
  • Organization: Strong deadline management and attention to recurring operational requirements.
  • Autonomy: Ability to take ownership of a channel and proactively identify what needs to be done without step-by-step supervision.

During the interview process, you'll have the opportunity to showcase your skills in the following areas:

  • Amazon Marketplace Management: How you manage Seller Central and identify opportunities to improve channel performance.
  • PDP & Conversion: How you approach product detail page optimization and marketplace conversion.
  • Amazon Advertising: How you build, monitor, and optimize advertising activity.
  • Inventory & FBA: How you manage inventory, replenishment, and stockout risk.
  • Forecasting & Analytics: How you use data to forecast demand and make operational decisions.
  • Revenue Performance: How you diagnose performance against targets and determine which levers to pull.
  • Ownership & Execution: How you independently manage recurring deadlines, solve problems, and coordinate across functions.

Diversity of experience is core to Oceans. You are expected to work inclusively with individuals from a variety of backgrounds, ensuring that both personal and collective dignity are supported.

Role Specifications

This is a remote role, where you will be expected to work a split shift with some overlap with our client’s time zone. You will, however, be expected to be present for in-person training programs during your first 3.5 weeks with us. During the offer process, we’ll share more information about our benefits and compensation philosophy, considering both market trends and individual factors.

About Oceans

At Oceans Talent, we connect the world’s top talent with visionary companies building what’s next. Here, you’re not just stepping into another role — you’re joining a team that values individuality, ambition, and growth without limits. Unique, like you.

We’re always excited to share more about our journey, where we’re headed, and how you can grow with us throughout the interview process.

Want to learn more about our recruitment process, what to expect from interviews, and possible outcomes? Check out [The Dive].

jobs.title: Global Product Owner - Employer Of Record (EOR)
jobs.excerpt: Global Product Owner - Employer of Record (EOR) Role OverviewAt GoGlobal, the Global Product Owner (GPO), Employer of Record (EOR) owns the EOR product end to end, including its global scope, standards, commercial model, operating framework, service delivery, and economics.
jobs.description:
Global Product Owner - Employer of Record (EOR)

Role Overview

At GoGlobal, the Global Product Owner (GPO), Employer of Record (EOR) owns the EOR product end to end, including its global scope, standards, commercial model, operating framework, service delivery, and economics. As a senior member of the Delivery leadership team reporting to the Chief Delivery Officer, you are accountable for the growth, profitability, operational excellence, and reputation of the EOR product worldwide.

This is a leadership role whose primary objective is sustainable business growth through exceptional client delivery. You are the senior product and delivery voice for EOR in the market, serving as a trusted advisor to clients, prospects, and strategic partners while partnering closely with Revenue and Sales to win, retain, and expand business globally.

You lead the EOR function globally through the Global Process Manager (GPM), Regional Product Owners (RPOs), EOR Operations leaders, and Outsourcing Control (OC) leads. You establish and defend global product standards, design the operating model to scale with market demand, and continuously evolve the product to strengthen GoGlobal's competitive advantage.

Roles & Responsibilities

Commercial Leadership & Growth

  • Act as the senior client-facing product authority for EOR, leading strategic engagements, executive client discussions, proposals, and escalations.
  • Partner with Revenue and Sales as the EOR subject matter expert, helping qualify opportunities, shape solutions, support pricing strategies, and expand key accounts.
  • Drive product growth through strong market positioning, customer retention, cross-selling, and upselling initiatives.
  • Define and evolve the commercial logic for EOR, including pricing frameworks, service tiers, packaging, premium offerings, and commercial guardrails.
  • Support strategic partnerships and alliances that enhance market reach and service capability.

Product Strategy & Ownership

  • Own the global EOR product strategy, service catalogue, delivery framework, and operating model.
  • Define what is included within the EOR service scope, associated service levels, and operational standards globally.
  • Continuously evaluate market trends, competitive positioning, client needs, and regulatory developments to enhance the product offering.
  • Lead product innovation initiatives to improve client value, scalability, and service differentiation.
  • Establish a clear product roadmap that aligns with company growth objectives and market opportunities.

Global Delivery Standards & Operational Excellence

  • Set and maintain global execution standards, SLAs, quality metrics, and client experience expectations across all regions.
  • Ensure consistency in onboarding, employee lifecycle management, payroll coordination, benefits administration, and offboarding processes globally.
  • Drive operational excellence through standardization, automation, process optimization, and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Partner with Operations, Technology, and Legal teams to enhance service delivery efficiency and scalability.
  • Oversee the resolution of critical delivery issues and complex client escalations.

Cost Management & Commercial Sustainability

  • Own EOR product-level cost-to-serve and overall commercial performance.
  • Drive productivity improvements, operational efficiencies, margin enhancement, and long-term economic sustainability.
  • Evaluate delivery models and resource strategies to optimize profitability while maintaining service quality.
  • Reduce dependency on high-cost external providers through capability development, process optimization, and strategic sourcing initiatives.
  • Ensure pricing structures accurately reflect risk, complexity, and service delivery requirements.

Regional Delivery Governance & Team Leadership

  • Lead all Regional Product Owners (RPOs) for EOR as their global functional leader, holding them accountable for regional performance and delivery outcomes.
  • Lead, mentor, and develop the GPM, RPOs, Operations leaders, and OC leads to build strong product, commercial, and operational capability.
  • Foster alignment across regions while ensuring local market requirements are incorporated into product execution.
  • Create a culture of accountability, collaboration, innovation, and client-centricity throughout the global EOR organization.
  • Define organizational capability requirements and workforce planning strategies to support growth.

Compliance, Risk & Governance

  • Own the global compliance posture for the EOR product across employment, payroll, tax, labor law, and worker classification obligations.
  • Ensure EOR delivery adheres to regulatory requirements and internal governance standards in every country where GoGlobal operates.
  • Partner with Legal, Compliance, and Risk functions to proactively identify and mitigate regulatory, operational, and commercial risks.
  • Maintain strong controls and governance frameworks across all delivery locations and third-party partners.
  • Oversee compliance monitoring, audit readiness, and ongoing regulatory change management.

Key Performance Indicators

  • Revenue growth and product win rate.
  • Retention and Net Revenue Retention (NRR).
  • Gross margin and cost-to-serve.
  • EOR employee onboarding speed and quality.
  • Delivery SLA attainment and operational performance.
  • Client satisfaction (NPS and CSAT).
  • Compliance and audit performance.
  • Productivity and scalability metrics.
  • Employee lifecycle service quality.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Human Resources, Finance, Law, International Business, or a related field.
  • 12+ years of experience in Employer of Record (EOR), Global Employment, HR Outsourcing, Workforce Solutions, Payroll Services, or Global Business Services.
  • At least 5 years leading a global product, service line, operational function, or business unit with end-to-end accountability.
  • Demonstrated track record of driving growth through revenue generation, market expansion, client retention, and account development.
  • Experience managing a service-line P&L, including ownership of cost-to-serve, margin, pricing strategies, and productivity performance.
  • Strong working knowledge of global employment practices, labor regulations, payroll delivery models, worker classification, and workforce compliance requirements.
  • Strong client-facing, commercial, and business development capability, comfortable serving as the senior product voice with clients and prospects.
  • Experience leading senior product, operational, and delivery leaders across multiple regions and cultures.
  • Ability to balance commercial objectives, operational excellence, compliance requirements, and customer experience.

Preferred

  • Prior experience as a Product Owner, Service Line Leader, General Manager, or Head of EOR within a global workforce solutions, PEO, EOR, payroll, or HR services organization.
  • Experience leading a global EOR transformation, operating model redesign, or large-scale growth initiative.
  • Experience building and scaling international employment solutions across multiple jurisdictions.
  • Strong understanding of HR technology, workforce management platforms, and digital service delivery models.
  • Experience leading post-acquisition integration, globalization, or operational transformation programs.
  • Professional certifications in HR, Payroll, Employment Law, or Business Management are advantageous.

Benefits

OVERVIEW

As a privately owned company, we are free from the pressures of venture capital or private equity investors demanding exponential growth in unreasonable time frames.

Sometimes, things just take time to do well. In our business, delivering great results is a process - and we're committed to doing it right.

We are not for sale. We believe that financial success is a natural outcome of our work, not the primary goal. Unlike many investors who view money as a goal, our focus is on long-term growth and sustainable success.

We are a global team, built for those who want to go further. Here's what your career at GoGlobal looks like:

A company small enough for your voice to be heard meaningfully, yet large enough to make a global impact

Collaborating with a diverse, global and supportive team

Built for the long-haul - no VC or PE pressure, just a focus on sustainable growth

WHY WE ARE DIFFERENT

We Make Growing Your Career Possible

    • We operate with the benefits of a partnership without the complexities of a partnership. Our hybrid partnership-corporate model offers all employees the opportunity to become a partner, while maintaining a streamlined corporate structure so that decisions are made quickly.
    • We do not offer equity plans. As we are not for sale and are not chasing an exit, "stock options" hold little value in our business model. Instead, we provide opportunities for outstanding employees to make partner and share in the profits. We believe it's better to build lasting value than to chase a one-time payout.
    • We prioritize organic and sustainable growth. Expanding operations quickly by way of mergers and acquisitions might seem appealing, but the reality is integrating diverse cultures can be challenging. We're proud of our own culture and prefer to grow it our way.
    • We're global. We offer career opportunities across the world-whether it's new job roles or international locations
    • English is our official language, but for many, it's our second language. We embrace this and find it rewarding communicating with colleagues from all over the world.
    • We are not a family. We operate more like a high-performing sports team where each individual's contribution is crucial to our collective success.
    • We keep things simple and collaborative. Our structure makes it easy for teams to work together across borders so we can serve our clients with global needs more effectively. Unlike big, siloed companies, we work seamlessly to handle international deals without the headaches of territorial ownership.
    • We believe in transparency and trust. Every month, we share our financials with the team so everyone knows where we stand and what's coming next. It's all about open communication, building trust and empowering every individual to be part of our journey. We don't tell you what to think - we provide the information you need to make your own informed decisions.
    • We believe flexibility drives success. Our company is built on trust, and that's why we embrace fully remote work, and hybrid options in some countries. Forget rigid office routines - it's old school! This flexibility fuels productivity, strengthens our workforce, and ensures we remain agile in a fast-changing world.

Ready to take the next step in your career with us? Apply now!

**Kindly review the provided privacy notice (LINK) to gain a comprehensive understanding of our policies and practices governing the treatment of your Personal Data. By applying, you consent to background and reference checks, to the extent permissible by law.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer – Workday Finance
jobs.excerpt: For decades, DTN has been the silent force behind some of the world’s most critical industries—helping businesses navigate complexity, uncertainty, and risk with smarter, faster decisions.
jobs.description:
For decades, DTN has been the silent force behind some of the world’s most critical industries—helping businesses navigate complexity, uncertainty, and risk with smarter, faster decisions. From agriculture to energy to weather intelligence, our proprietary Operational Decisioning Platform transforms raw data into decision-grade insights—enabling companies to optimize supply chains, ensure market stability, and safeguard infrastructure against disruption. We don’t follow trends—we set the standard for precision, trust, and operational impact.

DTN is at an exciting inflection point. Building off a foundation of financial strength, profitability, and industry trust, we’re accelerating growth and expanding our global footprint. Our purpose-built solutions—powered by AI and honed by decades of vertical expertise—are helping some of the world’s most significant enterprises thrive amid operational constraints and uncover new opportunities in a fast-changing world.

Job Description:

DTN is seeking a highly experienced Senior Software Engineer – Workday Finance to join our Finance engineering organization and build scalable, reliable, and secure software solutions supporting critical financial business processes.

In this role, you will design, develop, and maintain high-quality software for enterprise Finance applications and services. You will work closely with Product Managers, Architects, Engineers, QA, and Finance domain experts to translate complex business requirements into robust technical solutions. The ideal candidate combines strong software engineering fundamentals with experience building distributed, cloud-based enterprise applications and an understanding of financial systems and business processes.

What You Will Be Responsible For

  • Design, develop, test, deploy, and maintain highly scalable software services supporting Workday Finance capabilities
  • Own complex technical problems from requirements and architecture through implementation, production deployment, and ongoing support
  • Design and implement reliable APIs, backend services, data models, and distributed systems
  • Develop solutions supporting financial transactions, accounting, billing, revenue, reporting, and related Finance workflows
  • Ensure financial data is accurate, consistent, secure, traceable, and auditable
  • Design systems capable of handling high transaction volumes while meeting performance, availability, and reliability requirements
  • Build resilient services with appropriate handling of retries, failures, duplicate transactions, and data reconciliation
  • Participate in architecture and design reviews and influence technical direction
  • Partner with Product Management and Finance subject-matter experts to translate business requirements into effective technical designs
  • Troubleshoot complex production issues and continuously improve system reliability, performance, and observability
  • Develop automated unit, integration, and end-to-end testing
  • Contribute to CI/CD, DevOps, monitoring, logging, and operational excellence
  • Identify opportunities to simplify architecture, improve engineering processes, and reduce technical debt
  • Mentor other engineers and provide technical leadership within the team
  • Champion engineering best practices through code reviews and continuous improvement initiatives

What You Will Bring to the Position

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience
  • 7+ years of professional software engineering experience with demonstrated ownership of complex systems
  • Strong programming experience in one or more modern languages such as Java, Python, C++, Go, or similar
  • Strong understanding of object-oriented design, data structures, algorithms, and software engineering principles
  • Experience designing and developing distributed systems and scalable backend services
  • Strong experience with RESTful APIs, service-oriented or microservice architectures, and asynchronous/event-driven systems
  • Strong SQL and relational database experience
  • Experience with cloud technologies and modern software development practices
  • Experience with automated testing, CI/CD, monitoring, logging, and production support
  • Demonstrated ability to analyze complex technical problems and develop practical, scalable solutions
  • Strong communication and cross-functional collaboration skills

What Will Make You Stand Out

  • Experience developing ERP, Finance, accounting, billing, revenue, or financial management software
  • Understanding of financial concepts including General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, billing, revenue recognition, accounting periods, and financial reporting
  • Experience with high-volume transaction-processing systems
  • Experience with event-driven architectures and distributed messaging systems
  • Experience with Kubernetes, Docker, or comparable container technologies
  • Experience with AWS, Azure, GCP, or other cloud platforms
  • Experience designing multi-tenant SaaS applications
  • Familiarity with financial data reconciliation, auditability, and data-integrity requirements
  • Experience working within an enterprise SaaS environment
  • Demonstrated technical leadership and mentoring experience

What You Can Expect from DTN

  • Competitive Salary
  • Unlimited PTO
  • Flexible working hours
  • Remote work model (position dependent)
  • Competitive Medical, Dental and Vision Insurance Plans
  • 6% 401K matching
  • Unlimited access to 13k+ courses via learning platform to support employee career advancement
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP)

Compensation

The targeted hiring base pay range for this position is between $109,500 and $145,500. DTN is a pay for performance organization, which means there is the opportunity to advance your compensation with performance over time. The actual base pay offered for this position will be dependent upon many factors, including but not limited to: prior work experience, training/education, transferable skills, business needs, internal equity and applicable laws. The targeted hiring base pay range is subject to change and may be modified in the future. This role may also be eligible for market competitive variable pay and benefits.

About DTN:

DTN is a global data and technology company helping operational leaders in energy, agriculture, and weather-driven industries make faster, smarter decisions. Our Operational Decisioning Platform turns complex data into decision-grade insights—empowering customers to expand their margins, accelerate growth, and outpace risk. jobs.title: Director, Quantitative Systems Pharmacology
jobs.excerpt: At Eisai, satisfying unmet medical needs and increasing the benefits healthcare provides to patients, their families, and caregivers is Eisai’s human health care (hhc) mission.
jobs.description:
At Eisai, satisfying unmet medical needs and increasing the benefits healthcare provides to patients, their families, and caregivers is Eisai’s human health care (hhc) mission. We’re a growing pharmaceutical company that is breaking through in neurology and oncology, with a strong emphasis on research and development. Our history includes the development of many innovative medicines, notably the discovery of the world's most widely-used treatment for Alzheimer’s disease. As we continue to expand, we are seeking highly-motivated individuals who want to work in a fast-paced environment and make a difference.If this is your profile, we want to hear from you.

The Director of Quantitative Systems Pharmacology (QSP) will lead the development and implementation of mechanistic knowledge of biology integrated into mathematical models that support drug discovery and clinical development. The Director of QSP will provide scientific leadership, define QSP strategies, and collaborate across Eisai’s Deep Human Biology Learning (DHBL) project teams to translate existing knowledge and data into actionable QSP models. These models will provide functional understanding of complex nonlinear pathophysiological systems and their interactions, will allow scientists to explore system dynamics and biological hypotheses, will yield insight into responses to different pharmacological approaches to modulating biological systems, and will provide mechanistic insights to inform Eisai’s R&D decisions (for example FIH translation, dose selection, candidate selection, selection of target population, and combination strategies). This Director QSP position is essential for supporting the increasing expectations of team leaders and global regulators of applying QSP methodologies to continuously improve the conceptual and mechanistic understanding of the relations among drug exposure, efficacy, and safety.

Essential Functions:

  • Develop, implement, and apply QSP models to understand diseases, their pathways, and their progressions. Evaluate DHBL drug candidates and treatment modalities to predict their effects and optimize therapeutic strategies (e.g., the selection of target tumor types and populations), and to support clinical introduction including first-in-human dose selection.
  • Use and improve existing Neurology QSP Platforms to gain insights into the causal relationships between biological and drug-level responses, enhancing the understanding of drug-target interactions and disease mechanisms. Develop new QSP models and platforms as they are needed.
  • Lead DHBL preclinical and early clinical QSP development strategy to support optimal dose selection with simulations based on mechanistic understanding to assess efficacy and safety.
  • Advocate for model-informed drug discovery and development (MIDD) approaches. Provide scientific leadership, present research at scientific conferences, and integrate MIDD strategies into Eisai’s R&D programs to improve efficiency and decision-making.
  • Foster collaboration across functional groups and promote the development of new modeling tools and methods. Advance the adoption of QSP capabilities to improve the predictive power of these tools to support the design and optimization of drug combinations.
  • Manage the expectations/timelines of assigned M&S work for the relevant project teams.
  • Use mathematical, computational, and statistical tools to analyze and interpret large, complex data sets to gain insights into the causal relationships between drug-target interactions and disease mechanisms.
  • Provide scientific/strategic expertise across multiple therapeutic areas to support decision-making in the conversion of discovery to clinical through the design, development, and execution of quantitative mechanistic models to support the translational process.

Requirements:

  • PhD, MD-PhD and/or PharmD in Bioengineering, Systems Biology, Applied Mathematics, Computational Biology, Pharmacometrics, Chemical Engineering, Pharmaceutical Sciences, or a related quantitative discipline.
  • Deep knowledge of the principles and theoretical aspects of applied mathematical modeling, including numerical methods, ordinary differential equations (ODEs), partial differential equations (PDEs), parameter estimation/optimization, and how these tools can be applied in the development of complex biochemical models.
  • Deep expertise in quantitative systems pharmacology (QSP), mechanistic modeling, systems biology, and translational science.
  • Demonstrated experience applying QSP approaches to support drug discovery and/or clinical development programs with measurable program impact.
  • Strong understanding of pharmacology, physiology, immunology, molecular biology, and disease mechanisms.
  • Ability to learn quickly in new areas of biology and to use a solid foundation of quantitative skills to apply newly acquired knowledge to build mechanistically sound QSP models.

jobs.description:
People Business Partner, Operations, People Team (Remote)

Full-Time, Remote / Salaried, Exempt

Includes Benefits, PTO, Flexible Schedule, Equity

Steno was built on a simple idea - litigation support shouldn't be an obstacle. Since 2018, we've been delivering on that promise, growing into a business with over $90M raised, a team that continues to scale, and a multi-product platform serving thousands of law firms nationwide. We combine expert and hospitable services, proprietary data, and modern technology in a way no one else in the legal industry can.

Our Operations organization is the engine behind that promise - the team that gets depositions covered, transcripts delivered, and clients served on time, every time. This role sits on the People team as the dedicated People Business Partner to that organization, working at two altitudes at once — close enough to the front line to engage with individual contributors and coach managers through the day-to-day, and trusted enough by senior Operations leaders to be a real thought partner as their part of the business grows.

Who are you?

You're an HR Business Partner who's spent real time inside operational environments — places where the pace of the business and the people running it are tightly linked. You've coached frontline managers through hard conversations, and you've also earned the trust of senior leaders on tough people and team decisions. You're equally comfortable in both rooms.

You lead with strong HR Business Partner fundamentals — coaching, performance management, employee relations, workforce planning — and that foundation makes you a trusted advisor for leaders working through hard decisions about their team. You read people, people data, and organizational signals with equal fluency, and you use several inputs to stay ahead of problems.

You're comfortable being the connective layer between centrally designed people programs and the realities of a fast-moving business unit — translating strategy into something a frontline manager can actually use, while also being a real thought partner to senior leaders navigating tough calls. You know where your judgment ends and where something needs to be escalated, and you lead with what's effective, even when it isn't the popular call.

What you'll drive

  • Partner with Operations leaders - from senior leadership to frontline managers — on workforce and organizational planning tied to production volume, client demand, and the pace of the business
  • Coach managers, especially first-line and newer managers,on performance conversations and team dynamics, building their capability to handle these situations themselves
  • Identify people risks inside Operations early - attrition patterns, capability gaps, engagement dips — by pairing data with what you're hearing directly from the people closest to the work
  • Innovate centrally built people programs (performance cycles, comp changes, talent processes) to Operations' structure and calendar, and own execution on the ground
  • Handle employee relations matters within Operations with appropriate discretion and sound judgment on what to resolve directly versus escalate
  • Represent People, including recommended team and company procedures, at Operations' planning and leadership discussions as a standing partner
  • Feed real signal from the field back to the People team so programs get built for how Operations actually works

You'll thrive here if

  • You've spent 7+ years as an HR Business Partner, including meaningful time supporting an operational or frontline workforce
  • You've directly supported a business unit through a period of significant growth and can speak to how you handled the people side of it
  • You've coached managers through headcount planning, as well as performance and team issues, and can point to managers who got better because of you
  • You shape strategic and tactical decisions with senior leaders as a genuine thought partner, bringing your own point of view to the table
  • You're comfortable with ambiguity and can tell the difference between what needs your judgment or intervention now and what can wait
  • You bring data into people conversations — attrition, engagement, staffing trends — alongside what you're hearing directly from the people closest to the work
  • You build trust quickly with operational leaders at every level, from frontline managers to senior executives

Our Team

Operations is the largest team at Steno and the one clients feel most directly — Production, Billing, Provider Operations, Customer Success, and Scheduling all sit inside it. This role sits on the People team, reporting to the VP, People Business Partners & Operations, and partners closely with Operations leadership as the group scales.

Compensation & Benefits

  • Salary - $130,000 - $160,000
  • Health, Vision, & Dental Benefits — generous, low-cost plans for employees and their families
  • Wellness & Mental Health — shared benefits designed to support the whole person
  • Flexible Paid Time Off — trust-based and meant to be used
  • Equity options — so you share in what we're building
  • Access to a company-provided 401(k) account
  • Home office setup and a monthly stipend to offset internet and phone costs

  • Steno is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate based on any characteristics that are protected under the law. All employment decisions are based on qualifications, merit, and business needs.
  • Applicants needing special assistance or accommodations for interviews or website access should contact us at .
  • Steno personnel will always have either a steno.com email address or will contact you via Rippling Recruiting. Act with caution if asked for personal information. Background checks, for example, are only conducted after an offer is extended.

Still, we never disclose or sell your personal information.

Part-Time Consulting IGA Engineer (Entra ID Governance)
Remote | Contract (1099) | Part-Time, approximately 20 hours per week | November 1 to January 15
This is a fully remote role.

About the Role

We are looking for an experienced identity governance engineer to carry out the hands-on build of identity governance and administration capabilities in a large enterprise environment. Our lead architect owns the solution design and client relationship. You will work under that direction and handle the configuration, testing, validation, and documentation of identity lifecycle and entitlement management workflows.
This is an execution role, not a lead role, but it is client facing. You will join working sessions and status calls, answer questions about the configuration you have built, and be expected to represent the work clearly and professionally. It is well suited to a deeply technical engineer who has done this build work before and is comfortable doing it in front of a client.

Key Responsibilities

  • Perform discovery of existing identity sources, target systems, and entitlement structures, and document findings and dependencies for the architect
  • Provide input to the architect on governance design and tool configuration decisions
  • Configure identity lifecycle workflows covering joiner, mover, and leaver events
  • Build and configure entitlement management structures including access packages, catalogs, and approval policies
  • Configure access reviews and certification campaigns, including scope, reviewer assignment, and remediation handling
  • Configure Conditional Access policies aligned to lifecycle states and access risk
  • Run test cycles, then validate provisioning and deprovisioning behavior across users, groups, and service accounts
  • Produce as-built documentation and support administrator training and operational handoff

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years implementing IGA solutions in enterprise environments, including workflow build, testing, and production rollout
  • Hands-on experience with Microsoft Entra ID Governance, including identity lifecycle workflows and entitlement management
  • Detailed working knowledge of joiner, mover, and leaver event patterns and how they translate into automated workflow configuration
  • Experience configuring Conditional Access policies in an enterprise environment, including how those policies interact with lifecycle events
  • Experience configuring access reviews and certification campaigns, including scoping and remediation workflows
  • Working knowledge of on-premises Active Directory as a provisioning target in a hybrid environment, including group and account structures and directory synchronization behavior
  • Understanding of modern authentication (OIDC, SAML, Kerberos) and access control models (RBAC, PBAC, ABAC)
  • Working familiarity with Azure environments
  • Ability to author technical documentation and conduct knowledge transfer sessions
  • Comfortable on client calls, able to explain configuration decisions and status clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders

Preferred Qualifications

  • Prior work in manufacturing environments
  • Experience integrating multiple authoritative sources of identity data rather than a single HR system of record
  • Experience with SuccessFactors inbound provisioning to Entra ID
  • Experience building custom or API-based provisioning integrations for systems without a native connector
  • Experience with role modeling or entitlement rationalization
  • Experience with separation of duties controls and policy enforcement
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equivalent training, education, and work experience

Contractor Requirements

  • Hourly 1099 engagement, approximately 20 hours per week, running November 1 through January 15
  • Compensated for hours worked. Reduced or paused hours over the holiday period
  • Must be based in the United States and authorized to work without sponsorship
  • Must be able to pass a background check

At Panopto, we are the most customer-centric learning technologycompany in the world. As the leader in visual and audio-based learning, we empower organizations to share knowledge effortlessly in a capture and post-capture world. We don’t just build software; we obsess over our users’ goals to deliver solutions that truly matter. Our mission is simple: to attract the brightest talent, people like you, to Elevate the Craft and do the most impactful work of your career.

To enhance our team we are seeking an experienced Integrated Campaign Manager, Higher Education to own our demand generation strategy and campaign execution for one of our key markets.

Position Summary

You'll translate market priorities — new-logo growth, renewal defense, LMS ecosystem positioning — into campaign narratives, then run the cross-functional work that brings them to market: messaging with Product Marketing, paid media with our agency partner, outbound sequencing with SDR, and reporting that ties activity to pipeline and win rate.

Working alongside Product Marketing, Events, SDR, Marketing Operations, and our EMEA/APAC Campaign Manager, you'll set the plan and write the brief, then build the email program, brief the landing page, and pull the funnel numbers yourself.

You’ll also have opportunities to contribute to other initiatives that directly advance our core values and help you elevate your craft.

How You’ll Contribute

In this role, you will:

  • Own annual and quarterly campaign planning for the Higher Education vertical, aligning campaign priorities to new-logo, renewal, and expansion goals.

  • Map buyer evaluation paths by role and identify gaps in messaging, content, and offers; prioritize campaign assets based on expected pipeline impact.

  • Translate competitive dynamics, procurement considerations, and changing Higher Education buying patterns into campaign narratives, timing, and messaging.

  • Develop audience and messaging plans by buyer role in partnership with Product Marketing.

  • Plan, launch, optimize, and report on integrated campaigns across email, webinars, paid media, and digital channels.

  • Write and edit campaign copy for email programs, landing pages, webinar promotions, and related campaign assets.

  • Build and manage campaigns in HubSpot or a comparable marketing automation platform, including segmentation, workflows, and reporting setup.

  • Coordinate with paid media agency partners on Higher Education campaign themes, audience targeting, and performance reviews.

  • Align campaign timing and messaging with SDR outbound sequencing and connect campaign engagement to qualified pipeline.

  • Partner with Events on conferences, field events, and webinar programs and incorporate event pipeline into vertical performance reporting.

  • Partner with Marketing Operations on lead flow, scoring, attribution, and campaign measurement.

  • Represent Higher Education campaign strategy and performance in marketing planning sessions and quarterly business reviews.

  • Partner with the EMEA/APAC Campaign Manager to adapt strategy and messaging for regional buying cycles and procurement norms.

  • Own the campaign scorecard for the vertical, including sourced and influenced pipeline, MQL-to-SQO conversion, win-rate impact, and channel efficiency; define success measures before launch and recommend changes based on funnel performance.

  • Use generative AI tools to accelerate account and persona research, campaign drafting, and synthesis of SDR and win/loss insights; build repeatable prompts and workflows for recurring campaign activities.

What Success Looks Like

  • Within 3 Months: Launch your first original, gap-analysis-driven Higher Ed campaign and deliver the initial quarterly pipeline and conversion scorecard to leadership.

  • Within 6 Months:Optimize multi-channel campaign performance using scorecard insights, refining messaging and budget allocation to measurably improve pipeline velocity and funnel conversion.

  • Within 1 Year: Own the end-to-end Higher Ed campaign strategy and execution, consistently delivering against annual vertical pipeline, win-rate, and ROI targets.

Values in Action

  • Customer First, Always: You proactively surface friction points in the customer experience before they are escalated — and propose solutions, not just reports.

  • Thrive Together: You share work-in-progress for early feedback, knowing that challenge improves the outcome. You separate critiques of ideas from critiques of people.

  • Elevate the Craft: You hold the bar high on your own work and invest in developing those around you. You treat every project as an opportunity to learn something new.

  • Act with Ownership: You define success by outcomes, not activity. You flag problems early and bring a proposed path forward, not just the problem.

  • Clarity Over Complexity: You default to the simpler solution. Your written communication — internal or external — is direct, specific, and free of filler.

How We Thrive

You’ll join Panopto’s Demand Generation team, a group of results-driven marketers focused on creating measurable impact through smart, creative, and data-informed programs.

The team partners closely with Product Marketing, Sales, and Marketing Operations to design campaigns that connect Panopto’s unique value with the needs of our audiences in the corporate and higher education markets.

We value curiosity, accountability, and collaboration — and we believe in challenging ideas, not people. You’ll have the autonomy to own your campaigns from strategy to reporting, while being supported by a team that shares ideas freely and celebrates collective success.

The Foundation for Success

  • Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, or a related field, or equivalent years of experience.

  • 5+ years in campaign or demand generation roles at a B2B SaaS company, with direct ownership of a market segment or vertical.

  • Experience running multi-channel campaigns end to end: strategy, copy, execution, reporting.

  • Hands-on experience with HubSpot or a comparable marketing automation platform, and with Salesforce or a comparable CRM.

  • Comfortable moving between a quarter's campaign calendar and the email that goes out Tuesday.

  • Experience tracking campaign performance against pipeline and revenue metrics, and presenting that data to stakeholders outside marketing.

  • Strong project management skills; runs multiple campaigns at once without dropping a deadline.

  • Hands-on experience using AI tools for research, drafting, or workflow automation, with a specific example to walk through.

What Sets You Apart

  • Experience marketing to higher education or another committee-driven, cycle-bound buying market.

  • Experience running campaigns against an entrenched incumbent, where the sale is displacement, not greenfield.

  • Familiarity with LMS ecosystems (Canvas, Blackboard, Moodle) and how they shape a buyer's evaluation.

Join Us

Join Panopto and play a key role in shaping the security foundation of a platform used by millions. If you love threat modeling, automating defenses, guiding engineering teams, and turning compliance standards into practical, scalable security practices, you’ll feel right at home here.

Beyond the Requirements: At this point, we hope you're feeling excited about the job description you’re reading. Even if you don't feel that you meet every single requirement, we still encourage you to apply. We're eager to meet people that believe in our mission and can contribute to our team in a variety of ways - not just candidates who check all the boxes. We want people to feel comfortable expressing their true selves and to come, stay, and do their best work here.

Recruiting Tips: From crafting an impressive resume to presenting your best self during our interviews, we're dedicated to ensuring you feel well-prepared and self-assured as you embark on opportunities at Panopto. Discover some valuableRecruiting Tipsfrom our team.

Application Review -> Recruiter Call -> Video Interview & Assessment -> Hiring Manager Call -> Interview Loop -> Debrief -> Offer

Our people and culture

Panopto’s mission is to be the leader in visual and audio-based learning in a capture and post-capture world. Our user base is as diverse as the world’s universities and businesses. Panopto’s commitment to fostering a fair, equitable, and inclusive culture empowers each member of our team to express their authentic selves, contribute their distinct perspectives and make a meaningful impact both individually and collectively. This inclusive environment not only encourages creativity and the free exchange of ideas but also harnesses the power of varied viewpoints. As a result, we are better equipped to tackle our most intricate challenges, leveraging the wealth of different experiences and backgrounds within our team. This collaborative spirit empowers us to challenge ideas (not people) recognizing that our shared success relies on collective wisdom. It drives us to continuously improve and innovate, ultimately elevating the quality of our products and services. It’s what sets Panopto apart as a unique and rewarding place to work.

Our purpose

We believe that video can have a transformative effect on learning. So we built a video knowledge management platform that helps businesses and universities improve the way that they train, teach, and share knowledge. Since 2007, we have been a pioneer in video capture software, video management, and inside-video-search technology. Panopto has been adopted by more than 1,600 companies and universities worldwide with over 11 million end users. Today, Panopto’s knowledge management platform is the largest repository of expert learning videos in the world. A proud remote-first company, Panopto is headquartered in Pittsburgh, with offices in London, Hong Kong, Singapore, and Sydney, and has received industry recognition for its innovation, rapid growth, and company culture.

Please be assured that AI tools are used to support our team, and all final hiring decisions are made by human reviewers. Panopto hiring teams will thoroughly review your application and assessment results. AI is not used to make final decisions regarding your candidacy.

jobs.title: Sales Development Representative, Group Sales (Canada- Remote)
jobs.excerpt: Adventure is our Culture.  Join a team that celebrates a lifestyle as bold as the terrain we love.
jobs.description:
Adventure is our Culture. Join a team that celebrates a lifestyle as bold as the terrain we love. At Backcountry, we are rooted in adventure, recognition, and wellbeing on and off the mountain. We spotlight employee stories, celebrate milestones, and offer exclusive outdoor perks. Whether you are at HQ, in a retail store, or remote, you will be part of a team that thrives on energy, exploration, and connection.

Reports to: Head of Group Sales

Location: Remote (US or Canada)

About the Role

    Backcountry Group Sales connects our brands to the business community, serving corporate, medical, university, military, construction, hospitality, and other industry groups. This B2B program is growing and needs a driven, outbound-focused rep to build pipeline and fuel that growth.

    As Sales Development Representative, Group Sales, you will own the top of the funnel — prospecting, outreach, and qualification — running outbound campaigns across email, phone, and LinkedIn to identify and engage prospective group accounts. This role is a proven path into Account Management: reps who master outbound prospecting and consistently deliver qualified pipeline are the first considered as Account Manager openings come up.

    This is a lean team. You will own a lot, move fast, and make decisions with full end-to-end responsibility.

What You'll Do

  • Generate pipeline through outbound email, phone outreach, and LinkedIn prospecting into target verticals such as military, construction, hospitality, and enterprise accounts
  • Build and run repeatable outbound campaigns — sequences, messaging, and cadences — to consistently fill the top of the funnel
  • Qualify inbound and outbound leads by understanding the prospect's needs and buying process
  • Hand off qualified opportunities to an Account Manager with clean, complete context for a smooth close
  • Meet or exceed monthly and quarterly pipeline and activity targets
  • Build and maintain accurate records of all prospects and outreach activity in the CRM (Pipedrive)
  • Use tools like Apollo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, and NetSuite to research, prospect, and track accounts
  • Participate in ongoing procedural and sales training sessions to sharpen outbound skills and stay current on product knowledge
  • Represent Backcountry values in every prospect interaction and internal handoff

Required Qualifications

  • A minimum of 1 year of outbound selling experience
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills
  • Comfort making high volumes of outbound calls and emails, and staying motivated through repetitive prospecting work
  • Creativity in how you approach outreach — you don't rely on the same script
  • General understanding of B2B buying processes and outbound principles
  • Comfort with CRM and sales tech (Pipedrive, Apollo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, or similar)
  • Coachable — open to feedback and eager to improve
  • Flexible across time zones — this role can be worked from any US or Canadian time zone

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in B2B, group, or corporate sales
  • ABM or lead generation experience
  • Experience with a sales methodology (Sandler, MEDDIC, SPIN, GAP)
  • Background in tech or outdoor industries
  • Interest in growing into an Account Manager role over time

Why Join

    The people who do best here are builders. They take ownership, move fast, and want to see the direct impact of their work.

  • Clear Growth Path: This role is the on-ramp to Account Management — your outbound results are your promotion case.
  • Training and Development: Structured sales training and hands-on coaching from your manager accelerate your outbound craft.
  • Trusted From Day One: You own your pipeline and outreach strategy, with your work directly fueling revenue growth across Account Management and marketing.
  • Competitive Benefits (US): Paid time off policies, 401(k) match, medical/dental/vision and a variety of supplemental policies, and employee discounts across our portfolio of brands.
  • Competitive Benefits (Canada): Paid time off policies, RRSP match, medical, dental, and vision coverage, a variety of supplemental benefit options, and employee discounts across our portfolio of brands.

Interview Process

    1. Recruiter Screen - A 30-minute conversation with our recruiting team to align on the role, your background, and what you are looking for.
    2. Hiring Manager Interview - A 30-minute video conversation with the Head of Group Sales, including a short assessment where you will walk through a campaign you have run and its results.
    3. In-Person Interview - We'd like to meet you. Details and logistics will be arranged with your recruiter.
    4. Reference Checks - Conducted in parallel with the final stages where possible.
    5. Offer - We move quickly for the right candidate.

    Interview process is subject to change. Any updates will be communicated promptly and clearly.

Please Note

  • Part of our interview process is a mandatory in-person interview with someone on our team prior to an offer. Candidates that are unwilling or unable to meet for an in-person interview will be removed from consideration immediately.

CSC Generation will conduct an exhaustive background check including verifying dates of employment directly with your former employer.

jobs.excerpt: Job Title: Full Stack Developer (AI-First) Department: Engineering Reports To: Engineering Lead Location: Remote, CST Compensation: Competitive salary based on experience About Us:We are a fast-growing, high-performance agency operating at the intersection of eCommerce, Amazon, growth, systems, and AI.
jobs.description:
Job Title: Full Stack Developer (AI-First)
Department: Engineering
Reports To: Engineering Lead
Location: Remote, CST
Compensation: Competitive salary based on experience

About Us:

We are a fast-growing, high-performance agency operating at the intersection of eCommerce, Amazon, growth, systems, and AI. Our team helps ambitious brands scale, and were increasingly focused on building internal tools, automation layers, intelligence systems, and AI-powered products that drastically improve business operations. We are not interested in using AI in a superficial way—were creating an AI-native agency model where intelligent systems enhance internal workflows, data visibility, decision-making, execution speed, and product capabilities.

This Role Is NOT For You If:

  • Youre satisfied with maintaining old workflows or outdated methods.
  • You dont think about the future of AI and emerging tools.
  • You struggle to quickly learn new tools and technologies.
  • You prefer working in slow-moving, non-agile environments.
  • You dont enjoy building scalable, high-performance software.

This Role IS For You If:

  • Youre passionate about AI and building intelligent systems that drive real business impact.
  • Youre a builder who thrives on experimenting with new technologies and pushing boundaries.
  • Youre fluent in both frontend and backend development and excited by full-stack engineering.
  • You think in terms of leverage: automating processes, making workflows smarter, and using AI to increase output and decision-making.
  • You are a self-starter who takes ownership, moves fast, and is excited to work in a fast-paced, high-agency environment.

What Success Looks Like:

In your first 90 days, you will:

  • Build Scalable Systems: Develop modern full-stack applications, covering frontend, backend, databases, and infrastructure.
  • Integrate AI: Use Claude Code and other AI tools to drive faster development and smarter workflows.
  • Prototype New Ideas: Experiment with new products and features, quickly prototyping and refining the best ideas into production systems.
  • Automate Workflows: Develop AI-first workflows and automation tools to eliminate repetitive tasks.
  • Collaborate with Leadership: Work closely with leadership to identify high-leverage areas where AI and software can have the biggest impact.

Your Responsibilities:

1. Full Stack Development

  • Frontend Development: Build modern, scalable front-end applications using frameworks like React, Next.js, and TypeScript.
  • Backend Development: Develop backend systems with Node.js, Python, and scalable system designs.
  • System Design: Design and implement APIs, databases, and cloud infrastructure to power applications.

2. AI Integration

  • Claude Code Utilization: Use Claude Code extensively to speed up software development, including building, debugging, refactoring, and exploring architecture.
  • AI-First Tools: Build AI-powered utilities and tools that integrate seamlessly into business processes.

3. Product and System Innovation

  • Automation: Automate internal processes, including data workflows, and build agent-based systems to reduce manual work.
  • AI Copilots: Create AI assistants and intelligent interfaces that help internal and external users improve productivity.
  • Prototyping: Rapidly prototype new product ideas and features, then refine the most promising ones into production-ready systems.

4. Collaboration & Experimentation

  • Leadership Collaboration: Partner with leadership to identify opportunities where AI and software can create leverage and deliver value.
  • Tool and Model Experimentation: Stay on the cutting edge by experimenting with new AI models, tools, and frameworks.

What Were Looking For:

Required Skills & Traits:

  • Strong experience as a Full Stack Developer.
  • Experience with modern frontend tools like React, Next.js, TypeScript, or similar.
  • Strong backend experience using Node.js, Python, APIs, databases, and scalable system design.
  • Proficiency with Claude Code for building, debugging, and optimizing software.
  • A genuine obsession with AI, emerging tools, and the future of software development.
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to work effectively in a fast-moving team.
  • Ability to move quickly, take ownership, and solve complex problems with minimal direction.

Nice to Have:

  • Experience with OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, or open-source models.
  • Familiarity with building agent frameworks, RAG, vector databases, or tool-calling systems.
  • Experience building internal platforms, analytics systems, or automation tools.
  • Startup or high-performance agency experience.
  • Experience shipping software quickly while maintaining high engineering standards.

Why This Role Is Different:

This is not a maintenance role. Its not for someone comfortable with slow-moving corporate environments or traditional development. This role is for someone who wants to help shape the future of an ambitious, AI-first company and play a key part in developing the products that come out of it. Youll have room to experiment, push ideas forward, and help define how AI truly integrates into a business with real momentum.

Application Process:

  1. Submit Your Application: Send your resume and a brief cover letter detailing your relevant experience.

  2. Assessment: If shortlisted, complete an assessment to showcase your technical skills and ability to think strategically.
  3. Interview: Candidates will go through 1-2 rounds of interviews to evaluate your full-stack development expertise, AI fluency, and problem-solving approach.

Ready to Shape the Future? Apply Now!

We are an equal opportunity employer and celebrate diversity in our workforce.

jobs.title: National Real Estate Practice Leader
jobs.excerpt: The National Real Estate Practice Leader is responsible for advancing IMA’s national presence, growth, and expertise across the real estate industry.
jobs.description:
The National Real Estate Practice Leader is responsible for advancing IMA’s national presence, growth, and expertise across the real estate industry. This leader brings deep knowledge of real estate risks, sophisticated carrier and market relationships, and a strategic mindset oriented around complex property portfolios, development activity, and evolving economic and regulatory conditions. The leader serves as a highly visible resource across geographies and builds a durable practice capability that markets, producers, service teams, and clients can use across IMA.

Essential Responsibilities:

Growth, Production & Market Impact

  • Drive national new business growth across priority real estate sectors, which may include multifamily, affordable housing, commercial office, industrial and logistics, retail, mixed-use, hospitality, development, and property management.
  • Actively support producers on complex real estate opportunities, including strategy, program structure, property and catastrophe risk, valuation, builder’s risk, casualty, environmental risk, cyber, management liability, claims, and alternative risk considerations.
  • Provide direct involvement on high-value pursuits, including complex portfolios, catastrophe-exposed assets, development projects, and organizations with sophisticated risk financing needs.
  • Participate in internal business reviews, prospect meetings, client presentations, and RFP responses, representing IMA’s national real estate expertise.
  • Bring forward timely insights on real estate, capital markets, insurance conditions, regulatory developments, climate risk, construction costs, and economic trends, and apply them to client and growth strategy.

Real Estate Specialty Strategy & National Alignment

  • Develop and execute the national strategic plan for the Real Estate Practice, ensuring alignment with IMA’s enterprise growth priorities.
  • Establish a clear point of view on priority client segments, geographic opportunities, differentiation, investment needs, and where the practice can win.
  • Partner with market and sales leaders to translate opportunity into focused plans with outcomes, owners, milestones, talent needs, service needs, and resource requirements.
  • Align service standards, technical expectations, and client delivery models across participating IMA markets to support a consistent client experience.
  • Assess the current state of the practice and recommend where to scale, strengthen, incubate, maintain, partner, or stop.

Carrier, Market & Industry Relationships

  • Build and maintain deep relationships with property and casualty carriers, wholesale and program partners, alternative risk providers, and other markets relevant to real estate clients.
  • Strengthen market access and carrier alignment for complex portfolios, catastrophe-exposed assets, development projects, and difficult or specialized risks.
  • Build trusted relationships with real estate associations, centers of influence, lenders, capital partners, and other industry stakeholders.
  • Collaborate with carrier and external partners to bring useful market intelligence, benchmarking, risk insights, and new solutions to IMA’s clients and internal teams.
  • Represent IMA in relevant real estate forums and bring emerging client needs, market changes, and partnership opportunities back into the organization.

Talent Development & Capability Building

  • Define the production, service, technical, analytics, claims, risk control, and leadership capabilities required for the practice to succeed.
  • Actively support specialty recruiting by identifying talent pools, target organizations, role profiles, and high-potential candidates, and by participating in interviews and selection.
  • Partner with Market Presidents and business leaders on onboarding, deployment, development, promotion, and retention of real estate talent.
  • Mentor and develop real estate-specialized talent across production, account management, technical placement, analytics, claims, and risk control.
  • Build a sustainable national bench of real estate experts and future leaders, with deliberate development and succession planning.
  • Reduce reliance on any one individual or market by converting expertise into repeatable solutions, playbooks, tools, training, service standards, and delivery models.

Collaboration, Growth Enablement & Internal Integration

  • Serve as a consultative growth partner to Market Presidents, Commercial Lines leaders, sales leaders, producers, and client teams.
  • Engage early in strategic prospects, complex client needs, and major opportunities to pressure-test assumptions, shape pursuit strategy, and connect the right expertise and resources.
  • Increase producer confidence and effectiveness through real estate insight, practical coaching, relationship support, and clear access to practice resources.
  • Lead national practice calls and cross-market collaboration, promoting knowledge sharing and the transfer of proven approaches across IMA.
  • Partner with Marketing on focused thought leadership, events, association involvement, and market-facing content aligned with practice strategy.
  • Help markets replicate proven growth plays while adapting them to local asset classes, relationships, talent, and execution realities.

Performance, Accountability & Enterprise Leadership

  • Establish meaningful goals and expectations for growth, talent, capability, client value, activity, and execution.
  • Maintain a regular review cadence with market and enterprise stakeholders, surface risks and barriers early, and recommend adjustments based on evidence.
  • Create shared accountability across specialty, market, sales, and service leadership by clarifying ownership, milestones, resource needs, and decision points.
  • Represent the practice in enterprise planning and provide an objective view of opportunity, capacity, performance, and investment needs.
  • Measure success through the capability and results of the practice, not simply the individual activity of the Practice Leader.

Required Experience & Skills

  • Extensive real estate-related brokerage, underwriting, risk management, consulting, or adjacent experience, with strong technical knowledge of real estate exposures and insurance solutions.
  • Demonstrated credibility across relevant real estate sectors, client operating models, risk exposures, insurance markets, and competitive dynamics.
  • Experience supporting complex real estate portfolios, sophisticated placements, development projects, strategic pursuits, or industry-specific solutions.
  • Strong knowledge of property and catastrophe risk, valuation, builder’s risk, complex casualty, contractual risk transfer, claims, and alternative risk considerations.
  • Demonstrated ability to build senior-level relationships with real estate executives, clients, carrier leaders, associations, centers of influence, and strategic partners.
  • Proven ability to lead through influence across markets, functions, and reporting lines.
  • Experience recruiting, developing, mentoring, or deploying specialized talent.
  • Ability to convert technical knowledge into practical solutions, clear communication, scalable tools, and measurable growth or client value.

Competencies

  • Real Estate Industry and Business Acumen
  • Strategic Leadership and Commercial Judgment
  • Capability Building and Talent Development
  • Market Partnership and Growth Enablement
  • Relationship Building with Real Estate Executives, Carriers, and Industry Partners
  • Complex Client and Pursuit Leadership
  • Enterprise Collaboration and Shared Accountability
  • Effective Communication and Executive Presence
  • Execution Discipline and Follow-Through

$250,000—$350,000 USD

Being a part of IMA has its benefits. Our plans are cost-effective, convenient and provide progressive ways for staying healthy, protecting loved ones, pursuing financial security and living a full and balanced life.
