jobs.excerpt: As the most trusted global leader in data-first contract lifecycle management (CLM) software, Agiloft helps organizations manage the end-to-end process of proposing, negotiating, signing, and leveraging contracts using our flexible Data-first Agreement Platform (DAP).
jobs.description:
As the most trusted global leader in data-first contract lifecycle management (CLM) software, Agiloft helps organizations manage the end-to-end process of proposing, negotiating, signing, and leveraging contracts using our flexible Data-first Agreement Platform (DAP). With contract data as the foundation, customers quickly and collaboratively reach agreement and leverage contract visibility to thrive with competitive advantage. Employing powerful, pragmatic artificial intelligence as a legal force multiplier, and robust integration capabilities as a data liberator, organizations around the world trust Agiloft’s certified implementers to deliver connected, intelligent, and autonomous solutions across the entire contract lifecycle.
Top analysts like Gartner, Forrester, and IDC agree, all showing Agiloft as a leader in the CLM space. Our no code platform is easily managed and administered by business users, which is why Agiloft is the contract you keep: nearly a full 100% of new customers are satisfied with their initial implementations, and some 97% of customers renew every year. Ours is a growing, vibrant, successful company that is at the forefront of a market that is becoming a must-have for all organizations.
We believe that the way to build the strongest, most vibrant place to work is to bring in individuals from all walks of life, and to support them in bringing their authentic selves to their day, every day. Our working philosophy is that “EX = CX”: when employee experience is excellent, so is customer experience. We support multiple Employee Resource Groups (ERGs), and offer a working environment that supports healthy work/life balance, including floating holidays and a quarterly, no-questions-asked wellness day.

Position Overview

This is a foundational engineering role. You will own a critical domain of the platform on which Agiloft's CLM product is built as one of a small team of staff engineers who each own a core part of the platform and shape its direction together. This is a backend- and distributed-systems–weighted position with deep ownership of your domain and end-to-end accountability for its design, scalability, reliability, and security as the product and customer base grow.

You will work across the organization with engineering leaders, senior engineers, product leaders, and partner teams to understand where the product is going, translate business and product goals into durable platform architectures, and align diverse stakeholders on the technical direction. This means, you will set architectural direction alongside a peer group of staff engineers of your caliber. This is a hands-on leadership role that combines deep backend and cloud expertise with the influence to drive architecture across functional boundaries.

Job Responsibilities

    DATA MODEL & PLATFORM ARCHITECTURE

  • Own the canonical data models and service boundaries in your domain
  • Design models and boundaries that let independent systems evolve in parallel without duplicating logic or creating competing implementations
  • Evolve the platform through additive, backward-compatible changes that introduce new capabilities without disrupting existing behavior.
  • Own the architecture of one or more critical platform domains, with responsibility for design integrity, scalability, reliability, security, and long-term technical health.

    • DISTRIBUTED SYSTEMS & CLOUD ARCHITECTURE (AWS)

  • Design AWS-native, event-driven and asynchronous services that scale on demand, degrade gracefully under load, and remain cost-efficient as volume grows.
  • Architect the backend to enable and support AI/ML workloads at scale with a focus on performance, scalability and cost efficiency.
  • Act as architectural steward for these services, keeping them scalable, resilient, secure, and maintainable as customer and platform demands grow.
  • Drive cloud-native design principles: stateless services, managed-service adoption, and failure-tolerant, self-healing architectures.

    • SECURITY & MULTI-TENANCY

  • Treat tenant isolation, authentication, and authorization as first-class design concerns across every service and API you own.
  • Design secure authentication and token-handling flows, permission-aware data access, and safe credential management for an enterprise, multi-tenant platform.
  • Design for correct, isolated behavior across tenant, environment, and data-residency boundaries, and reason explicitly about security posture and blast radius when centralizing sensitive capabilities.

    • TECHNICAL LEADERSHIP & CROSS-FUNCTIONAL INFLUENCE

  • Partner with product- and engineering leaders to develop a deep understanding of customer and business needs and translate them into platform architectures that solve the problem
  • Lead the technical design of major platform initiatives end to end, and drive alignment across teams and functions whose priorities and incentives do not always converge.
  • Integrate diverse stakeholders and project teams around a shared technical direction, navigating differing functional interests with sound judgment and strong interpersonal skill.
  • Produce clear, rigorous design documents, service contracts, and acceptance criteria that others can review, build on, and trust, setting the standard for technical design on the team.
  • Use AI-assisted tools to accelerate and sharpen design and implementation, applying the judgment to know where they add leverage and where deeper thinking is required.
  • Lead by example in applying AI-assisted engineering tools to accelerate architecture, design, implementation, and testing, using sound technical judgment to amplify productivity without compromising quality, maintainability, or depth of thinking.

    • API DESIGN

  • Design clean, versioned API contracts on top of the platform's data models — including high-scale bulk and asynchronous operations — with deterministic behavior, idempotency, structured error handling, and well-defined limits.
  • Establish contract tests and permission-enforcement validation as first-class parts of every API you design.

    • DELIVERY & ENGINEERING EXCELLENCE

  • Own initiatives end to end from design through release, with accountability for product quality in your domain and high standards for reliability, security, observability, performance, scalability, usability, and cost across the services you own
  • Champion modern practices: infrastructure-as-code, automated testing, continuous delivery, and observability-by-default
  • Lead platform-modernization and refactoring initiatives while maintaining delivery velocity and improve the developer experience for the services you own.
  • Identify and drive improvements to how the engineering organization designs and delivers
  • Contribute across the stack when an initiative calls for it, including UI layers on top of the platform services you build; backend remains the primary focus.

    • ORGANIZATIONAL IMPACT & MENTORSHIP

  • Serve as a technical multiplier unblocking teams, accelerating architectural decisions, and reducing long-term complexity.
  • Partner with CloudOps, Security, MLOps, and integration teams to define reliability targets, operational-readiness standards, and clean interfaces between domains.
  • Mentor senior and mid-level engineers, raising the bar for data-model and systems design, security, and design-document quality.
  • Stay ahead of a fast-moving industry, particularly the rapid evolution of AI capabilities, and drive pragmatic adoption where it delivers clear business value.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's and/or master's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Software or Electrical/Electronics Engineering, or a comparable field.
  • 8+ years of professional software engineering experience, including 2+ years at staff level.
  • Demonstrated leadership of architecture decisions spanning multiple teams with concrete examples of driving cross-team technical direction to a decision.
  • Proven ability to drive technical outcomes across diverse stakeholders and teams that report into different functions, aligning divergent interests without direct authority.
  • Track record of owning significant initiatives end to end, including release ownership.
  • Strong proficiency in Python (working experience in Java a plus), building backend and cloud-based services.
  • Deep experience designing, building, and operating scalable, enterprise-grade distributed systems on AWS.
  • Strong data-modeling and service-architecture skills, with a track record of building durable, reusable abstractions that other teams adopt and extend without rework.
  • Experience designing backend systems that enable demanding workloads wih high-throughput data pipelines, asynchronous processing, or ML/inference services at scale and with cost-efficiently.
  • Solid grounding in application security and multi-tenancy: authentication/authorization, token handling, tenant isolation, and permission-aware data access.
  • Experience designing high-scale API contracts
  • Strong experience with infrastructure-as-code and CI/CD for cloud services.
  • Strong understanding of observability in distributed systems: logging, metrics, tracing, and alerting.
  • A demonstrated habit of staying current with rapidly evolving AI capabilities and integrating them into how you work and design.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication in English

Preferred Qualifications

    Additional Experience (a plus)

  • Building services that support AI/ML product features and data pipelines
  • Integrating third-party SaaS platforms and connectors with attention to security and reliability.
  • Search and retrieval systems
  • Domain familiarity with CLM, contracts, or comparable enterprise B2B platforms.

Background checks will be conducted on an ongoing basis every 3 years or as needed for individuals in this role.

jobs.description:
Anticipated Contract End Date/Length: May 7, 2027
Work Setup: Remote
Clearance Required: BPSS and Right to Work in the UK

Our client in the Information Technology and Services industry is looking for a S/4HANA – Coupa Integration Architect (Indirect Procurement) with proven experience delivering global integrations between Coupa and SAP S/4HANA for complex organisations, from design through cutover and Hypercare. The role requires strong expertise in API engineering, SAP integration artefacts, Coupa integration configuration, and procurement processes across P2P and AP.

Work closely with Business and IT stakeholders, upstream and downstream products, and third-party providers to deliver secure, scalable, and reliable integration solutions. Apply an agile, outcomes-focused approach while managing complex integration work efforts, dependencies, and environment strategies across multiple delivery waves.

What you will do:

  • Design and deliver global integrations between Coupa and SAP S/4HANA for complex organisations, from design through cutover and Hypercare.
  • Build and manage APIs using REST/JSON and OData, including schema design, error handling, and performance tuning.
  • Configure and manage Coupa integrations covering supplier and ERP integrations, master data synchronisation, COA/segments, approvals, tax, receiving, invoicing, and payment status updates.
  • Apply SAP S/4HANA Procurement/MM and FI-AP objects and processes, including vendors/business partners, purchasing organisations, POs, service entry sheets, GRs, invoices, GL/CC/WBS, and tax determination.
  • Design and support integration solutions using platforms such as SAP Integration Suite/CPI, MuleSoft, Dell Boomi, or Azure Integration Services.
  • Implement integration security, monitoring, observability, and CI/CD practices across middleware platforms.
  • Manage API specifications using OpenAPI/Swagger and perform API testing with Postman.
  • Configure and support SAP integration artefacts, including IDoc types for vendors, POs, GRs, and invoices, as well as BAPI/RFC, ALE, and OData services.
  • Configure Coupa master data imports and exports, suppliers, COA, transactional flows, SFTP/API integrations, and file formats.
  • Implement security controls using OAuth2, mTLS, certificates, key management, and data protection practices.
  • Establish monitoring and observability using CPI/MuleSoft dashboards, Splunk, App Insights, alerting, and trace correlation.
  • Implement CI/CD practices for integrations using Git, branching, versioning, and automated deployment.
  • Plan and manage large integration work efforts, dependencies, and environment strategies across multiple delivery waves.
  • Coordinate with upstream and downstream products, including MDG and ServiceNow, and third-party providers.
  • Manage stakeholder discussions and communicate complex integration concepts to cross-functional Business and IT audiences.
  • Support project delivery using tools and ALM platforms such as JIRA, Azure DevOps, Smartsheet, and SolMan.
  • Apply test automation practices for integration interfaces.
  • Manage integration impacts across both Indirect and Direct Procurement process flows, P2P, and AP.
  • Drive integration outcomes in ambiguous environments while challenging the status quo and maintaining a focus on delivery quality.
  • Proven experience delivering global Coupa and SAP S/4HANA integrations for complex organisations, covering design, implementation, cutover, and Hypercare.
  • Strong hands-on proficiency with REST/JSON, OData, API engineering, schema design, error handling, and performance tuning.
  • Extensive knowledge of Coupa configuration for supplier and ERP integrations, master data synchronisation, transactional flows, approvals, tax, receiving, invoicing, and payment status updates.
  • Strong understanding of SAP S/4HANA Procurement/MM and FI-AP objects and processes, including vendors/business partners, purchasing organisations, POs, service entry sheets, GRs, invoices, GL/CC/WBS, and tax determination.
  • Experience with SAP Integration Suite/CPI, MuleSoft, Dell Boomi, Azure Integration Services, or comparable integration middleware platforms.
  • Hands-on experience with OpenAPI/Swagger specifications and Postman-based API testing.
  • Practical knowledge of SAP IDocs, BAPI/RFC, ALE, and OData services, including IDoc types for vendor, PO, GR, and invoice processes.
  • Experience configuring Coupa master data imports/exports, suppliers, COA, SFTP/API integrations, file formats, and transactional flows.
  • Strong understanding of OAuth2, mTLS, certificates, key management, and data protection requirements.
  • Experience with integration monitoring and observability tools such as CPI/MuleSoft dashboards, Splunk, App Insights, alerting, and trace correlation.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD practices for integrations, including Git, branching, versioning, and automated deployment.
  • Understanding of both Indirect and Direct Procurement process flows and their data impacts across P2P and AP.
  • Experience working with upstream and downstream products such as MDG and ServiceNow, as well as third-party providers.
  • Familiarity with JIRA, Azure DevOps, Smartsheet, SolMan, and other project or ALM tools.
  • Experience with test automation for integration interfaces.
  • Ability to plan and manage complex integration work efforts, dependencies, and environment strategies across multiple delivery waves.
  • Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex integration concepts to cross-functional Business and IT audiences.
  • Self-motivated and able to prioritise effectively while meeting challenging deadlines.
  • Credible, resilient, and comfortable working with ambiguity and challenging the status quo to achieve the best integration outcomes.
  • Agile and outcomes-focused approach to integration delivery.

DigiCert is a global leader in intelligent trust. We protect the digital world by ensuring the security, privacy, and authenticity of every interaction. DigiCert is building trust infrastructure for the modern Internet; and DNS is central to that mission. You will work closely with engineering, architecture, security, product marketing, sales, and customers to define the product vision, validate use cases, shape requirements, and bring new capabilities to market. jobs.description:
Who Are We?

Thanx is a leading loyalty and guest engagement platform for regional and national restaurants. We help brands drive profitable growth by increasing guest frequency, growing digital sales, and reducing reliance on discounts. Most loyalty platforms work for guests who are already loyal. Thanx unifies loyalty, digital ordering, and marketing automation in one platform that turns first-time and casual guests into regulars, treating loyalty as a business outcome, not a program, and engaging across the entire guest base.

Thanx has raised more than $30M from elite investors including M33 Growth, Ribbit Capital, and Sequoia Capital. Our success is rooted in a culture that has attracted some of the best talent in the country, and we are proud of strong employee tenure, a track record of internal promotions, and the company-wide shift to working AI-native over the last 18 months. We credit our cultural “core behaviors” with these accomplishments: Think Boldly, Execute Reliably, Focus on What Matters, Say “Thanx” Genuinely, Encourage Diverse Perspectives, and Lead, Virtually.

Who are you?

You’re a strategist first. You set the direction for a brand relationship and can navigate a large, complex organization to build real relationships with senior leaders. You’re self-motivated and decisive: you don’t wait for a perfect plan or someone’s permission to move, and you know which problems are worth running at. You direct cross-functional teams like a business owner, not a project manager.

You use AI daily to work faster and think sharper, not just to grind through busywork. You’re direct, you’re a team player, and you’re ready to own outcomes for the brands that matter most to our business.

You've spent enough time on complex enterprise accounts to know how these relationships actually work: where a renewal is really won and what a CFO will push back on. You operate without a lot of direction, hold a point of view in front of senior stakeholders, and figure things out when the path is not obvious.

Everyone at Thanx has equity and is expected to operate like an owner. That means real intensity, including evenings and weekends when the work calls for it. If that isn't what you're looking for right now, this isn't the right role. We would rather you know that before you apply than after you start.

Position overview

As Enterprise Customer Success Manager, you'll own the strategy for a portfolio of Thanx's largest and most strategic restaurant brands. These are the accounts where getting it right takes real relationships with senior, multi-stakeholder leadership teams, not a cadence of check-ins.

This is a new profile on our CS team, built for someone experienced enough to operate independently at the executive level and to direct the cross-functional work it takes to power a true enterprise brand.

You'll report to our VP of Customer Success and work day-to-day across Sales, Support, Product, Engineering, and Finance. Your portfolio will be roughly 10 to 12 brands representing $3-6M in ARR.

How We Work With AI

What Thanx gives you

AI capability at Thanx is infrastructure, not a perk. You will be given the tools, the budget, and the working culture to get good at this quickly:

  • Real token budgets. You will not be rationed on the tool you use to do your work.
  • Keystone. Our homegrown connective tissue that puts company data and tooling into a queryable, natural-language format.
  • The Grid. An internal site to host AI-built applications, reports, and tools that can be shared company-wide.
  • A show-and-tell culture. People here demo what they have built, and it becomes something the rest of the company uses. Getting up the learning curve is a shared project, not a solo one.
  • A growing library we built ourselves. The CS Cantina, is a skill library built by the Customer Success team that any CSM can run and extend.

What we expect from you

  • You treat AI as a working partner. You know the output is only as good as the context you give it and the review you do afterward, and you invest time in both.
  • You build or improve things other people use. When you solve a problem, you put in the extra effort to make the solution reusable, so nobody on your team has to solve it again. Then you do the harder part: make it good enough, and obvious enough, that using it beats going back to the old way.
  • You do not wait to be assigned the work. You notice when a one-off request is really a recurring problem, and you decide it is worth solving before anyone asks you to.

At review time, the question is not how much you used AI. It is what you built, who else is using it, and how your team works differently because of it.

What it looks like in this role

  • Directing the work. You walk into an executive business review with a point of view you built yourself. You bring the full account picture to the tool, health data, stakeholder history, open risks, rather than a single question, and shape what comes back into something a restaurant operator can act on.
  • Verification and judgment. You verify any number before it reaches an operator who knows their business better than any model does. You check a claim against the source, not against a summary that sounds right.
  • Building and improving for others. You extend and improve the skills the CS team already runs, so the whole team can spot and act on high value account opportunities with less effort. When a problem shows up in your book, you assume it's in someone else's too and you solve it once for everyone.
  • Deciding what's worth building. You identify which accounts are underperforming their potential and build the plan without waiting to be pointed at them. You build your own workflow rather than filing a request and waiting on ops.

Key responsibilities

  • Account strategy: set the direction for your accounts and defend it in front of senior stakeholders, client-side and internal.
  • Cross-functional leadership: define what’s needed, why it matters, and the impact it unlocks. Direct the work like a business owner; don’t just track it.
  • Renewals: own and close the full cycle end to end, leading the negotiation with Finance and the VP of Customer Success.
  • Champion development: find and grow the internal advocates who carry Thanx inside their organization.
  • Growth: spot the accounts underperforming their potential and build the plan, including senior buy-in, to close the gap.
  • AI-augmented account management: use AI daily across your book, from account planning and health monitoring to stakeholder comms and renewal prep.

Travel and location

This role is fully remote and can be based anywhere in the US or Canada. Expect roughly 10-15% travel: two to four trips a quarter for on-site business reviews, executive meetings, and brand launches, plus one or two industry events a year. Trips cluster around renewal and annual planning cycles rather than spreading evenly.

What we’re looking for

  • 6+ years in Customer Success, Account Management, or a strategic customer-facing role on complex, multi-stakeholder enterprise accounts.
  • A track record as a strategist, not a coordinator. You’ve directed cross-functional partners toward customer outcomes, not tracked their to-do list.
  • Executive presence. You’re equally comfortable pushing back on a VP internally and advising one externally.
  • Startup experience. You’ve carried a book where the process didn’t exist yet, headcount was thin, and the answer wasn’t in a playbook.
  • Real fluency with AI tools, used daily to extend your own judgment. Bring a specific example of how you’ve used AI on the job.
  • Experience owning renewal and expansion conversations, including with procurement and finance counterparts.
  • Experience with a health-scoring or CS platform is a plus.

There’s one exception: startup experience is non-negotiable for this seat. If you’re close on the rest, apply.

Leveling & Location:

Thanx uses structured internal leveling and location-based compensation. Final leveling and compensation are determined through the interview process based on experience, scope, and work location, and any offer will align with the appropriate range.

Application Process:

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to assist in screening or assessing applications; human review will always remain part of the process.

jobs.description:
Chief of Staff to the CEO (m/f/d)
Fulltime | Remote | Europe

Who We Are

vialytics is revolutionizing how cities manage road infrastructure. Our AI-powered road management system, combining intelligent software with a simple smartphone, enables municipalities to detect road damage, prioritize maintenance, and make smarter infrastructure decisions.

Founded in 2018, we have rapidly scaled across Europe and the U.S., supporting 1000+ municipalities in 7 countries.

We're now entering the next phase of growth:

  • accelerating our international expansion

  • taking our product to the next level

  • building an organization that truly scales

The opportunities ahead are significant. Capturing them will require exceptional alignment across the leadership team, fast and high-quality decision-making and the ability to turn executive strategy development into action.

👉 That's exactly where you come in.

🎯About the role

This is not a typical Chief of Staff role.
This is a high-leverage role focused on keeping the leadership team aligned and the CEO's decisions moving.

You are the person the CEO turns to when a topic requires alignment across the leadership team, a decision needs to move faster than the org would naturally move it, or the board needs a clear, well-prepared story.

You bring structure to how the C-suite works together — the cadence of how we meet, decide, and hold each other accountable — and you ensure the board sees a company that is aligned, deliberate and in control of its own trajectory.

Your success is measured by the speed and quality of C-level decision-making, and by how well-prepared and aligned the leadership team is going into every board interaction.

For the right person, this role provides a unique opportunity to operate at the center of the company's leadership and shape how we govern ourselves through Series B and beyond.

🧭 Your Mandate

You operate with the explicit mandate of the CEO.

In practice, this means:

  • You can challenge priorities, assumptions and decisions at the leadership-team level.

  • You can bring C-level stakeholders together and drive alignment and decisions to closure.

  • You can define ownership, timelines and follow-up mechanisms for C-suite commitments.

  • You can hold leadership-team members accountable for commitments and agreed outcomes.

  • You can escalate unresolved issues directly to the CEO when necessary.

  • You can take ownership of company-wide strategic initiatives and drive them through to execution — from scoping through delivery, not just to a decision.

You do not manage individual functions or replace their leaders. You do not own the mechanics of cascading company priorities into the organization — that ownership sits with the functional and operational leads who run those systems day to day, including the Chief of Staff to the CFO, who owns OKR cascading and performance-management infrastructure across Enabling Functions.

👉 The Chief of Staff does not lead through hierarchy. The Chief of Staff leads through mandate, alignment and execution at the leadership-team level.

👉 Priorities set by the Chief of Staff are to be treated with the same level of importance and urgency as if they came directly from the CEO.

💼 Your Key Responsibilities

You work directly with the CEO on how the leadership team operates, decides and shows up to the board.

Your focus splits roughly as follows:

  • ~ 80% C-suite Alignment, Decision Orchestration and Leadership-Team Cadence

  • ~ 20% Board and Investor Relations, plus select Special Projects

C-Suite Alignment & Decision Orchestration (~ 80%)

• Leadership Team Cadence: Design and run the rhythm of how the C-suite meets, prepares, decides and follows up — the meetings, pre-reads, and decision logs that make the leadership team function as one team.

• C-Level Alignment & Accountability: Align the leadership team around shared priorities, surface and resolve cross-functional conflicts at the C-level before they become bottlenecks, and hold leaders accountable for the commitments they make to each other.

• Decision Velocity: Build and run the operating rhythm that enables fast, high-quality decision-making at the leadership-team level — not the mechanics of pushing those decisions down into the organization, which sit with the functional owners, including the CFO CoS for Enabling Functions.

• Strategy Formulation & Moderation: Design and moderate the sessions where the leadership team actually formulates strategy — framing the right questions, structuring the debate, and driving it to a decision — rather than just facilitating logistics around a strategy someone else already wrote.

• Strategic Clarity: Help translate company strategy into priorities the leadership team is genuinely aligned behind, before those priorities are handed to the functions that will execute and cascade them.

Board & Investor Relations, Special Projects (~20%)

• Board Preparation & Narrative: Own the board meeting agenda, narrative and pre-reads, and ensure the leadership team is aligned and prepared before every board interaction.

• Investor Relations Support: Support the CEO in investor communications and Series B readiness, ensuring the story the board and investors hear is coherent and well-evidenced.

• CEO Leverage: Take ownership of select company-wide initiatives that don't have a clear single owner, drive them to a decision or a clear next owner, and remove the CEO as a bottleneck.

• Special Projects: Step into ambiguous, high-stakes, cross-functional topics at the CEO's direction — the ones that don't yet have a home — and bring enough structure to them that a clear owner and path forward emerge.

• Strategic Project Execution: Own execution of company-wide strategic initiatives that cut across the leadership team and require CEO-level sponsorship — from scoping through delivery — so they land in practice, not just get agreed to in a meeting. Execution of strategic initiatives within a single function sits with that function's leader, including the Chief of Staff to the CFO for Enabling Functions.

You translate C-suite priorities into clarity and alignment at the leadership-team level, and you drive critical leadership-team decisions to completion — with clear backing from the CEO, and without building a team of your own.

🌟 We would be the perfect match if you

  • Bring 9–13 years of professional experience after completing your academic degree, including 3–5 years in a CEO-adjacent seat with real exposure to board dynamics — for example as a Chief of Staff, Founder's Associate, or Head of Strategy & Operations with board involvement.

  • Have worked closely with founders, CEOs or executive teams, operating through influence and mandate rather than formal authority over a function.

  • Have hands-on experience with investor relations and board management — preparing board materials, owning a board narrative, or directly supporting fundraising and investor communications.

  • Have a track record leading high-impact, cross-functional special projects with no natural single owner — ambiguous, senior-stakeholder situations you were asked to bring structure to, not just a defined workstream.

  • Have experience running or significantly shaping a leadership-team operating cadence — how a C-suite meets, decides and holds itself accountable.

  • Are able to create alignment, drive accountability and influence senior executives — including those more senior or more tenured than you — without relying on formal authority.

  • Combine strategic thinking with exceptional execution and a strong bias for action

  • Thrive in fast-paced, high-growth environments with ambiguity, change and ambitious goals.

  • Communicate clearly, directly and credibly with stakeholders at every level, including the board.

  • Are fluent in written and spoken English; German is a plus.

🔭 Career paths we'd typically look at

  • Strategy consultants with senior client exposure, ideally including board-level engagements

  • Head of Strategy & Operations / Biz Ops at a VC-backed scale-up, with board exposure.

  • Chief of Staff to a CEO at a comparable-stage company.

  • VC or growth equity Principal with genuine operating experience, not purely investment-side.

  • Ex-Founder or COO of a smaller company, if their track record shows driving through influence and handing ownership back — not accumulating it.

What we're explicitly not looking for: someone who leads by taking ownership of functions and building a team underneath them. This role has no direct reports and does not accumulate headcount — its leverage comes from mandate and trust, not from an org chart.

🔀 Your Hiring Journey

1. Kick Off Chat (45 min -1h) :Friendly virtual chat with People & Culture and the Hiring Manager to explore the role, your experience, and our culture.

2. Expert Interview : Case Study (1h30) :Meet key stakeholders Patrick (CEO) and Oli (CFO) together with P&C and present a practical business case to demonstrate your strategic thinking and execution skills.

3. Onsite - Meeting in Stuttgart :An opportunity to meet the C-Level Team virtually or in person.

💰 What We Offer:

  • Top-tier equipment & tools: MacBook, iPhone, AirPods, plus access to modern SaaS tools and platforms

  • A dynamic and international scale-up environment: Flat hierarchies, fast decision-making, and real ownership from day one

  • Flexible working options: Remote setup in Europe with flexibility and occasional travel

  • Learning & wellbeing benefits: €1500 annual training budget, EGYM Wellpass, FutureBens, and more

This role sits at the intersection of technical depth and customer communication. You’ll work with customers, sales, product, and engineering teams to translate requirements into technically sound application recommendations, support product evaluations and proof-of-concept work, guide customer onboarding and implementation, and help build clear technical documentation.

Technical Application Support

Solution Design & Scoping

Pre-Sales & Post-Sales Engagement

Customer Onboarding & Implementation Guidance

Documentation & Knowledge Building

  • Create and maintain application notes, technical guides, and FAQs.
  • Develop customer-facing written materials that help customers self-serve.
  • Help internal teams communicate product capabilities clearly.

Feedback Loop to Product

  • Capture recurring customer questions, pain points, and feature requests.
  • Relay customer feedback to Krevera's product and engineering teams.
  • Help inform the product roadmap through insights gathered from customer engagements.

Required Experience & Skills

  • Demonstrated experience in an applications engineering, field applications, or systems engineering role, ideally within a technical product company.
  • Strong foundational knowledge in the relevant engineering domain.
  • Ability to understand customer environments and map Krevera's products to their needs.
  • Comfort working at the intersection of technical depth and customer communication.
  • Ability to explain complex concepts clearly to both engineers and non-engineers.
  • Experience supporting or collaborating with sales teams during pre-sales and proof-of-concept cycles.
  • Ability to produce clear technical documentation, application notes, or customer-facing written materials.
  • Based in the United States, with availability to engage during standard US business hours.

What Makes You a Strong Fit

  • You own problems end-to-end: when a customer question comes in, you follow it through to a real answer rather than passing it around.
  • You communicate proactively, keeping customers and internal teammates informed without needing to be prompted.
  • You are comfortable sitting at the edge of what you know and learning on the job, asking good questions, and building expertise quickly in unfamiliar territory.
  • You bring a low-ego, collaborative approach to working across technical and commercial teams.

What Success Looks Like

  • Customers receive clear, technically sound guidance for their specific applications and challenges.

Typical Day

Your day moves between customer-facing work and internal collaboration. In the morning you might be on a call with a customer working through a specific application question, then spend time preparing a technical summary for the sales team ahead of a product evaluation later in the week.

You respond to inbound technical inquiries, contribute to documentation that reduces repeat questions, and check in with Krevera's engineering and product teams to stay current on product updates and flag what you are hearing from the field.

The rhythm is a mix of scheduled calls and self-directed work, requiring you to manage your own time and prioritize clearly across active customer engagements.

Remote – work virtually from anywhere in the United States

Salary

AI2IO recognizes salary ranges from job boards do not necessarily reflect our pay ranges. In many instances we out-compete those ranges for well-qualified candidates.

Job Summary

The Forward Deployed Engineer – MEP Design is a hands-on, execution-focused role within AI2IO, embedded with the MEP Design department of DLB Associates and its family of affiliate companies. Working on a forward-deployed model, this individual is employed by AI2IO but works with and for the design teams day to day, turning the department’s priorities into working AI tools, workflows, and processes that engineers and designers use on real projects.

This is a builder’s role, not a strategy role. Design leadership identifies where improvement is needed and owns the roadmap; the Forward Deployed Engineer takes that roadmap and makes it real, using the AI platforms available across the

organization—including Claude, Microsoft 365 Copilot, and AI2IO’s CORE AI platform—to design, build, test, deploy, and

support solutions. The role favors configuring and extending proven, off-the-shelf platforms and commercially available tools over custom development; solutions that require custom software are handed off to AI2IO’s DevOps team. Success is

measured by tools in use on live projects and hours returned to the design teams, not by plans or presentations.

The ideal candidate comes from the MEP consulting world. They have produced construction documents, worked through

deadline weeks and QA/QC reviews, and understand that a sealed drawing carries the Engineer of Record’s professional

responsibility. They know the difference between a tool that is technically impressive and one an engineer will trust on a

deliverable. Somewhere along the way, they became the person in their office who automates things, and they want to do

that full time.

Because this role bridges two organizations, the Forward Deployed Engineer serves as the Design department’s advocate

and translator within AI2IO—representing the department’s priorities of engineering accuracy, defensibility, practicality, and

speed to usable results, while working within AI2IO’s security, governance, and development standards. The position reports to AI2IO’s AI Strategy & Enablement leadership and takes day-to-day priorities from Design department leadership.

The Engineer works closely with the AI Enablement Program Manager to convert successful engagements into reusable

patterns, training material, and adoption signals. They also serve as a key feedback channel back to AI platform owners —

surfacing capability gaps, training needs, and governance issues observed in the field.

Essential Functions

Build & Deploy AI Solutions

  • Translate Design department roadmap priorities into working AI solutions—agents, automations, scripts, prompt libraries, and Claude and Microsoft 365 Copilot workflows—moving quickly from requirement to usable tool and iterating from there.
  • Evaluate commercially available AI tools, industry software, and native platform features first, selecting and configuring off-the-shelf solutions wherever they meet the need, and pursuing custom development only when no suitable option exists.

Microsoft technologies are an important part of our work. We want to turn business requirements into useful AI assistants, reliable workflows, and connected systems that deliver measurable results.

Alongside technical delivery, your responsibilities may include project management, team leadership, mentoring, and coordination of outsourced contributors. You should be comfortable discussing business priorities, organizing delivery, reviewing technical work, and helping colleagues improve.

Ownership of Our Microsoft EnvironmentYou will independently manage and develop our company's Microsoft environment across Microsoft 365, Azure, and Power Platform. This includes taking ownership of configuration, access management, operational reliability, governance, documentation, and cost control.

We need someone who can identify issues, propose practical improvements, coordinate implementation, and verify that our systems continue to work reliably. You should be comfortable combining hands-on technical work with project management, team leadership, mentoring, and coordination of outsourced specialists.

Key Responsibilities

  • Build and maintain AI assistants and agents using Microsoft Copilot Studio and Microsoft Foundry.
  • Identify practical opportunities for Microsoft 365 Copilot and help teams use it effectively.
  • Connect AI solutions to relevant business knowledge and systems while respecting permissions and data boundaries.
  • Develop Power Automate workflows with reliable validation, exception handling, monitoring, and recovery.

  • Implement custom connectors or supporting code where the project requires them.
  • Evaluate AI output quality, grounding, failure behavior, latency, and operating costs.
  • Establish appropriate human review and approval steps for consequential automated actions.
  • Independently administer our Microsoft 365, Azure, and Power Platform environments, including users, groups, roles, application registrations, permissions, and service connections.
  • Configure and manage GitHub-connected Power Platform solutions, including repositories, authentication, source control, branching, reviews, and deployment workflows.
  • Manage the solution lifecycle across development, testing, and production, including solution dependencies, environment variables, connection references, release verification, and recovery procedures.
  • Maintain secure application identities, credentials, and access configurations with clear ownership and appropriate permissions.
  • Monitor platform health, investigate failures, maintain operational documentation, and control licensing and cloud expenditure.
  • Translate business requirements into clear tasks, delivery milestones, and verifiable acceptance criteria.
  • Manage project scope, priorities, dependencies, risks, and stakeholder communication.
  • Coordinate outsourced developers, review their deliverables, and maintain clear ownership.
  • Mentor colleagues through practical demonstrations, reviews, and knowledge transfer.
  • Keep solutions maintainable and proportionate to the problem and startup budget.

Required Qualifications

  • Demonstrated experience delivering production solutions using Copilot Studio, Microsoft Foundry, and Power Automate.
  • Practical understanding of Microsoft 365 Copilot and its use in business workflows.
  • Experience building AI agents or assistants connected to business data, tools, and APIs.
  • Experience evaluating AI-generated answers and actions, including handling unreliable or unsupported output.
  • Strong knowledge of Power Automate cloud flows, connectors, expressions, approvals, and troubleshooting.
  • Experience integrating SharePoint, Teams, Dataverse, Microsoft Graph, or comparable business platforms.
  • Working knowledge of Microsoft Entra ID, application permissions, authentication, and secure credential handling.
  • Ability to write and review supporting code or scripts, for example in Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, or PowerShell.
  • Proven experience independently administering a company's Microsoft environment, with responsibility for reliable operation and ongoing improvement.
  • Hands-on experience configuring and managing Power Platform solutions connected to GitHub.
  • Practical experience with GitHub Actions or comparable CI/CD workflows for Microsoft solutions.
  • Strong understanding of environment separation, managed and unmanaged solutions, dependencies, connection references, and environment-specific configuration.
  • Previous responsibility for technical project delivery, including planning and stakeholder communication.
  • Proven experience leading developers, mentoring colleagues, or coordinating distributed contributors.
  • The ability to take ownership of technical problems, communicate their business impact, and carry improvements through to a verified result.
  • Ability to work independently, explain technical decisions clearly, and prioritize within a limited startup budget.

Especially Valuable Experience

  • Delivering Microsoft AI or automation projects in a startup or consulting environment.
  • Building retrieval workflows with documented knowledge sources and permission-aware access.
  • Working with Power Apps, Azure services, SQL databases, or Azure DevOps.
  • Experience with Azure API Management and its AI gateway capabilities, including authentication, model routing, usage limits, monitoring, and cost control.
  • Experience with related components such as Azure Key Vault, Azure Monitor, Application Insights, and Azure AI Search.
  • Experience building and maintaining Power BI reports and dashboards, including Power Query, data modelling, DAX, scheduled refresh, workspace permissions, and row-level security.
  • Experience connecting reporting and analytics to operational workflows and business decisions.
  • Replacing fragile workflows with solutions that are easier to operate and maintain.
  • Coordinating outsourced implementation while retaining internal technical ownership.
  • Using AI development tools effectively and recognizing when generated solutions introduce unnecessary complexity.

Growth, Leadership and CompensationThis is an opportunity to join early and help shape our Microsoft AI and automation practice.

Initial compensation will reflect our startup budget, your experience, and the agreed responsibilities. As the business develops and your contribution grows, we aim to offer substantial salary progression during the first few years.

Strong contributors may progress into roles such as Microsoft AI Team Lead, AI & Automation Lead, Solutions Architect, or Head of AI & Automation. Progression will depend on demonstrated results, leadership capability, company growth, and financial capacity. We will discuss expectations and progression milestones openly during recruitment.

What We Offer

  • Close collaboration with startup leadership.
  • Varied projects with practical business impact.

Remote Working ArrangementOur remote working setup includes a time-tracking tool that records mouse-click and keyboard-activity metrics and captures screenshots. This working arrangement will be explained during recruitment.

Applicants should be comfortable working with this setup.

How to ApplyWe are looking to fill this core role promptly and will review applications as they arrive. Applying early provides an opportunity to discuss how you could help shape our AI and automation work.

Please submit your CV and a short overview of:

jobs.title: Senior Microsoft AI Engineer - Copilot, Foundry & Power Automate
jobs.excerpt: Location: 100% Remote Employment: Full-time, long-term position Start date: As soon as possible after selection and agreement Salary: Startup-aligned starting compensation, based on experience and responsibilities, with substantial growth potential during the first few years About UsWe are a startup developing AI-powered solutions, business applications, integrations, and automations across different products and internal initiatives.
jobs.description:
Location: 100% Remote
Employment: Full-time, long-term position
Start date: As soon as possible after selection and agreement
Salary: Startup-aligned starting compensation, based on experience and responsibilities, with substantial growth potential during the first few years

About UsWe are a startup developing AI-powered solutions, business applications, integrations, and automations across different products and internal initiatives.

Microsoft technologies are an important part of our work. We want to turn business requirements into useful AI assistants, reliable workflows, and connected systems that deliver measurable results.

Our delivery model combines internal ownership with outsourced development. We are looking for someone who enjoys hands-on implementation, can coordinate external specialists, and wants to help build and lead a growing team.

The RoleWe are seeking an experienced Microsoft AI Engineer with strong practical experience in Microsoft Copilot, Copilot Studio, Microsoft Foundry, and Power Automate.

You will take responsibility for projects from requirements discovery and solution design through implementation, testing, deployment, and ongoing improvement. Your work will span different business processes and products.

Alongside technical delivery, your responsibilities may include project management, team leadership, mentoring, and coordination of outsourced contributors. You should be comfortable discussing business priorities, organizing delivery, reviewing technical work, and helping colleagues improve.

Ownership of Our Microsoft EnvironmentYou will independently manage and develop our company's Microsoft environment across Microsoft 365, Azure, and Power Platform. This includes taking ownership of configuration, access management, operational reliability, governance, documentation, and cost control.

We need someone who can identify issues, propose practical improvements, coordinate implementation, and verify that our systems continue to work reliably. You should be comfortable combining hands-on technical work with project management, team leadership, mentoring, and coordination of outsourced specialists.

Key Responsibilities

  • Build and maintain AI assistants and agents using Microsoft Copilot Studio and Microsoft Foundry.
  • Identify practical opportunities for Microsoft 365 Copilot and help teams use it effectively.
  • Connect AI solutions to relevant business knowledge and systems while respecting permissions and data boundaries.
  • Develop Power Automate workflows with reliable validation, exception handling, monitoring, and recovery.
  • Integrate Microsoft 365, Teams, SharePoint, Dataverse, Microsoft Graph, external APIs, and other business systems.
  • Implement custom connectors or supporting code where the project requires them.
  • Evaluate AI output quality, grounding, failure behavior, latency, and operating costs.
  • Establish appropriate human review and approval steps for consequential automated actions.
  • Independently administer our Microsoft 365, Azure, and Power Platform environments, including users, groups, roles, application registrations, permissions, and service connections.
  • Configure and manage GitHub-connected Power Platform solutions, including repositories, authentication, source control, branching, reviews, and deployment workflows.
  • Manage the solution lifecycle across development, testing, and production, including solution dependencies, environment variables, connection references, release verification, and recovery procedures.
  • Maintain secure application identities, credentials, and access configurations with clear ownership and appropriate permissions.
  • Monitor platform health, investigate failures, maintain operational documentation, and control licensing and cloud expenditure.
  • Translate business requirements into clear tasks, delivery milestones, and verifiable acceptance criteria.
  • Manage project scope, priorities, dependencies, risks, and stakeholder communication.
  • Coordinate outsourced developers, review their deliverables, and maintain clear ownership.
  • Mentor colleagues through practical demonstrations, reviews, and knowledge transfer.
  • Keep solutions maintainable and proportionate to the problem and startup budget.

Required Qualifications

  • Demonstrated experience delivering production solutions using Copilot Studio, Microsoft Foundry, and Power Automate.
  • Practical understanding of Microsoft 365 Copilot and its use in business workflows.
  • Experience building AI agents or assistants connected to business data, tools, and APIs.
  • Experience evaluating AI-generated answers and actions, including handling unreliable or unsupported output.
  • Strong knowledge of Power Automate cloud flows, connectors, expressions, approvals, and troubleshooting.
  • Experience integrating SharePoint, Teams, Dataverse, Microsoft Graph, or comparable business platforms.
  • Working knowledge of Microsoft Entra ID, application permissions, authentication, and secure credential handling.
  • Ability to write and review supporting code or scripts, for example in Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, or PowerShell.
  • Proven experience independently administering a company's Microsoft environment, with responsibility for reliable operation and ongoing improvement.
  • Hands-on experience configuring and managing Power Platform solutions connected to GitHub.
  • Practical experience with GitHub Actions or comparable CI/CD workflows for Microsoft solutions.
  • Strong understanding of environment separation, managed and unmanaged solutions, dependencies, connection references, and environment-specific configuration.
  • Previous responsibility for technical project delivery, including planning and stakeholder communication.
  • Proven experience leading developers, mentoring colleagues, or coordinating distributed contributors.
  • The ability to take ownership of technical problems, communicate their business impact, and carry improvements through to a verified result.
  • Ability to work independently, explain technical decisions clearly, and prioritize within a limited startup budget.

Especially Valuable Experience

  • Delivering Microsoft AI or automation projects in a startup or consulting environment.
  • Building retrieval workflows with documented knowledge sources and permission-aware access.
  • Working with Power Apps, Azure services, SQL databases, or Azure DevOps.
  • Experience with Azure API Management and its AI gateway capabilities, including authentication, model routing, usage limits, monitoring, and cost control.
  • Experience with related components such as Azure Key Vault, Azure Monitor, Application Insights, and Azure AI Search.
  • Experience building and maintaining Power BI reports and dashboards, including Power Query, data modelling, DAX, scheduled refresh, workspace permissions, and row-level security.
  • Experience connecting reporting and analytics to operational workflows and business decisions.
  • Replacing fragile workflows with solutions that are easier to operate and maintain.
  • Coordinating outsourced implementation while retaining internal technical ownership.
  • Using AI development tools effectively and recognizing when generated solutions introduce unnecessary complexity.

Growth, Leadership and CompensationThis is an opportunity to join early and help shape our Microsoft AI and automation practice.

Initial compensation will reflect our startup budget, your experience, and the agreed responsibilities. As the business develops and your contribution grows, we aim to offer substantial salary progression during the first few years.

Strong contributors may progress into roles such as Microsoft AI Team Lead, AI & Automation Lead, Solutions Architect, or Head of AI & Automation. Progression will depend on demonstrated results, leadership capability, company growth, and financial capacity. We will discuss expectations and progression milestones openly during recruitment.

What We Offer

  • A fully remote role with a long-term perspective.
  • Ownership across AI implementation, automation, and project delivery.
  • The opportunity to mentor colleagues and build a distributed team.
  • Close collaboration with startup leadership.
  • Varied projects with practical business impact.
  • Significant potential for career and compensation growth as the company develops.

Remote Working ArrangementOur remote working setup includes a time-tracking tool that records mouse-click and keyboard-activity metrics and captures screenshots. This working arrangement will be explained during recruitment.

Applicants should be comfortable working with this setup.

How to ApplyWe are looking to fill this core role promptly and will review applications as they arrive. Applying early provides an opportunity to discuss how you could help shape our AI and automation work.

Please submit your CV and a short overview of:

  • A Copilot Studio or Microsoft Foundry solution you delivered, your contribution, and how you verified its results.
  • A Power Automate workflow you implemented and how you handled failures.
  • A Microsoft environment you administered and GitHub-connected solutions you managed.
  • A project you managed or a team you led or mentored.
  • Your experience coordinating outsourced contributors.
  • Your earliest start date and salary expectations, taking our startup stage into account.

Public links and anonymized examples are welcome. Please do not share confidential information or credentials.

jobs.title: Digital Marketing Manager
jobs.excerpt: About L & E Research, Inc.  L&E Research has connected companies with people since 1984.
jobs.description:
About L & E Research, Inc.

L&E Research has connected companies with people since 1984. Market research agencies, brands, healthcare and life sciences teams, and law firms rely on us to recruit the right participants for qualitative and quantitative research, then host their sessions in our focus group facilities and sensory labs or online.

We run facilities in Chicago, Cincinnati, Columbus, Denver, New York City, Orlando, Raleigh and Tampa, and serve clients through three practices: L&E Health, L&E Consumer and L&E Legal (mock trial and jury research). We’re dual ISO-certified (ISO 20252 and ISO 27001), and 99% of our clients say they’d recommend us.

Digital Marketing Manager

Full-Time | US Remote | EST or MST

ABOUT THE ROLE

We’re hiring a hands-on Digital Marketing Manager to own L&E’s marketing day to day. This is a doer’s job. You’ll plan, write, build, launch and measure most of what we put into the market yourself, with freelance help, where it makes sense, not a full-time agency doing the work for you. This role reports to the Chief Marketing Officer.

Our buyers are researchers: agency project directors, insights leads at brands, clinical research teams and trial consultants. They’re skeptical of fluff. They buy on trust, speed and quality. We need someone who can take what our sales and recruiting teams know and turn it into content those buyers actually use, then show us with numbers what’s working.

The foundation is already in place: a new Webflow site, HubSpot, product analytics and automated lead routing. What we need now is a marketer who uses all of it every week.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Create content (the biggest part of the job)

  • Plan and produce a steady stream of content: blog posts, case studies, guides, email newsletters, webinars, sales collateral, LinkedIn posts and landing pages.
  • Interview our recruiters, project managers and sales team to get their expertise out of their heads and onto the page.
  • Refresh our library of older ebooks and white papers and relaunch them as gated HubSpot offers.
  • Build content for each of our core segments: Healthcare/Clinical, Consumer/Brand, Legal/Mock Jury and research agencies.

Own HubSpot and marketing operations

  • Run HubSpot Marketing Hub: lists, workflows, nurture sequences, forms, lead scoring and attribution reporting.
  • Keep the database clean. Work with Sales on lifecycle stages, MQL definitions and handoff rules.
  • Manage the company’s three websites on Webflow: publishing, landing pages and on-page SEO/AEO.

Work side by side with Sales

  • Lead a weekly sales and marketing meeting: what’s landing with prospects, where deals stall, what Sales needs from marketing.
  • Build the collateral Sales asks for: one-pagers, battlecards, proposal inserts and email templates.
  • Turn win/loss feedback into messaging changes.

Measure everything

  • Report monthly on marketing-sourced and influenced pipeline, conversion by channel and page, and content performance.
  • Use HubSpot and web analytics to find where visitors drop off before requesting a bid and fix it.
  • Stop doing what the numbers say isn’t working.

Run demand generation

  • Email, LinkedIn, SEO, and paid search or social where it earns its keep.
  • Support industry conferences and events.
  • Manage the marketing budget and any freelancers or vendors.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

  • First 30 days: Learn the business. Sit in on sales calls and with the recruiting team. Audit HubSpot and the company’s three websites. Ship your first piece of content.
  • First 60 days: A regular publishing cadence is running. The weekly sales and marketing meeting is established. A reporting dashboard is live.
  • First 90 days: A content calendar for the next two quarters, and early, measurable movement in leads and bid requests.
  • First year: Marketing is a reliable source of qualified pipeline targets, and the sales team will tell you marketing helps them win.

WHAT YOU BRING

Experience

  • 4–7 years of hands-on B2B digital marketing as a generalist: content, email, SEO, social, paid and marketing ops.
  • Real HubSpot experience. You’ve built workflows, lists and reports yourself, not just used them.
  • A track record of tying marketing to pipeline and revenue, with numbers you can talk through.
  • Nice to have: Agency experience, especially 2+ years working across multiple clients, problems and tech stacks.
  • Nice to have: Exposure to market research, B2B services, healthcare/life sciences or legal. Not required; we’ll teach you the industry.
  • Nice to have: Webflow or another modern CMS, GA4 or product analytics, basic HTML.
  • Nice to have: Webinar or video production.

Knowledge & Skills

  • Strong writing. You’ll share samples you wrote.
  • Smart use of AI tools to speed up research and drafting without lowering quality.

TECHNOLOGY REQUIREMENTS

A Windows-based PC will be provided to all full-time employees. You'll also need:

  • Reliable high-speed internet/broadband connection.
  • Consistent and dependable phone service.

WHO YOU ARE

Beyond the technical skills, the right person for this role brings these qualities to the work every day:

  • Thrives in a fast-paced, virtual setting. You stay focused and productive working remotely, even when priorities shift quickly.
  • Works well independently and with a team. You are self-motivated and know when to take the lead and when to collaborate.
  • Communicates clearly. You write and speak well, and you are confident talking directly with clients and internal stakeholders.
  • Stays organized. You set priorities, build a work schedule, track progress toward goals, and keep details, data, and activities in order.
  • Acts with integrity. You use sound business practices and hold yourself to standards that match our values.
  • Builds strong working relationships. You work cooperatively with others to set goals, solve problems, and make decisions that help the whole organization.

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS

  • Occasional travel for trade shows and team meetings (about 10%).
  • Complete all training course assignments issued by HR/IT.
  • Adhere to the ISO/IEC 27001 and ISO 20252 standards.
  • Must be authorized to work in the United States without employer sponsorship, now or in the future.

CLICK APPLY NOW TO GET STARTED

We read every application, and we want to know you read this post all the way through.

Key Phrase - Webflow.

The People First culture at TaskUs has enabled the company to expand its workforce to approximately 60,000 employees globally. Presently, we have a presence in twenty-three locations across twelve countries, which include the Philippines, India, and the United States.


It started with one ridiculously good idea to create a different breed of Business Processing Outsourcing (BPO)! We at TaskUs understand that achieving growth for our partners requires a culture of constant motion, exploring new technologies, being ready to handle any challenge at a moment’s notice, and mastering consistency in an ever-changing world.


What We Offer:At TaskUs, we prioritize our employees' well-being by offering competitive industry salaries and comprehensive benefits packages. Our commitment to a People First culture is reflected in the various departments we have established, including Total Rewards, Wellness, HR, and Diversity. We take pride in our inclusive environment and positive impact on the community. Moreover, we actively encourage internal mobility and professional growth at all stages of an employee's career within TaskUs. Join our team today and experience firsthand our dedication to supporting People First.

TaskUs (Nasdaq: TASK) is a leading provider of outsourced digital services and next-generation customer experience to the world’s most innovative companies. We solve complex operational challenges for global category leaders within AI, autonomous vehicles (AV), robotics, and beyond. By combining specialized human talent with intelligent technology, we power the companies shaping the future.


Role Overview


As the Head of Delivery, AI Operations, you will be responsible for ensuring that operations deliver training data (collection and annotation), adversarial testing, model evaluation services, and AI safety reviews meets the highest standards. You will drive thought leadership on project delivery, work closely with customers to define and deliver high-quality outputs, and oversee the development of new production protocols across projects. This role requires a blend of strategic thinking, hands-on operations, and cross-functional collaboration to ensure our services are impactful for AI projects, primarily focused on Physical AI elements such as Robotics and world model development.


The ideal candidate will have a strong entrepreneurial mindset, deep expertise in operations and delivery for AI Services (such as producing training data via FTEs and freelancer models), and experience leading global teams. They will be comfortable working in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment and being in a constant state of learning.

  • Manage the delivery of AI services such as data collection and annotation, adversarial testing, and AI content safety moderation.
  • Lead a global team of Operations Managers to oversee successful delivery of AI services to ensure on time and under budget deliveries that meet and exceed customer quality expectations.

  • Design and oversee specialized operations protocols for multiple delivery models including leveraging full time employees in our global centers, remote workers, and freelance workers.
  • Partner cross functionally with Quality, Training, PMO, Sales, and Product and Engineering teams to advance automation and evolve our ability to deliver high quality outcomes.
  • Foster a high-performance culture, encouraging continuous learning and improvement.
  • Drive a culture of testing, iterating, and scaling processes, ensuring that all workflows are efficient and results-driven.

  • 7+ years of Operations leadership experience, ideally within an organization that provides HITL, RLHF and evaluation services to leading LLM developers, Mag7 companies, AV builders and Robotics companies.

  • You LOVE this stuff. You have a strong pov on the coolest and most useful AI tools on the market, and you love opening the hood and playing around. You have a deep understanding of large language models, generative AI workflows, and data structures.

jobs.excerpt: About Us We are an early-stage startup preparing to launch a mobile dating app competing in the same market as Tinder, Bumble and Hinge.
jobs.description:
About Us

We are an early-stage startup preparing to launch a mobile dating app competing in the same market as Tinder, Bumble and Hinge.

Our working culture is fast-moving, hands-on and shaped by short decision cycles, evolving priorities and limited resources. We need someone who enjoys this environment, takes initiative and remains composed and effective when deadlines are tight or plans change.

You will help shape the product, build the brand and bring the app to market. Initially, you will personally deliver much of the work across marketing, content, partnerships and automation. As the business develops, the role may expand to include building and leading a team.

Job Description

You will play a central role in deciding how the app is positioned, how the brand looks and communicates, which audiences we serve and how the product develops to meet their needs.

Working closely with the founding and development teams, you will turn market research, user insights and performance data into recommendations for product priorities, features, onboarding and the overall user experience. Your involvement starts before launch and continues through ongoing product development and growth.

You will also own the marketing strategy and its practical execution. This includes creating the content and systems needed across websites, social media, YouTube long-form videos, Shorts, advertising, influencer campaigns and partnerships.

Exceptional practical expertise in AI is essential. You must be able to use AI to produce high-quality work independently and build reliable content pipelines and automations. n8n and similar tools should be part of your everyday workflow.

Key Responsibilities

  • Shape the product: Research user needs, competitors and market opportunities. Help define the product's value proposition, contribute to roadmap priorities and turn insights into clear feature proposals and briefs.
  • Improve the user experience: Work with the product and development teams on onboarding, activation, engagement, retention and monetization. Help define experiments and assess whether changes improve the experience.
  • Build the brand: Develop brand positioning, messaging, tone of voice, visual direction and storytelling. Translate these into a consistent identity across the app and all marketing channels.
  • Own go-to-market: Develop and execute the pre-launch, launch and growth strategy, including target audiences, market selection, channel priorities and campaign planning.
  • Create marketing content: Personally plan, produce, edit and publish the content the business needs, including websites, landing pages, social posts, advertising assets, graphics, email campaigns, YouTube long-form videos, Shorts and other short-form video.
  • Build content pipelines: Use AI and automation to support research, scripting, visual production, video editing, repurposing, publishing and performance analysis while maintaining creative quality.
  • Develop influencer marketing: Identify suitable creators, establish relationships, negotiate collaborations, develop campaign briefs and measure results.
  • Establish partnerships: Find and develop relevant brand, community, event and distribution partnerships that support awareness, trust and user acquisition.
  • Drive measurable growth: Run acquisition and lifecycle experiments across paid, organic, referral and community channels. Connect marketing activity to activation, retention and commercial outcomes.
  • Automate operations: Build and maintain n8n workflows and integrations that reduce repetitive work across marketing, content production, partnerships and reporting.
  • Support future team growth: As needs and resources develop, help identify hiring priorities, document effective workflows and onboard colleagues or external specialists.

Required Qualifications

  • Substantial hands-on experience launching and growing consumer mobile apps, with a demonstrable personal contribution to apps reaching six-, seven- or eight-figure download totals.
  • Evidence of your own impact: the decisions you owned, the work you delivered and the measurable results achieved.
  • Experience contributing directly to product development through user research, feature definition, prioritization, experimentation and collaboration with designers and developers.
  • Strong brand-building ability, including positioning, messaging, visual judgment and consistent execution across product and marketing.
  • Exceptional practical AI skills across research, writing, design, image generation, video production, editing and content workflows.
  • The ability to independently produce marketing content across multiple formats, including social media, YouTube long-form videos, Shorts, websites and advertising creatives.
  • Hands-on experience with influencer marketing, creator collaborations and partnership development.
  • Strong practical knowledge of n8n or comparable automation platforms, including APIs, webhooks, integrations and reliable workflow operation.
  • A solid understanding of mobile acquisition, attribution, activation, retention, customer acquisition cost and lifetime value.
  • The judgment to prioritize the channels and activities that matter most, balancing quality, speed and limited startup resources.
  • A willingness to take ownership across disciplines and personally execute the work required at an early-stage business.
  • Resilience under pressure, strong prioritization skills and the ability to maintain quality and sound judgment during demanding launch phases.
  • Comfort working with uncertainty, changing priorities and limited startup resources, with the confidence to communicate trade-offs, flag constraints early and propose practical solutions.

Especially Valuable Experience

  • Experience with dating apps, social discovery products or consumer platforms that depend on network effects.
  • Growing mobile apps to millions or tens of millions of downloads.
  • Taking a product from pre-launch through launch and subsequent growth.
  • Building local user density, communities and market-by-market launch strategies.
  • Developing a brand from the beginning and carrying it consistently into the product experience.
  • Building a YouTube presence, repeatable video formats or creator-led acquisition channels.
  • Establishing partnerships that delivered measurable distribution, engagement or revenue.
  • Growing from an individual contributor into a team leadership role within a startup.

What We Offer

  • A central role in shaping the product, brand and market launch of a new mobile dating app.
  • Broad responsibility across creative work, product decisions, marketing and growth.
  • The opportunity to build practical systems and workflows from the beginning.
  • The potential to help build and lead a team as the business grows.

How to Apply

Please share your CV and selected examples demonstrating:

  • Mobile apps you helped launch or scale, their download totals and your personal contribution.
  • Product decisions or improvements you helped shape, including the user insight behind them and the outcome.
  • Branding and marketing content you personally created, ideally covering multiple formats.
  • AI-powered content workflows or automations you built.
  • Influencer campaigns or partnerships you developed and the results they produced.

Public links and anonymized examples are welcome. Please respect the confidentiality of previous employers and clients.

Two (2) or more years’ experience working within litigation case management system, preferably Legal Tracker.

The Challenge
