JCTM is seeking a Senior Intel Business Analyst to support critical information systems that enable the collection, organization, analysis, and reporting of operational performance data across multiple USCIS communication channels.

Build Your Career

At JCTM, we value knowledge, experience, integrity, and commitment. Joining our team means becoming part of an organization that empowers individuals, prioritizes ethical practices, and fosters a culture of collaboration and growth.

Challenging Projects

As an Intel Business Analyst with JCTM, you will support the analysis, design, implementation, testing, and maintenance of the USCIS Centralized Data Repository (CDR) and OAIS Centralized Reporting System (OCRS) user interface. You will work with government stakeholders and technical personnel to translate operational needs into system enhancements, improve access to reporting information, and support the continued effectiveness of enterprise data systems.

Key Responsibilities

  • Business and Systems Analysis: Analyze operational requirements, system functionality, and business processes supporting the CDR and OCRS applications.
  • Requirements Development: Collaborate with USCIS stakeholders to identify, document, and translate business requirements into actionable technical specifications.
  • System Design and Implementation: Support the design, implementation, testing, and maintenance of CDR/OCRS functionality and approved system enhancements.
  • Data and Reporting Analysis: Analyze reporting workflows, data structures, and information requirements to identify opportunities for improved efficiency and reliability.
  • Operational Process Improvement: Evaluate existing business processes and recommend enhancements to reporting, data management, and application functionality.
  • System Testing: Coordinate and perform functional testing, user acceptance testing, and validation of system enhancements.
  • Data Integrity: Review system data and reporting outputs for inconsistencies, anomalies, and potential quality issues.
  • Stakeholder Coordination: Work with USCIS program personnel, technical teams, and external vendors to support requirements development and issue resolution.
  • Documentation: Develop and maintain functional requirements, system documentation, user procedures, and records of approved modifications.
  • Change Management: Track requirements, changes, and implementation activities using USCIS-approved systems such as Jira, Confluence, and SharePoint.
  • System Support: Provide ongoing analytical and operational support for the CDR and OCRS environments.

State-of-the-Art Technology

Expand your expertise through exposure to AWS-hosted enterprise data systems, SQL-based reporting repositories, Amazon Connect, Amazon QuickSight, and integrated reporting environments supporting high-volume federal customer service operations.

New Skills

Collaborate with government program managers, technical developers, reporting specialists, and enterprise system stakeholders while developing additional expertise in business requirements analysis, data integration, and federal IT modernization.

Room to Grow

You will have opportunities to grow your career and contribute to the company's strategic goals, supported by mentorship and a collaborative work environment.

You Have

  • Associate's degree or higher.
  • Minimum of 5 years of experience in the Information Technology field.
  • Ability to analyze business processes, system requirements, and information technology workflows.
  • Ability to support system design, implementation, testing, documentation, and maintenance activities.
  • Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to communicate technical and functional information effectively to diverse stakeholders.

Nice to Haves

  • Experience as a Business Analyst, Systems Analyst, or Technical Business Analyst supporting enterprise IT systems.
  • Experience developing business requirements, functional specifications, process documentation, or user stories.
  • Familiarity with SQL databases, data repositories, and reporting platforms.
  • Experience with AWS, Amazon Connect, Amazon QuickSight, or similar cloud-based systems.
  • Experience evaluating operational data and identifying opportunities for workflow automation.
  • Familiarity with Jira, Confluence, SharePoint, and Agile development methodologies.
  • Experience supporting user acceptance testing and application enhancement projects.
  • Previous experience supporting DHS, USCIS, or other federal government organizations.

Clearance

Applicants selected will be subject to a security investigation and must meet eligibility requirements for access to applicable government information and systems. This position requires a satisfactory USCIS Enter-on-Duty (EOD) determination prior to beginning work and the ability to obtain and maintain the required government suitability determination.

HOW YOU’LL MAKE AN IMPACT

As the Sales Operations Analyst, you'll have the opportunity to make a meaningful impact by supporting the commercial operations of USGBC and GBCI. In this role, you'll transform commercial data and business needs into reliable analysis, actionable insights, and effective Salesforce workflows that support sales efficiency and effectiveness.

You'll support Market Leads, Account Management teams, and leadership with pipeline, forecasting, account coverage, customer retention, expansion, and partner performance reporting. You'll also perform business analysis to define Salesforce requirements, test workflows, and support the adoption of approved commercial processes.

You will support global sales operations across all regions by helping establish consistent reporting practices, improving data quality, and providing accurate commercial insights that enable informed decision-making across markets.

You'll report to the director of sales operations and work closely with regional directors, market leads, account management, client solutions, sales enablement, technology, and finance to support sales success across all global regions and markets.

As an individual contributor within the global sales operations team, you will help standardize commercial data, reporting, and business processes while supporting regional teams with their operational and analytical needs.

Key Responsibilities

  • Global commercial reporting and analytics:build and maintain approved reports and dashboards covering sales pipeline, conversion rates, opportunity stage aging, win/loss trends, account coverage, customer retention, expansion, and channel partner contributions. Coordinate with marketing and communications on campaign performance, lead routing, and return-on-investment reporting. Analyze material trends, identify data limitations, and recommend follow-up actions. Support consistent global reporting standards while providing regional and consolidated performance insights to commercial leadership.
  • Sales forecasting and commercial planning:prepare forecasting inputs, assumptions, scenarios, and variance analyses to support commercial planning and decision-making. Identify incomplete information, inconsistent opportunity values, and reporting discrepancies. Support territory planning, account coverage, quota and KPI distribution, and workload analysis while maintaining traceability and preserving opportunity owners' accountability for their forecasts. Help consolidate and analyze forecast data across global regions to improve reporting consistency, visibility, and accuracy.
  • Data quality, governance, and commercial attribution:monitor and improve data accuracy across salesforce accounts, contacts, opportunities, account hierarchies, required fields, customer and partner relationships, and commercial records. Identify duplicate or incomplete records, coordinate corrections with record owners, and reconcile approved commercial measures with finance to prevent duplicate attribution. Support the implementation and consistent application of global data quality standards, reporting definitions, and commercial attribution practices.
  • Salesforce business analysis and requirements documentation:gather and document business requirements, current and proposed workflows, user needs, field definitions, reporting logic, process handoffs, and acceptance criteria. Maintain a prioritized salesforce business-improvement backlog in partnership with the director of sales operations and technology. Collaborate with global stakeholders to identify regional business requirements and support scalable system improvements that align with approved global commercial processes.
  • System testing and change implementation:prepare and execute user acceptance testing (UAT), coordinate business testers, document defects, track testing results, and validate whether approved business requirements have been met. Support change readiness and coordinate with authorized technology teams for technical remediation and production deployment. Support cross-regional user testing and implementation readiness to ensure system changes are effective for global commercial teams.
  • Salesforce adoption and user support:develop process documentation, job aids, and user guidance to support the effective use of salesforce and approved commercial workflows. Provide targeted system demonstrations, troubleshoot business-process questions, and collaborate with sales enablement on training and reinforcement. Escalate access, security, integration, and technical issues to the appropriate technology teams. Support consistent CRM adoption and user understanding across regions, including teams operating in different time zones.
  • Commercial process improvement and standardization:maintain reporting schedules, metric definitions, process documentation, and audit trails. Identify opportunities to improve reporting efficiency, reduce manual work, and strengthen commercial processes through practical automation and process improvements. Protect confidential customer and partner information and operate within approved system permissions. Help develop and maintain standardized global reporting procedures, workflows, and documentation that support consistent commercial operations.
  • Cross-functional collaboration and regional support:partner with regional directors, market leads, account managers, finance, technology, marketing, product, client solutions, and sales enablement to resolve reporting issues, clarify commercial workflows, and support operational improvements. Act as a central analytical and business-process resource for global commercial teams, supporting consistent data interpretation, knowledge sharing, and coordination across regions.
  • Analytical ownership and quality assurance:independently manage assigned reports, dashboards, data quality checks, business requirements, and testing activities. Select appropriate analytical methods, document findings and limitations, and recommend corrective actions within approved reporting definitions and system permissions. Ensure analytical outputs are accurate, consistent, well-documented, and appropriate for global commercial reporting.
  • Issue resolution, recommendations, and escalation:recommend improvements to commercial metrics, salesforce workflows, reporting processes, and system release readiness based on evidence. Escalate unresolved data disputes, system defects, sensitive information concerns, and competing workload priorities. Preserve established decision-making authority, with business owners approving material requirements and authorized technology owners approving system releases. Provide timely analysis and recommendations to support global sales operations leadership in addressing operational challenges and improving performance.

Experience

  • A minimum of three years of experience in sales operations, revenue operations, commercial analytics, or business analysis supporting customer-facing teams, including at least two years of hands-on experience with salesforce reporting and commercial workflows.
  • Demonstrated experience developing reports and dashboards, improving data quality, conducting user acceptance testing, and supporting business-process adoption.

jobs.excerpt: Why SoftwareOne?  SoftwareOne is a global software and cloud solutions provider and distributor, powered by around 12,000 people across more than 70 countries.
jobs.description:
Why SoftwareOne?

SoftwareOne is a global software and cloud solutions provider and distributor, powered by around 12,000 people across more than 70 countries. But what really makes us SoftwareOne is our people: curious minds, different perspectives, and talented teams working together to solve real challenges and create meaningful impact. Here, you’ll have the opportunity to grow, explore new possibilities, and build a career that’s uniquely yours, while helping shape what’s next in technology.


The role

  • Interested in building a greenfield, modern and forward-looking risk function where data, technology, and independent insight inform strategic decision-making?
  • Looking for a role with meaningful influence across executive leadership, the Board, and the wider business?

Practical Information

Location:Europe | Reports to: Global Head of Internal Audit, with direct access to the Audit Committee and Executive Board | Team:Group Risk Function of 3 FTE initially, will grow to 6 FTE | Language requirements: Fluent English, written and verbal | Learn more: softwareone.com

The Role

We are looking to appoint a Chief Risk Officer to lead SoftwareOne’s second-line Group Risk function and further develop our enterprise-wide approach to risk management. This is a newly established leadership role with a broad global mandate. You will bring an independent, enterprise-wide perspective on risk, ensuring that risk insight is embedded in strategic and commercial decision-making and supports SoftwareOne as the business continues to evolve. A central part of the role is to shape the next stage of SoftwareOne’s risk maturity, building a forward-looking, data-led and technology-enabled function that combines effective governance with practical business partnership and strengthens risk ownership across the organization. You will work closely with executive leadership and the Audit Committee, while collaborating across Finance, Legal, Compliance, Information Security, Data Protection, and Internal Audit. This is a hands-on, high-energy role for a leader who wants to be judged on measurable impact: you will personally shape the models, challenge the numbers, and tell the risk story to the Board.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own and continuously evolve SoftwareOne's enterprise risk management framework, risk appetite, tolerances and taxonomy, maintaining a consolidated view of strategic, operational, financial, technology, regulatory and emerging risks
  • Provide independent oversight and constructive challenge across the Group, monitoring risk exposure against appetite and ensuring timely escalation of material risks and breaches to executive and Board-level stakeholders
  • Strengthen forward-looking risk management through quantitative risk assessment (including financial quantification of principal risks and loss ranges, e.g., Monte Carlo simulation), scenario analysis, stress testing, key risk indicators and horizon scanning, bringing risk insight into strategic decisions, major transformations and significant commercial initiatives
  • Oversee the Group’s ICFR program end-to-end, including reporting on overall ICFR effectiveness to the Executive Board and Audit Committee, and provide second-line oversight of internal control and financial compliance frameworks, working closely with Finance and other control functions
  • Develop and mature SoftwareOne’s business continuity, crisis management, and operational resilience capability, while actively applying risk technology, analytics, automation, and AI to improve risk insight and decision-making
  • Lead and develop the Group Risk function and establish effective risk governance, including the Management Risk Committee, executive and Audit Committee reporting, and collaboration across key business functions

What we need to see from you

  • Significant senior leadership experience in enterprise risk management, including leading a second-line risk function within a complex multinational or similarly governed organization
  • A proven track record of designing, building, or significantly maturing ERM frameworks, risk appetite, governance, and executive and Board-level risk reporting, with specific, quantified examples of impact delivered
  • Strong quantitative and analytical risk capabilities, with hands-on experience in risk modelling, scenario analysis, stress testing, key risk indicators, and data-led decision support
  • Strong knowledge of internal control and financial compliance frameworks, including hands-on experience building, overseeing, or assessing ICFR, SOX, or equivalent programs
  • Sound independent judgement and credibility when engaging and constructively challenging senior executives, Audit or Risk Committees, and Boards, combined with a pragmatic and commercially minded approach to risk
  • An energetic, hands-on and technology-forward approach, with a bias for action and the ability to personally build risk models, drive new capabilities, and apply GRC technology, analytics, automation, and AI to strengthen risk management and decision-making
  • Strong communication and storytelling skills, with the ability to translate complex quantitative, operational, and financial risks into clear, compelling narratives for senior audiences

What's On Offer

  • The opportunity to shape and mature SoftwareOne’s Group Risk function with a mandate covering ERM, risk appetite, financial control oversight, resilience, risk data, and reporting
  • Direct engagement with the Executive Board and Audit Committee, with the independence to provide objective challenge and escalate material risks where required
  • The opportunity to develop a more quantitative and forward-looking approach to risk, incorporating scenario modelling, continuous monitoring, analytics, and risk-sensing capabilities
  • Influence across strategic decisions including M&A and integration, major transformation, new products and markets, large deals, and technology and AI adoption
  • The mandate to advance SoftwareOne’s risk technology environment, including an integrated risk platform, automated KRI feeds, dashboards, continuous monitoring, and responsible use of AI
  • The opportunity to build and develop a multidisciplinary Group Risk team spanning enterprise risk, financial compliance, risk data and reporting, with business continuity and resilience capability planned as the function develops to be added as the functions develops, subject to confirmation

⚙️ Omnichannel & Back-Office Automation

Speria is looking for a hands-on Cloud Engineer to support customer-facing Microsoft Azure environments across EMEA. This role combines cloud infrastructure engineering, systems administration, production operations, deployment support, and direct customer interaction. You will help build new environments, keep live platforms healthy, troubleshoot customer-impacting issues, and improve reliability through monitoring, automation, documentation, and repeatable operating practices.

  • Support customer onboarding, environment provisioning, implementations, go-lives, production cutovers, and post-deployment stabilization.

  • Monitor environment health, availability, performance, capacity, and cloud cost signals; identify and drive improvement opportunities.

  • Troubleshoot infrastructure, connectivity, database, performance, and Azure platform issues affecting live customer environments.

  • Review logs and monitoring data, identify root causes, resolve issues independently where possible, and escalate effectively when development or other specialists are needed.

  • Automate repetitive operational and administrative work with PowerShell.

  • Improve alerts, monitoring coverage, runbooks, standards, documentation, and repeatable operating procedures.

  • Work directly with customer IT teams on Azure, networking, security, connectivity, deployment, and incident-related needs.

  • Partner across Engineering, Infrastructure, Projects, Product, Development, and customer-facing teams.

  • Participate in occasional after-hours or weekend work when required for approved customer go-lives or production cutovers.

What You Bring

  • 5+ years of experience in cloud infrastructure engineering, systems engineering, infrastructure operations, or a related technical role.

  • Strong hands-on Microsoft Azure experience in production environments.

  • Experience with Azure networking, compute, storage, identity, monitoring, and security.

  • Proficiency with PowerShell scripting and automation, supported by practical examples.

  • Windows Server and systems administration experience.

  • Experience supporting production systems, customer-facing applications, hosted cloud environments, or B2B SaaS platforms.

  • Reliable deployment and support of customer Azure environments.

  • Successful customer onboarding, go-live, and post-deployment stabilization.

  • Timely, well-communicated resolution of infrastructure, networking, connectivity, and platform issues.

  • Strong collaboration with internal teams and customer IT stakeholders.

Job Title:

Clinical Financial Case Mgr - RN

Department:

Health System Shared Services | Revenue Cycle Clinical Support

Scope of Position

Revenue Cycle Clinical Support Office (RCCS) is an area within Access and Revenue Cycle Management Shared Services responsible for Clinical Pre-Certification, Case Reviews, Pre-billing edits, in-patient account validations, supporting Utilization Management, Peer to Peer processes, complex billing scenarios, audits (governmental, commercial, compliance, and internal), clinical appeals and denial management. RCCS is integral to the Revenue Cycle and supports cash collection through preventing and appealing denials.


Position Summary

The Clinical Financial Case Manager - RN (CFCM-RN) implements and supports the philosophy, mission, values, standards, policies, and procedures of The Ohio State University Wexner Medical Center. The CFCM-RN functions within the multidisciplinary team to secure complex pre-authorizations and prevent/appeal clinical denials. The job duties require the utilization of clinical knowledge to interpret and apply medical necessity guidelines to determine appropriateness for services provided. The CFCM-RN makes determinations on the appropriate level of care (Inpatient or Observation) based on the ability to read, understand, and interpret documented clinical


information. The role requires CFCM-RNs to become Subject Matter Experts (SME) for assigned payers as well as governmental payer requirements and audits such as RAC, MAC, QIO, etc. The CFCM-RN maintains an awareness of State and National Health care trends, JCAHO, CMS, and third-party payer Utilization Management guidelines.


The Financial aspect of the role involves acquiring knowledge of Managed Care, Scheduling, Financial Counseling, Pre-Certification, Admissions/Discharges/Transfers, Clinical workflows and documentation, Revenue Management, Charge Description Master, Coding (Diagnosis, HCPCS, Revenue Codes, Procedure Codes, Modifiers, etc.), Medical Information Management, Release of Information, Case Management, Utilization Management, Clinical Documentation Improvement, Compliance, Legal, Finance, Transplant workflows, Billing, Follow Up, Cash Posting, and any other areas that maybe needed to complete the tasks. The CFCM-RN must be able to read, understand and interpret a payer remit, denial/remark codes, and expected reimbursement to determine the cost effectiveness of completing an appeal.


The CFCM-RN must be versatile, flexible, and very adaptable to change because the payer rules change constantly. The CFCM-RN must be able to troubleshoot, problem solve, continuously learn, be highly independent, self-motivated and have an elevated level of interpretive skills and the ability to work closely with departments such as Legal, Medical Information Management, Physician groups and the Business Office.

plan of care.

Must be able to orientate self to new applications quickly. Summary

This is a quality engineering role responsible for ensuring the reliability and performance of Genesys’ internal Contact Center as a Service (CCaaS) platform built on Genesys Cloud. As part of the IT Platform Development team, you’ll own and evolve our test automation framework and combine automated and manual testing across voice, digital, and AI-driven experiences. Working in an agile environment, you’ll partner closely with developers to validate flows, bots, and integrations so that every release is high quality, safe, and repeatable.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own, maintain, and evolve the test automation framework for Genesys’ internal Genesys Cloud CCaaS platform, including architecture, coding standards, reusable libraries, and reporting.
  • Design, build, and execute automated test suites for voice, digital (chat, messaging, email), and AI-driven experiences, including Architect flows, bot flows, and integrations.
  • Perform targeted manual and exploratory testing where automation is not practical, including end-to-end call and conversation validation.
  • Test AI capabilities such as conversational bots, intent recognition, knowledge surfacing, summarization, and agentic AI workflows for accuracy, consistency, and regression.
  • Validate routing, queue, IVR, and data action behavior, as well as REST API integrations with platforms such as ServiceNow.
  • Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines to enable continuous testing and safe, repeatable releases.
  • Partner with developers, the product owner, and the manager in an agile environment to refine acceptance criteria, estimate effort, and plan sprint test deliverables.
  • Create and maintain test plans, test cases, and test data; track defects through resolution and drive root cause analysis.
  • Drive UAT by partnering with stakeholders to validate business outcomes.
  • Report on test coverage, quality metrics, and release readiness to stakeholders.
  • Maintain clear documentation for the framework, test assets, and testing procedures.

Minimum Requirements

  • 5+ years of hands-on experience in test automation, including building or maintaining an automation framework.
  • Proven experience testing contact center solutions (voice and digital channels), such as IVR, routing, ACD, and agent desktop workflows.
  • Proficiency in at least one programming or scripting language used for automation (Python, Java, JavaScript, or TypeScript).
  • Experience with test automation tools and frameworks such as Selenium, Playwright, Cypress, or equivalent.
  • Experience with API testing using tools such as Postman, REST Assured, or similar, with working knowledge of REST, JSON, and OAuth.
  • Solid understanding of manual testing techniques, test design, and the full software testing life cycle.
  • Experience working in agile/Scrum teams and with tools such as Jira.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and Git-based source control.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills; ability to debug complex, multi-system issues.
  • Excellent communication and teamwork skills across distributed teams.
  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, or related discipline, or equivalent experience.

Desirable Skills

  • Hands-on experience with Genesys Cloud, including Architect, bot flows, Data Actions, and the Genesys Cloud APIs/SDKs.
  • Experience testing AI and conversational systems, including NLU models, LLM-based features, and voice bots.



Working at Genesys

  • A flexible-first culture – Join a global team of nearly 7,000 employees with flexible ways of working designed to help people do their best work.

Learn more about our culture, AI innovation and sustainability commitments through our Careers site and Sustainability Report.


What Happens After You Apply

Be the one building what's next - where AI, experience and impact come together.

jobs.description:
About the Role

We are looking for a confident, persuasive and emotionally intelligent Healthcare Sales & Intake Consultant to join a growing healthcare lead management and intake operation.

Our client is a US-based marketing agency specialising in generating enquiries for Applied Behaviour Analysis (ABA) therapy providers through Google and Facebook advertising. They are expanding their services to help ABA therapy providers manage incoming enquiries, connect with prospective families and convert leads into completed patient intakes.

In this role, you will be the first point of contact for parents enquiring about therapy services for their children. Your responsibility will be to respond to incoming leads promptly, understand each family's needs, explain the relevant provider's services, address questions and concerns, and guide parents through the intake process.

This is a sales-driven position that requires more than simply answering calls. You will need to build trust, demonstrate empathy, handle objections confidently and consistently follow up with prospective families to improve lead conversion.

You will work across multiple healthcare providers, managing enquiries through separate CRM systems and phone numbers for each client.

The ideal candidate has a strong background in inbound sales, insurance sales, healthcare sales or consultative telesales, with the ability to turn enquiries into meaningful conversations and successful conversions.

Requirements

Key Responsibilities

1. Inbound Lead Management & Response

  • Monitor incoming leads from Google, Facebook and other digital advertising channels.
  • Contact prospective families promptly after receiving an enquiry.
  • Make outbound calls to parents who have submitted enquiries but have not yet responded.
  • Manage incoming calls and respond to questions about the provider's services.
  • Prioritise new enquiries to ensure quick response times and minimise missed opportunities.

2. Sales & Lead Conversion

  • Build rapport and establish trust with parents and prospective families.
  • Understand the family's needs and determine whether the provider's services are suitable.
  • Clearly explain the relevant ABA provider's services and intake process.
  • Confidently handle questions, concerns and objections.
  • Use persuasive but empathetic communication to encourage parents to move forward.
  • Guide prospective families through the intake forms and encourage completion.
  • Consistently follow up with interested families to improve conversion rates.
  • Identify qualified leads and hand them over to the relevant provider for the next stage.

3. Follow-Up & Relationship Management

  • Maintain regular contact with prospective families who have not completed their intake.
  • Schedule follow-up calls and ensure no promising enquiries are overlooked.
  • Adapt communication based on each family's circumstances and level of interest.
  • Maintain a professional, patient and supportive approach throughout the process.

4. CRM Administration & Documentation

  • Manage leads across multiple client-specific CRM systems.
  • Use separate calling systems and phone numbers for each ABA provider.
  • Accurately document conversations, enquiries, outcomes and follow-up activities.
  • Update lead statuses and maintain organised records.
  • Ensure all relevant information is captured before transferring qualified leads to the provider.
  • Maintain accurate and consistent reporting across assigned accounts.

5. Performance & Reporting

  • Meet expected response times and daily call activity targets.
  • Monitor lead engagement, contact rates and conversion progress.
  • Maintain accurate records of qualified leads and completed intakes.
  • Participate in call reviews, coaching and performance calibration sessions.
  • Use feedback and call assessments to continuously improve communication and conversion results.

Minimum Requirements

  • Approximately 5 years of experience in sales, telesales, inbound sales or lead conversion is preferred.
  • Strong experience handling inbound enquiries and outbound follow-up calls.
  • Proven ability to convert enquiries into sales, appointments or completed applications.
  • Excellent verbal English communication skills with a confident and professional telephone manner.
  • Strong objection-handling, negotiation and persuasive communication skills.
  • Ability to build rapport and establish trust quickly over the phone.
  • Emotionally intelligent, patient and empathetic when dealing with parents and families.
  • Comfortable following sales scripts while keeping conversations natural and engaging.
  • Strong follow-up, organisational and time-management skills.
  • Good computer literacy and experience working with CRM systems.
  • Ability to work independently and manage multiple client accounts.
  • Comfortable working towards measurable sales and conversion targets.

Advantageous Experience

  • Medical aid or health insurance sales.
  • Life insurance or other consultative insurance sales.
  • Healthcare or medical call centre experience.
  • Patient admissions, medical intake or appointment conversion.
  • Experience selling services rather than purely transactional products.
  • Previous experience working with US-based clients.
  • Exposure to ABA therapy, behavioural health or paediatric healthcare.

A formal college degree is not essential. Relevant sales experience, communication ability and proven conversion skills are more important.

Software & Systems

  • Client-provided CRM platforms.
  • Client-provided calling and telephone systems.
  • Call recording and quality monitoring tools.
  • Multiple CRM environments and client-specific phone numbers.

Training will be provided on the relevant systems, scripts, services and intake procedures.

Working Hours & Coverage

This is a remote position supporting US-based healthcare providers.

Coverage is required during the following US business hours:

Weekday coverage:

  • Monday to Friday.
  • Coverage runs from approximately 7:30 AM Eastern Time to 9:00 PM Eastern Time.
  • Two staggered shifts will provide coverage, with a 30-minute overlap for handovers and continuity.

Sunday coverage:

  • Sundays, approximately 10:00 AM to 5:00 PM Eastern Time.
  • Sunday coverage will be supported through a dedicated representative and backup arrangements.

Important scheduling requirements:

  • Candidates must be comfortable working US-aligned shifts.
  • Sunday availability is required as part of the overall team coverage.
  • Flexibility during the December holiday period is important to ensure consistent service coverage.
  • No specific public holiday arrangements have been confirmed.

Performance Expectations

Success in this role will be measured against the following:

  • Speed of response to new incoming leads.
  • Number of calls and follow-up attempts completed.
  • Number of prospective families successfully contacted.
  • Quality of conversations and objection handling.
  • Number of qualified leads generated.
  • Completed intake forms and lead conversion rates.
  • Accuracy of CRM documentation and follow-up records.
  • Attendance, reliability and adherence to scheduled coverage.

Calls will be recorded and periodically reviewed for quality assurance, coaching and performance improvement.

The Ideal Candidate

We are looking for someone who is:

  • Naturally persuasive and confident on the phone.
  • Empathetic and emotionally intelligent, particularly when speaking to parents seeking support for their children.
  • A strong communicator who knows how to guide a conversation without sounding scripted.
  • Resilient and comfortable handling objections or hesitant prospects.
  • Proactive and persistent with follow-ups.
  • Commercially minded and motivated by achieving measurable results.
  • Resourceful, independent and able to think beyond a script.
  • Highly organised when managing multiple clients and enquiries.
  • Reliable and comfortable working remotely with minimal day-to-day supervision.

We are looking for a sales-driven individual who understands that every enquiry is an opportunity to build trust, provide guidance and convert interest into action.

jobs.title: Senior iOS Developer - Swift, Kotlin Multiplatform & AI Coding
jobs.excerpt: Location: 100% Remote Employment: Full-time, long-term position Start date: As soon as possible after selection and agreement Salary: Based on experience, technical expertise, and level of responsibility About UsWe are developing a mobile application that combines real-world interactions with location and proximity technologies.
jobs.description:
Location: 100% Remote
Employment: Full-time, long-term position
Start date: As soon as possible after selection and agreement
Salary: Based on experience, technical expertise, and level of responsibility

About Us

We are developing a mobile application that combines real-world interactions with location and proximity technologies. Our team uses AI coding tools and autonomous coding agents to accelerate development, improve our engineering workflows, and build practical knowledge across the team.

We are looking for a senior developer who can take ownership of iOS development, deliver reliable software, and help our team become more effective at building applications with AI.

Job Description

We are seeking an experienced Senior iOS App Developer with an excellent background in native iOS development using Swift and SwiftUI, together with practical experience integrating Kotlin Multiplatform into iOS applications.

This is a hands-on engineering role. You will develop and improve our iOS application, integrate shared application logic, solve complex technical problems, and establish effective workflows for AI-assisted and agentic development.

Experience with GPS, Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE), Ultra-Wideband (UWB), or related location and proximity technologies would be particularly valuable.

You will also share your knowledge with our internal team, including mentoring a junior team member who is learning to build mobile applications through AI-assisted development, often referred to as “vibe coding.”

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop, maintain, and improve our native iOS application using Swift and SwiftUI.
  • Integrate Kotlin Multiplatform modules into the iOS application and collaborate on shared business logic.
  • Implement platform-specific functionality while maintaining consistent behavior across iOS and Android.
  • Implement and troubleshoot location and proximity features involving GPS, BLE, UWB, and related device capabilities.
  • Address practical iOS challenges such as permissions, application lifecycle, background execution, battery consumption, and device compatibility.
  • Use AI coding assistants and coding agents extensively to implement features, investigate defects, refactor code, and support testing.
  • Set up and improve agentic development workflows, including task decomposition, project context, automated checks, and review processes.
  • Review and validate AI-generated code, taking responsibility for its correctness, maintainability, security, and performance.
  • Test relevant functionality on real devices and investigate issues that automated tests alone may not reveal.
  • Mentor our junior team member through practical demonstrations, pair programming, and clear explanations.
  • Support application signing, release preparation, and distribution through TestFlight and the App Store.
  • Document important technical decisions and share reusable knowledge with the internal team.

Required Qualifications

  • Demonstrated senior-level experience delivering and maintaining production iOS applications.
  • Excellent practical knowledge of Swift, SwiftUI, and the iOS development ecosystem.
  • Practical experience with Kotlin Multiplatform and its integration into native iOS applications.
  • Solid understanding of application architecture, asynchronous programming, lifecycle management, and state management.
  • Strong debugging skills across application code, shared modules, APIs, and device behavior.
  • Substantial hands-on experience using AI coding tools to deliver working software.
  • A strong interest in agentic coding and the ability to establish effective development workflows around coding agents.
  • The ability to assess AI-generated solutions critically and explain technical decisions.
  • Willingness and ability to teach less experienced team members patiently and clearly.
  • The ability to work independently, communicate progress clearly, and take ownership of results in a remote team.
  • Interest in a long-term, full-time position and availability to start promptly after an agreement is reached.

Especially Valuable Experience

  • GPS positioning, location accuracy, geofencing, and sensor data.
  • BLE discovery, advertising, connections, and proximity detection.
  • UWB ranging, distance measurement, direction estimation, and hardware compatibility.
  • NFC and other device-to-device interactions.
  • Interoperability between Swift and Kotlin Multiplatform, including asynchronous operations and error handling.
  • Building automated development and testing workflows that combine human oversight with coding agents.

What We Offer

  • A fully remote, full-time role with a long-term perspective.
  • Compensation based on your experience, expertise, and responsibilities.
  • Ownership of meaningful iOS development work.
  • The opportunity to shape how our team uses AI and coding agents.
  • Close collaboration with an internal team that wants to learn from your experience.

Remote Working Arrangement

Our remote working setup includes a time-tracking tool that records mouse-click and keyboard-activity metrics and captures screenshots of the screen. This monitoring is part of the working arrangement and will be explained during the recruitment process.

Applicants should be comfortable working with this setup.

How to Apply

Please submit your CV and a short overview of relevant projects.

Include:

  • Your role in developing and releasing iOS applications.
  • Your experience integrating Kotlin Multiplatform into native iOS projects.
  • Any practical experience with GPS, BLE, UWB, or similar technologies.
  • The AI coding tools and agentic workflows you use, with an example of how they helped you deliver a working application or feature.
  • Your experience mentoring junior developers or colleagues learning AI-assisted development.
  • Your earliest start date and salary expectations.

Public portfolio links, App Store references, or GitHub links are welcome where available.

Medik8 is a UK-based clinical skincare company dedicated to delivering high-quality, results-driven products backed by scientific research and innovation. With a strong global presence and an exciting high-growth trajectory - particularly in the US - Medik8 continues to push boundaries in clinical skincare.

The Sales & Training Executive (STE) is the face of Medik8 within the retail space. You will be responsible for driving "sell-through" by educating premium beauty retailers on our CSA Philosophy (Vitamin C, Sunscreen, Vitamin A) and ensuring our brand presence is flawless. You will manage a territory of high-volume doors, building deep relationships with Store Leadership to ensure Medik8 is the #1 recommended clinical brand on the floor, while actively managing budget and team performance to meet strategic goals.

Key Responsibilities

1. Sales Strategy & Commercial Growth

  • Own the sales performance of your territory, delivering target KPIs and achieving the overall Sales Plan.

  • In partnership with leadership, develop and execute the territory strategy and event door strategy to achieve retailer sales targets and provide Year-Over-Year growth, with a focus on maximizing ROI.

  • Analyze weekly sell-through reports to identify opportunities and gaps. Analyze sell-out trends and report monthly on sales KPIs.

  • Plan and execute high-impact "Event Days" and "Brand Takeovers" to drive traffic and conversion, ensuring sales targets and ROI benchmarks are achieved.

  • Strategically manage your calendar to prioritize Top doors and high-potential locations.

  • Define and manage the customer experience at the point of sale.

2. Education & Training (The "CSA" Expert)

  • Execute high-impact ESVs (Education & Sales Visits), "shoulder-to-shoulder" training on the sales floor, distilling Medik8’s complex science into digestible, sales-driven "hooks."

  • Lead "Cluster Trainings" and "Morning Briefings" to inspire premium beauty retail staff, where available.

  • Master the "Vitamin A Ladder"—educating staff on how to transition customers from Retinol to Retinaldehyde (Crystal Retinal).

JOB ROLE: Client Project Manager

About the role:

We’re looking for a commercially driven Client Project Manager who can win new clients, turn enquiries into confirmed work and grow long-term client relationships within property maintenance and refurbishment.

You’ll take ownership of your client portfolio—from identifying opportunities and preparing competitive quotes to negotiating with suppliers and subcontractors, overseeing delivery and ensuring payment. Success means winning profitable work, delivering on your promises and giving clients reasons to come back.

We’re building our own system with AI and automations to reduce routine administration and help our team work more effectively. This will give you more time to focus on sales, client relationships and commercial decisions.

We want someone who already uses tools such as ChatGPT, actively explores new AI capabilities and is keen to help improve how we work. You’ll also bring practical trade knowledge and a commitment to keep learning about property maintenance and refurbishment.

Key responsibilities:

Win work and grow client accounts

  • Proactively identify and win new clients through outbound sales, referrals and networking.
  • Convert inbound enquiries into booked work through responsive communication, persuasive proposals and consistent follow-up.
  • Build strong client relationships, understand their properties and priorities, and become their trusted point of contact.
  • Generate new quote opportunities by identifying maintenance and refurbishment needs within existing accounts.
  • Follow up confidently, handle objections and move opportunities towards a decision.
  • Take ownership of your sales pipeline, quote conversion and client revenue growth.

Build competitive, profitable quotes

  • Understand client requirements and coordinate engineers, subcontractors or suppliers for surveys and specialist input where needed.
  • Prepare clear, itemised quotes with accurate scope, pricing and exclusions.
  • Negotiate competitive prices, availability and terms with suppliers and subcontractors while maintaining quality and protecting profit margins.
  • Develop a reliable supply chain and build relationships that support competitive pricing and dependable delivery.
  • Use your trade knowledge to challenge costs, identify gaps and propose practical solutions.
  • Seek technical advice where needed before committing to a scope or price.

Own the client experience and project delivery

  • Act as the client’s main point of contact throughout the job lifecycle.
  • Coordinate engineers, subcontractors, materials and access so work runs smoothly.
  • Ensure work is allocated to the right trade, location and availability.
  • Provide clear work instructions and keep clients informed of progress.
  • Resolve issues proactively and escalate when necessary.
  • Verify completed work through photos, client feedback and completion checks.
  • Agree changes to scope and additional costs before extra work proceeds.

Manage invoicing, profitability and payments

  • Ensure jobs are invoiced within 24 hours of completion.
  • Follow up on outstanding payments and resolve billing queries promptly.
  • Monitor project profitability and identify where costs or scope changes affect margins.
  • Take responsibility for commercial outcomes, from the initial enquiry through to payment.

Use AI and automation to improve productivity

  • Use tools such as ChatGPT to support quote drafting, client communication, meeting preparation and sales follow-up.
  • Check AI-generated outputs for accuracy, particularly technical scope, costs and commitments to clients.
  • Learn and adopt our own system as its AI and automation capabilities develop.
  • Identify opportunities to reduce repetitive work and improve speed, accuracy and the client experience.
  • Keep up with useful developments in AI, test practical applications and share improvements with the team.
  • Keep client, opportunity and job records accurate, and use approved tools responsibly.

Keep developing your trade knowledge

  • Continually build your understanding of maintenance and refurbishment trades, materials, labour requirements and pricing.
  • Learn from engineers, suppliers and completed projects to improve future quotes and decisions.
  • Ask practical questions, recognise gaps in your knowledge and seek specialist input when needed

How we measure success:

    • New clients won and quote opportunities generated.
    • Revenue and gross profit growth.
    • Quote conversion rates and turnaround times.
    • Repeat business and client retention.
    • Jobs booked and quality of project delivery.
    • Timely invoicing and payment collection.

Requirements

  • At least two years’ experience in property maintenance, refurbishment or a closely related trade services business.
  • A track record of winning work, converting quotes or growing client accounts.
  • Strong sales and relationship-building skills, with the confidence to approach new clients and develop repeat business.
  • Confident negotiation skills and a sound understanding of pricing, costs and profit margins.
  • Practical trade knowledge and a commitment to continually developing it.
  • Hands-on experience using ChatGPT or similar AI tools, with examples of how they improve your productivity.
  • Curiosity about AI and a willingness to keep learning and adapting as our systems evolve.
  • Experience coordinating clients, engineers, suppliers and subcontractors.
  • Strong organisation, clear written and verbal communication, and reliable follow-through.
  • Confidence using CRM systems, job tracking software and Microsoft Office.
  • Experience working towards targets, participating in daily stand-ups and contributing to process improvements.
  • A proactive approach—you follow up, solve problems and take responsibility for results.
  • A degree in any field and occasional weekend availability are advantages.

Additional requirements for remote roles

You must have:

  • Your own well-specified computer: A reliable, modern computer capable of smoothly running multiple business applications, AI tools and video calls at the same time.
  • Two screens: A dual-screen setup suitable for managing quotes, client communications and job information efficiently.
  • A good-quality camera: A webcam that provides a clear, professional image for client and team video calls.
  • A good-quality headset: Headphones with a clear microphone, suitable for regular calls.
  • Fast, reliable internet: A stable connection that supports uninterrupted video calls and cloud-based systems.
  • A suitable home office: A dedicated, quiet and professional workspace where you can focus and take client calls without interruptions.
  • Availability aligned with UK operations: The ability to work agreed hours supporting our UK clients and delivery teams.

You must be comfortable working independently, staying accessible to colleagues and clients, and taking ownership of your targets and results.

Benefits

  • Competitive base salary with an uncapped bonus scheme.
  • Profit-sharing scheme.
  • Career development opportunities as the business grows across the UK and Dubai.
  • The opportunity to contribute to a business building its own AI-powered systems and automations.
  • A collaborative, performance-driven culture with clear targets and ownership of results.

jobs.description:
Overview

Product Owner, Digital Sales Solutions

Location: UK-based role

Contract: Permanent, Full Time

Salary: Up to £60,000 (depending on skills and experience)

About The Role

This is a product owner role within Thumbprint, Avidity Group's data and analytics agency, working with our Head of Product. You'll own our Digital Sales Solutions products end to end, from an incentivised activation platform through to an AI-powered digital sales rep, turning strategy into a working, revenue-generating product and a roadmap the business is investing in.

This is a commercial role first. You'll own the P&L, agree terms with technology partners and support client pitches, rather than run a backlog for an in-house development team. You need to be as comfortable negotiating with a partner as you are explaining the product to a client.

The product won't sit still either. It starts as a rewards platform and evolves into one run by digital sales reps using AI. If you want one finished product to maintain, this isn't it. If you want to take a product from early stage to scale through that change, it is.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own and evolve the Digital Sales Solutions roadmap, turning strategy into a sequenced set of product decisions and dependencies
  • Make the incentive activation platform commercially healthy, working with our partner and client leads on activation types, pricing and onboarding new clients
  • Own the requirements and success measures for our digital sales rep, and work with a partner to get an MVP live in proof of concept with named clients
  • Use those proofs of concept to build a proposition that scales, delivering ROI for clients and commercial value for Avidity
  • Own day-to-day partner relationships: commercial terms, service levels, and what we take from partners versus build ourselves
  • Own the P&L logic, including pricing, margin per line item and the volume assumptions behind the business case
  • Set and own the measurement standard: activation and redemption rates, cost per influenced outlet and incremental volume per pound, benchmarked against the cost of a physical call using EPOS data
  • Make sure data governance and consent handling meet the standard we and our clients expect
  • Coordinate internal teams and partners against the roadmap, keeping the Head of Product, client leads and the Exec updated without them needing to oversee every workstream
  • Support client pitches where product input strengthens the case
  • Share best practice across the business to speed up adoption

What We're Looking For

  • Product ownership experience taking an early-stage product through to commercial scale, ideally in a platform, marketplace or partner-dependent model
  • Comfortable owning a product P&L
  • Experience managing a third-party technology or data partner where the commercial and technical relationship matter equally
  • Strong stakeholder management, with the ability to get delivery resource that reports elsewhere moving at the pace the roadmap needs
  • Working knowledge of AI agent-based products and what changes when a workflow moves from human-run to agent-run
  • Decisive enough to close open decisions rather than let them drift
  • Experience in FMCG, retail or field marketing is desirable, ideally with exposure to convenience or on-trade
  • A background in incentive, loyalty or rewards platforms is desirable
  • Exposure to EPOS or outlet-level retail data is a bonus
  • Experience building a business case that compares a new digital channel against an existing physical one would be ideal

What's In It For You?

  • We champion equality & inclusivity and are passionate about creating a workplace that promotes and values diversity
  • 23 days holiday per annum & bank holidays, with the option to purchase up to 5 extra days
  • Family-friendly policies, including enhanced maternity, paternity, and smart working options
  • Flexible working to support work/life balance
  • Access to mental health and wellbeing support through our Employee Assistance Programme
  • Annual pay reviews, early pay access, life assurance, enhanced sick pay, health cash plan, discounted private health care & more
  • Fantastic progression opportunities across the Avidity Group

Here at Avidity, we want to support you in your career. It's the performance and engagement of our people who make this an amazing place to work. Our employees are everything to us and that's why we make sure everyone enjoys continuous support, great perks and excellent career opportunities. We work really hard to create an open, honest, high performing & diverse culture. We think that's reflective in the results we deliver, which have enabled the strong partnerships we have with our clients.

At Arctic Wolf, we’re on a mission to end cyber risk.

The Director, Field Marketing is responsible for driving qualified pipeline growth and revenue outcomes across North America through integrated field, partner, alliance, and account-based marketing strategies. This leader serves as the connective tissue between Sales, Channel, Alliances, SDRs, Marketing Operations, Demand Generation, and Product Marketing, ensuring investments, programs, messaging, and resources are aligned to business priorities and measurable outcomes.


This role is accountable for optimizing the full revenue funnel, identifying opportunities to improve conversion and efficiency, and leveraging data, technology, and AI-driven insights to maximize impact. The Director leads a high-performing team while continuously evolving the go-to-market approach to drive scalable growth, operational excellence, predictable pipeline creation, and revenue acceleration.


Responsibilities

  • Own North America Field Marketing strategy and execution, aligning investments, campaigns, and programs to qualified pipeline, revenue, and growth objectives.

  • Establish a performance-driven operating model focused on MQL, SQL, Qualified Opportunity, Pipeline, and Revenue contribution rather than activity volume.
  • Drive accountability through data-driven decision making, identifying funnel friction, conversion gaps, and opportunities to improve performance across the buyer journey.
  • Develop scalable processes that leverage AI, automation, predictive analytics, and reporting to improve team productivity, campaign effectiveness, and decision quality.
  • Oversee field, partner, alliance, executive engagement, ABM, and regional growth programs with a focus on increasing buying-group penetration, pipeline progression, and revenue impact.
  • Continuously evaluate program effectiveness and investment allocation, making recommendations to increase funding for top-performing activities and reduce funding for underperforming tactics.
  • Establish closed-loop feedback mechanisms between the field and marketing teams to ensure campaigns, messaging, content, and sales plays are resonating with target audiences and driving business outcomes. Translate field insights, buyer feedback, and performance trends into data-driven recommendations that improve conversion rates, buying-group engagement, qualified pipeline creation, and revenue impact.
  • Serve as the voice of the field by helping Product Marketing, Marketing Operations, and Revenue Marketing understand what is and is not working in prospect and customer conversations, sales motions, partner engagements, and campaign execution.
  • Lead and develop a high-performing team capable of operating strategically, using data to inform decisions, challenge assumptions, and influence business outcomes.
  • Act as a trusted advisor to executive leadership on pipeline creation, territory performance, marketing investment strategy, resource allocation, and growth opportunities.

Who You Are

  • You think in systems, not one-off campaigns.
  • You focus on revenue impact, not activity volume.
  • You continuously challenge how resources, investments, and people are deployed to maximize business outcomes.
  • You leverage data to make decisions and are comfortable challenging assumptions when the results don't support them.
  • You treat AI, automation, and technology as core capabilities that help teams scale and make smarter decisions.
  • You understand that marketing's role is not simply to generate leads, but to create qualified pipeline, accelerate revenue, and influence business outcomes.
  • You build strong partnerships across Sales, Channel, Alliances, SDRs, Product Marketing, and Revenue Marketing teams to achieve shared goals.
  • You push for ideas that stand out, create differentiation, and drive measurable business impact.
  • You effectively connect field insights to marketing strategy, helping shape content, campaigns, sales plays, and investment decisions based on what customers and sellers are actually experiencing.
  • You are equally comfortable discussing territory strategy, funnel conversion, pipeline performance, investment allocation, AI adoption, and team development.

Minimum Qualifications

  • 10+ years of experience in Field Marketing, Revenue Marketing, Demand Generation, Channel Marketing, or related B2B marketing disciplines.
  • 5+ years of experience managing teams of four or more direct reports.
  • Proven experience driving qualified pipeline creation and revenue growth in partnership with Sales, SDR, and Channel organizations.
  • Experience leading regional, enterprise, ABM, partner, and alliance marketing strategies.
  • Strong analytical skills with experience using data to guide investment decisions, resource allocation, and business planning.
  • Experience managing multimillion-dollar budgets and demonstrating measurable return on investment.
  • Familiarity with modern marketing technologies including CRM, marketing automation, intent platforms, ABM platforms, analytics tools, and AI-powered solutions.
  • Demonstrated success leading and developing high-performing teams in fast-paced, high-growth environments.

Preferred Qualifications

On-Camera Policy
To support a fair, transparent, and engaging interview experience, candidates interviewing remotely are expected to be on camera during all video interviews. We understand that technical, bandwidth, or location-related challenges may occasionally prevent video use. If this applies, candidates are required to notify us in advance so we can explore appropriate accommodations.

Benefits


All wolves receive compelling compensation and benefits packages, including:

Security Requirements 

At Arctic Wolf, protecting our people, customers, and data is fundamental to how we operate. All employees are expected to uphold our commitment to security, privacy, and compliance by following internal information security policies, standards, and controls designed to safeguard the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of business, customer, employee, and other confidential information and to support compliance with applicable legal and regulatory requirements.

Depending on the role and where permitted by applicable law, employment may be subject to background verification and additional regulatory, security, or compliance requirements, including obligations related to data protection and export control laws, and authorization requirements where applicable.

Base Salary

The base salary range for this job family is 135,200 to 246,400 USD annually. This range reflects the base pay the company reasonably expects to offer for this position, aligned to the broader job family base pay structure. Actual base pay may vary based on skills, experience, and location, including job family level. In addition to base pay, Arctic Wolf offers variable incentive compensation, new hire equity grants, and a comprehensive benefits package.

Location: 100% Remote

Employment: Full-time, long-term position

Start date: As soon as possible after selection and agreement

Salary: Startup-aligned starting compensation, based on experience and responsibilities, with the potential for substantial growth during the first few years

About UsWe are a startup developing software products, web applications, AI-powered tools, integrations, and business automations across different projects.

Our delivery model combines internal ownership with outsourced development. We work with external developers and specialists, and we need strong technical leadership to turn their contributions into reliable, maintainable software.

AI-assisted and agentic development are central to how we work. We want to move quickly, make sensible technical decisions, and build solutions that our team can understand, operate, and improve.

We are looking for an experienced engineer who wants to join at an early stage, take meaningful responsibility, and grow with the company.

Job DescriptionWe are seeking a Senior AI & Full-Stack Engineer who can develop applications across frontend and backend, integrate AI capabilities, and manage the Linux infrastructure, databases, and deployment processes supporting them.

You should be comfortable taking a project from an initial business requirement through implementation, testing, deployment, and ongoing operation. You will work across different products and internal initiatives, helping us choose practical solutions and deliver them efficiently.

Alongside hands-on engineering, your responsibilities may include leading developers, mentoring less experienced colleagues, coordinating outsourced contributors, and reviewing externally delivered work. Previous team leadership and mentoring experience are therefore important.

This is an opportunity to help establish the engineering foundations of a growing startup and develop into a broader technical leadership position.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain web applications across frontend and backend.
  • Build AI-powered features, integrations, internal tools, and business automations.
  • Use AI coding assistants and coding agents effectively, with appropriate testing and human review.
  • Translate business requirements into clear implementation tasks and verifiable acceptance criteria.
  • Design APIs, business logic, authentication, authorization, and third-party integrations.
  • Manage database schemas, migrations, query performance, backups, and recovery procedures.
  • Administer Linux servers, including application services, permissions, updates, networking, and troubleshooting.
  • Build and maintain Docker environments, including container networking, persistent storage, configuration, and health checks.
  • Manage DNS records, domain routing, TLS certificates, and reverse proxies.
  • Maintain CI/CD workflows using GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps Pipelines, and appropriate build agents or runners.
  • Carry out deployments with migration checks, rollback procedures, and post-deployment verification.
  • Investigate production incidents and address their underlying causes.
  • Coordinate outsourced developers and specialists, clarify requirements, review deliverables, and manage technical dependencies.
  • Mentor developers through code reviews, practical demonstrations, and constructive feedback.
  • Keep implementation proportionate to the problem, controlling unnecessary complexity, infrastructure costs, and maintenance overhead.

Required Qualifications

  • Demonstrated senior-level experience delivering and maintaining production web applications.
  • Strong frontend development skills using a modern framework, JavaScript or TypeScript, HTML, and CSS.
  • Strong backend development experience, including secure APIs, integrations, validation, and error handling.
  • Practical experience integrating AI or LLM capabilities into software, including checking output quality, handling failures, and managing latency and usage costs.
  • Substantial hands-on experience with AI coding assistants or agentic development workflows, with examples of working results you independently verified.
  • Strong SQL and relational database experience, including migrations, indexing, performance analysis, and backup and recovery.
  • Hands-on Linux administration and Docker deployment experience.
  • A working understanding of DNS, HTTP/HTTPS, TLS, firewalls, ports, and reverse proxies.
  • Practical CI/CD experience with GitHub Actions and familiarity with Azure DevOps repositories, pipelines, and build agents.
  • Strong Git, pull-request, code-review, and release-management skills.
  • Previous experience leading a development team or coordinating technical delivery.
  • Proven mentoring experience and the ability to explain technical decisions clearly.
  • Experience working with outsourced developers, contractors, or distributed teams.
  • The ability to work independently, prioritize competing needs, and make sound decisions with a limited startup budget.
  • Interest in a long-term, full-time role with increasing responsibility.

Especially Valuable Experience

  • Building products or engineering processes in an early-stage startup.
  • Taking responsibility for several applications or services at the same time.
  • Evaluating outsourced work for correctness, security, maintainability, and operational readiness.
  • Developing AI agents, tool integrations, retrieval workflows, or reliable automation.
  • Operating PostgreSQL and multi-service Docker environments.
  • Establishing deployment standards, monitoring, incident procedures, and practical documentation.
  • Helping junior developers become more effective through structured mentoring.

Growth, Responsibility and CompensationJoining at this stage offers the opportunity to influence how we build software, organize delivery, and develop our engineering team.

Initial compensation will reflect our startup budget, your experience, and the agreed scope of responsibility. As your contribution and responsibilities grow alongside the business, we aim to provide substantial salary progression during the first few years.

For a strong contributor, the role can develop into positions such as Technical Lead, Engineering Lead, or Head of Engineering. Progression will depend on demonstrated results, leadership capability, company growth, and financial capacity. Compensation expectations and progression milestones will be discussed openly during recruitment.

What We Offer

  • A fully remote, full-time role with a long-term perspective.
  • Direct involvement in technical decisions across multiple products and initiatives.
  • The opportunity to build, lead, and mentor a distributed engineering team.
  • Broad ownership across software, AI integration, infrastructure, and delivery.
  • Close collaboration with startup leadership.
  • The potential for significant career and compensation growth as the company develops.

Remote Working ArrangementOur remote working setup includes a time-tracking tool that records mouse-click and keyboard-activity metrics and captures screenshots of the screen. This monitoring is part of the working arrangement and will be explained during the recruitment process.

Applicants should be comfortable working with this setup.

How to ApplyWe are looking to fill this core engineering role promptly. Applying early gives us the opportunity to discuss how you could help shape our technical direction from the beginning.

Please submit your CV and a short overview covering:

  • A production application you helped deliver and your own frontend and backend contributions.
  • An AI feature or agentic workflow you implemented and how you verified its results.
  • Your Linux, Docker, database, and deployment responsibilities.
  • A team you led or developers you mentored, including the outcomes.
  • Your experience coordinating outsourced development and reviewing external deliverables.
  • Your earliest start date and salary expectations, taking our startup stage into account.

Public portfolio links and GitHub repositories are welcome. Please do not share confidential customer information or credentials.

jobs.title: CRM Manager - Subscription
jobs.excerpt: Salary: £50,000 – £60,000 DOE Location: Remote We’re working with a fast-growing DTC subscription brand in the health and wellness space to appoint a CRM Manager who can take ownership of its customer lifecycle strategy and execution.
jobs.description:
Salary: £50,000 – £60,000 DOE
Location: Remote

We’re working with a fast-growing DTC subscription brand in the health and wellness space to appoint a CRM Manager who can take ownership of its customer lifecycle strategy and execution.

With approximately 90% of revenue coming through subscriptions, CRM and retention are fundamental to the continued growth of the business.

This is a hands-on role for someone who is as comfortable interrogating customer data and developing a retention strategy as they are building complex journeys in Klaviyo.

You won’t be inheriting a finished test plan. You’ll be expected to find the opportunities, form a point of view, build the solution and measure the impact.

The Role

You’ll own the CRM lifecycle end to end, initially as an individual contributor, with the opportunity to grow into a CRM or Retention Lead role as the programme develops.

The role will remain hands-on. You’ll continue to build and optimise alongside taking greater strategic ownership and, over time, potentially leading a team.

What You’ll Own

  • Own the full customer lifecycle in Klaviyo, including welcome and onboarding, product education, replenishment, pre-billing, failed payment, save and skip, and winback journeys

  • Analyse flow, customer and cohort performance to identify where revenue and margin are being lost

  • Build and implement retention strategies based on why customers are cancelling or skipping, rather than relying on blanket save journeys

  • Develop strategies to convert high-intent one-time customers into subscribers

  • Own CRM activity across email, SMS and WhatsApp

  • Manage deliverability, database health and engagement

  • Develop and optimise loyalty programme mechanics, including earn, burn, tiers and redemption journeys

  • Work closely with creative teams to brief and iterate CRM assets based on performance

  • Lead A/B testing across journeys and campaigns, prioritising tests based on commercial impact

  • Develop clear reporting around CRM performance and incremental contribution

How Success Will Be Measured

You’ll have clear commercial ownership, with success focused on:

  • Increasing the contribution margin generated during a customer's first three months, relative to their initial order value.

  • Increasing the proportion of active customers ordering in any given month, capturing the impact of cancellations, skips and changes in purchase frequency.

  • Growing the incremental revenue and margin generated through CRM flows.

What We’re Looking For

We’re looking for someone with genuine Klaviyo expertise, rather than someone who has simply used the platform to send campaigns.

You’ll ideally have:

  • Proven experience owning a CRM programme end to end

  • Deep, hands-on experience with Klaviyo, including complex conditional and branched journeys

  • A strong understanding of flow performance, attribution and incremental revenue

  • Experience working within a subscription-led business

  • Experience with Skio, Recharge or a similar subscription platform

  • A strong understanding of subscriber behaviour, churn and retention

  • A highly analytical approach, with the curiosity to investigate the data before being asked

  • The ability to turn insight into action and personally build and launch your recommendations

  • Strong strategic thinking and the ability to prioritise across multiple opportunities and projects

  • Experience with a loyalty platform would be a strong advantage

  • An independent, structured and fast-moving approach

Why Join?

This is an opportunity to join a growing DTC business at a point where CRM has a genuine opportunity to shape commercial performance, rather than simply support it.

You’ll have significant ownership from day one, with the opportunity to build the CRM function, develop the retention strategy and grow into a broader leadership position as the business scales.

Our client is committed to creating an inclusive and diverse workplace and welcomes applications from candidates of all backgrounds, experiences and perspectives. They believe that a diverse team makes for a stronger business and are committed to ensuring their recruitment process is fair and accessible to everyone.

Please note: Due to the volume of applications, only candidates shortlisted for the next stage will be contacted. If you have not heard from us within two weeks of applying, unfortunately your application has not been successful on this occasion. We appreciate the time taken to apply and thank everyone for their interest.

Location: 100% Remote

Start date: As soon as possible after selection and agreement
