jobs.title: DTC Ecommerce Growth Lead (Contract)
jobs.excerpt: Bulletproof is seeking an experienced DTC Ecommerce Growth Lead for a three-month, full-time contractor engagement to provide interim leadership of Bulletproof.
jobs.description:
Bulletproof is seeking an experienced DTC Ecommerce Growth Lead for a three-month, full-time contractor engagement to provide interim leadership of Bulletproof.com while the current DTC leader is on leave.

This person will be responsible for maintaining business continuity, owning DTC performance, directing agency and internal execution, and identifying near-term growth opportunities across acquisition, retention, subscription, site conversion, merchandising and innovation.

This is not primarily a hands-on production role. The contractor will set priorities, make commercial decisions, challenge assumptions, connect execution to business economics, and hold partners accountable for results.

In summary, this is a three-month, full-time interim leadership assignment with real business ownership. The successful contractor will step into an established DTC business, lead performance and forecasting, oversee a specialized DTC agency, guide paid acquisition across Google and Meta, supervise an experienced ecommerce operator, and help identify the next sources of profitable growth. The expectation is to quickly understand the economics of the business, focus the organization on the few things that matter most, and leave behind a stronger operating system and roadmap than the one inherited.

Additional Information:

  • Hourly contract rate: $50-$75/hour
  • Weekly hours: 30-40 hours per week, planned to start ASAP.
  • This is a fully remote contract role; candidates can be located anywhere within the United States.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Protect business continuity: Ensure forecasting, promotions, launches, site operations, retention programs, paid media and reporting continue without disruption.
  • Own DTC business performance: Maintain clear visibility to revenue, margin, traffic, conversion, AOV, subscriptions, retention and acquisition performance, and proactively identify gaps versus forecast.
  • Lead and hold the contracted agency accountable: Translate Bulletproof priorities into clear agency direction, manage scope and SLAs, prioritize work, challenge recommendations and ensure execution drives measurable business impact.
  • Accelerate the path back to growth: Identify and validate the highest-value revenue opportunities across acquisition, retention, subscription, merchandising, CRO, product prioritization and innovation.
  • Leave the business stronger: Provide documented learnings, decisions, outstanding risks and a prioritized forward roadmap for the returning DTC leader.
  • Weekly S&OE
    • Maintain and update the weekly DTC revenue outlook and item-level forecast.
    • Review actual performance versus forecast and identify risks and opportunities early enough to act.
    • Forecast expected performance by core product/category, promotional period, subscription revenue, paid acquisition contribution and major innovation launches.
    • Incorporate current traffic, conversion, AOV, inventory and media trends into the forecast.
    • Partner with Operations to understand inventory constraints, OOS risks and product availability.
    • Recommend interventions when weekly run rate falls behind expectation.
  • Monthly S&OP / Rolling Forecast
    • Own item-level DTC forecasting, including base business, promotions, subscriptions, innovation and seasonality.
    • Maintain and improve the rolling 12-month forecast rather than rebuilding it unnecessarily during the engagement.
    • Translate changes in demand into inventory, media and commercial actions through monthly S&OP.
    • Document assumptions, upside/downside scenarios, major risks and opportunities.
  • Monthly Business Performance Review
    • Own preparation of the DTC Monthly Business Review and ensure it explains business performance rather than simply reporting activity.
    • Cover revenue vs. plan/LE/prior year; contribution margin; traffic; CVR; AOV; new vs. returning mix; paid acquisition and CAC; subscription adds, active base and churn; repeat purchase; product/category performance; innovation; promotional effectiveness; CRO and creative learnings.
    • Provide a clear executive “So What?” with recommended actions and decisions.
  • Agency Leadership
    • Serve as the primary internal business owner for the agency across retention, CRO, website support, and AIO.
    • Translate business priorities into clear agency briefs and maintain a prioritized roadmap across workstreams.
    • Hold the agency accountable to scope, SLAs, quality standards and agreed business outcomes.
    • Lead business reviews and challenge recommendations that do not align with margin, LTV, inventory, brand strategy or product priorities.
    • Ensure tests generate useful learning and quantified business impact, not activity for activity’s sake.
    • Escalate performance, quality or timing issues appropriately and ensure learnings/documentation remain inside Bulletproof.
  • Paid Media Leadership – Google & Meta
    • Oversee Google and Meta strategy, budget allocation and performance with sufficient technical depth to challenge agencies and operators.
    • Review spend, CAC/nCAC, ROAS, NTB, conversion, revenue and contribution margin through a business-economics lens, not ROAS alone.
    • Evaluate product-level paid media economics and determine which products merit acquisition investment based on margin, conversion, repeat behavior, subscription potential and LTV.
    • Connect acquisition investment to downstream customer quality and retention.
    • Ensure creative testing is concentrated behind strategically prioritized products rather than spread thinly across the portfolio.
  • Retention, CRM & Subscription Strategy
    • Advance the shift from promo-first CRM toward segmented, value-driven lifecycle marketing.
    • Prioritize customer segments based on product affinity, purchase behavior, subscriber status, engagement, LTV and promotion dependency.
    • Monitor whether retention strategy is improving repeat purchase, time to second order, subscription conversion, early subscriber retention and revenue per recipient/customer.
    • Ensure educational content connects to product benefits, routines, replenishment moments and clear buying actions.
    • Monitor subscriber acquisition, first-renewal retention, cancellation and net subscriber trends.
    • Improve subscription attach, cancellation intervention, skip/pause/save behavior and cross-sell/multi-product subscription opportunities.
    • Evaluate subscription offer structures against both margin and churn, and ensure discontinued/OOS products have migration or substitution paths.
  • Promotional Strategy & Effectiveness
    • Own the DTC promotional strategy and calendar, including offer architecture, discount depth, GWP, sampling and subscription offers.
    • Evaluate incremental revenue, contribution margin, customer quality and demand pull-forward to determine which promotions should be repeated, changed or eliminated.
    • Ensure the agency and the internal ecommerce team execute within approved promotional and margin guardrails.
    • Reduce reliance on broad discounting where evidence supports stronger value-led alternatives.
  • Product Prioritization, Merchandising & Innovation
    • Manage discipline around which products receive disproportionate DTC investment.
    • Use product economics, customer demand, repeat behavior, margin and strategic relevance to prioritize paid media, creative, promotions, site placement and CRM support.
    • Define the 5-10 products deserving the greatest commercial support during the engagement.
  • CRO, Site Experience & Senior Ecommerce Specialist Leadership
    • Prioritize the CRO roadmap based on potential business impact; approve test hypotheses and success criteria; review results and make scale / iterate / kill decisions.
    • Guide campaign priorities and ensure landing pages and PDPs reinforce campaign and product priorities.
    • Provide direction, prioritization and support to the Senior Ecommerce Specialist, who owns substantial hands-on execution across Shopify, launches, promotions, subscriptions, merchandising, QA, SEO/AIO implementation and vendor coordination.
    • Set weekly priorities, remove conflicting asks, make trade-offs when capacity is constrained and protect the Specialist from becoming an uncontrolled intake function.
    • Do not absorb or duplicate hands-on Shopify, QA or routine site administration unless business continuity requires temporary intervention.
  • Customer & Cross-Functional Leadership
    • Represent the customer in DTC decisions by connecting quantitative performance with customer behavior, needs and friction points.
    • Ensure channel decisions improve both business economics and the consumer experience.
    • Serve as the DTC connector across Marketing/Brand, Creative, Finance, Operations & Supply Chain, Innovation/Product, Customer Care, IT/ERP, Analytics, the agency and other external partners.
    • Ensure DTC does not operate as an isolated channel and that commercial decisions reflect broader company priorities.
  • 8+ years of experience in DTC ecommerce, growth or digital commerce, with prior ownership of a meaningful ecommerce P&L or revenue target.
  • Strong Shopify-based DTC experience.
  • Demonstrated performance marketing experience across Google and Meta.
  • Strong command of CAC, ROAS, conversion, AOV, contribution margin and LTV.
  • Experience with retention, lifecycle marketing and subscription businesses.
  • Experience managing external ecommerce/performance agencies.
  • Strong forecasting, commercial planning and analytical capability.
  • Experience in consumer products / CPG strongly preferred.

The MA Plan Actuarial Strategic Operations team serves as the operational and financial nerve center for Clover's Medicare Advantage business. Embedded within the Actuarial organization, the team combines deep business expertise with advanced analytics and AI to integrate financial, operational, and actuarial insights, monitor enterprise performance, evaluate strategic initiatives, and deliver timely recommendations that improve affordability, member outcomes, and financial performance.

At Clover, AI is part of how we work. We expect leaders to thoughtfully incorporate tools such as Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, and emerging enterprise AI technologies into their daily workflows to improve analytical quality, accelerate execution, and enable better decisions.

The Senior Manager, Actuarial Strategic Operations serves as the strategic and people leader of Clover’s MA Plan Command Center, leading a team of Actuarial and financial operations professionals responsible for governance, initiative portfolio management, financial integration, performance monitoring, and enterprise decision support across Medicare Advantage.

This role partners across Finance, Actuarial, Clinical, Revenue, Pharmacy, and Operations to assess drivers of performance, align strategy, and ensure enterprise initiatives deliver expected outcomes. As a leader of the Command Center, you will champion automation and AI-enabled ways of working that enhance analytical workflows, reporting, and executive decision support.

This role is accountable for the performance, development, and capacity of the Command Center team. The Senior Manager will translate enterprise priorities into clear team objectives, allocate resources across high-impact work, establish quality and execution standards, and develop the team’s financial, analytical, business partnership, and AI-enabled capabilities.

As a Senior Manager, Actuarial Strategic Operations, you will:

  • Lead the MA Plan Command Center Operating Model: Set the direction and operating standards for Actuarial Strategic Operations, including governance, initiative portfolio management, prioritization, valuation, execution tracking, executive reporting, and continuous improvement of analytical and AI-enabled workflows. Translate enterprise priorities into clear team goals, allocate resources based on business impact and capacity, and ensure the team delivers timely, high-quality decision support.
  • Own Enterprise Performance Monitoring: Lead the team in developing and continuously evolving enterprise performance monitoring frameworks using leading and lagging indicators, dashboards, and KPIs. Establish analytical and quality standards, ensure consistent application across functional areas, and use performance trends to identify risks, prioritize team work, and guide leadership decisions.
  • Lead Financial Integration, AI-Enabled Analysis, and Executive Decision Support: Set the standards for integrating operational, actuarial, and financial performance into clear recommendations for executive leadership. Lead the team in adopting responsible AI-enabled analytical methods that improve speed, rigor, scalability, and decision quality while maintaining appropriate governance, data integrity, and financial discipline. Ensure analyses challenge strategic assumptions, surface material risks and opportunities, and provide actionable options that support enterprise priorities and financial objectives.
  • Drive Cross-Functional Alignment: Serve as the senior Command Center partner to leaders across Finance, Actuarial, Medical Economics, Clinical Operations, Revenue, Pharmacy, Product, and Analytics. Establish clear ownership, decision rights, and accountability across initiatives, resolve competing priorities, and ensure the team’s work is aligned with budgeting, forecasting, strategic planning, and enterprise performance objectives.
  • Scale the Command Center Capability: Lead the team in expanding automation, standardizing processes, strengthening data quality, and implementing AI-enabled solutions that improve reporting, accelerate analysis, reduce manual effort, and scale the Command Center operating model. Ensure new tools and processes are adopted, governed, documented, and sustained across the team.
  • Lead and Develop the Actuarial Strategic Operations Team: Lead, coach, and develop a team of financial operations and Actuarial professionals responsible for complex modeling, analysis, business partnership, and executive decision support. Set clear priorities and performance expectations, allocate work based on business impact and capacity, provide regular feedback and development opportunities, address performance concerns, and build the capabilities needed to support Clover’s evolving Medicare Advantage strategy.

Success in this role looks like:

In your first 90 days

  • You will build strong cross-functional partnerships with business leaders to understand priorities, align on objectives, and establish the Command Center as a trusted strategic partner.
  • You will establish the Command Center reporting framework by defining key performance indicators, leading and lagging metrics, and a consistent reporting cadence across functional areas.
  • You will develop executive dashboards and scorecards that provide timely visibility into initiative performance, financial impact, and execution risks.
  • You will assess team strengths, development needs, workload, and capacity, and establish clear roles, priorities, performance expectations, and operating rhythms.
  • You will establish regular 1:1s, team forums, quality reviews, and development plans that support accountability and team growth.
  • You will clarify how work is allocated across the Command Center and establish standards for financial analysis, modeling, executive reporting, and AI-enabled workflows.

After 6 months

  • You will lead executive operating reviews by delivering clear, data-driven insights on initiative performance, financial impact, emerging risks, and opportunities to senior leadership.
  • You will implement a proactive risk monitoring framework that leverages leading indicators to identify execution gaps early and recommend timely mitigation strategies.
  • You will establish yourself as a trusted strategic partner by providing actionable financial and operational insights that support executive decision-making, enterprise prioritization, and business planning.
  • You will build a high-performing team that consistently delivers rigorous, timely, and actionable financial and operational insights.
  • You will establish clear performance management and development practices, including measurable goals, regular feedback, and defined growth opportunities.
  • You will demonstrate effective delegation and capacity planning across a portfolio of enterprise priorities, adjusting resources as business needs evolve.

Future success in this role includes:

  • Influence enterprise prioritization by providing data-driven insights that inform strategic investment decisions and resource allocation across the Medicare Advantage business.
  • Drive automation and reporting excellence by continuously improving reporting processes, enhancing data quality, and increasing the efficiency and scalability of the Command Center operating model.
  • Establish the Command Center as the enterprise source of truth for initiative performance, execution monitoring, and financial insights that support executive decision-making.
  • Develop a sustainable Command Center talent model with clear roles, strong succession coverage, and the capabilities needed to support Clover’s evolving Medicare Advantage strategy.
  • Create a culture of ownership, analytical excellence, constructive challenge, and continuous improvement across the team.
  • Build team credibility with senior leaders by ensuring consistent quality, sound judgment, and measurable impact across enterprise decisions and initiatives.

You will love this role if:

  • You enjoy solving complex and ambiguous business challenges through data-driven analysis, AI-enabled exploration, and strategic problem solving.
  • You are energized by influencing business strategy through financial insights, rapid experimentation, and actionable recommendations powered by modern analytical and AI tools.

You should get in touch if:

jobs.description:
Job Title: Development Enablement Specialist

Location: Remote

About the Role

Horace Mann is building a structured framework for how software gets developed across the organization, inside IT, across business units, and increasingly with the help of AI. This role stands it up. You'll own the training program, the governance processes, and the day-to-day technical support that lets developers at every level build with confidence and in compliance.

This is a builder role in the truest sense: you'll start with a blank page and end with a functioning program: curriculum, documentation, intake workflows, and a support practice that developers actually want to use.

What You'll Do

In the first six months, you'll primarily be building:

  • Design and develop the tiered developer training program: four cumulative builder tiers (Personal Productivity through Enterprise Solution Lead) plus trigger-based add-on modules covering AI/LLM use, sensitive data handling, privileged access, third-party integrations, and business ownership
  • Document the risk overlay framework: clear, practitioner-facing guidance on what each overlay means, when it applies, and what a developer needs to do differently as a result
  • Build the solution intake and classification process: the workflow that takes a new solution from idea to assigned tier, applied overlays, and approved build path
  • Establish the ongoing compliance model: how training completion is tracked, how access is gated, and how attestations are renewed over time
  • Document development tooling standards and permitted integration catalogs so builders have a single reference for approved tools, registries, and external connections

On an ongoing basis:

  • Provide technical assistance to developers across IT and the business: helping with technical issues both hands-on and through coordination with subject matter experts.
  • Serve as the first point of contact when a developer hits a process or tooling question: triage, resolve, or route to the right team
  • Conduct training sessions, maintain training content as the framework evolves, and track completion against access requirements
  • Execute and maintain intake and compliance processes: solution intake, developer tools, approved packages, and attestations
  • Work with Security, Architecture, Governance, and Data teams to keep overlay documentation and intake processes current as policies and tools change
  • Identify patterns in support requests and use them to improve training content, documentation, and tooling defaults

What You'll Bring

  • Familiarity with modern software development practices: Git, CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps preferred), package management, secrets management, and deployment fundamentals
  • Ability to explain technical concepts clearly to audiences with varying levels of experience, from seasoned engineers to first-time business builders
  • Experience designing or delivering technical training, documentation, or enablement programs
  • Comfort working across teams — you'll partner with Security, Architecture, Governance, and business stakeholders regularly
  • Familiarity with AI development tools and platforms (experience with Claude, GitHub Copilot, or similar is a plus)
  • Strong organizational instincts — you'll be managing curriculum, process documentation, a support queue, and compliance tracking simultaneously

Why This Role Matters

Development is no longer confined to IT. AI assistants, low-code tools, and automation platforms have made builders out of people who wouldn't have called themselves developers two years ago. This role exists to make sure that expansion goes well, that the people building solutions have the skills and support they need, that the guardrails are clear and accessible rather than buried in policy documents, and that IT can say “yes” to more development, faster, because the foundation is solid.

Qualifications

  • 3–5 years of experience in technical training, instructional design, software development, or a related field.
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent work experience.
  • Familiarity with modern software development practices and technologies, including the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC), Git, CI/CD, and AI-assisted development tools.
  • Experience developing and delivering technical training or enablement content.
  • Ability to translate technical concepts into clear, practical guidance for audiences with varying levels of technical expertise.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to work effectively with management, business partners, technical teams, associates, and external resources.
  • Strong organizational and problem-solving skills with the ability to identify and document issues, risks, and dependencies.

Salary Range: $76,600.00 - $106,450.00

  • Salary is commensurate to experience, location, etc.

Horace Mann was founded in 1945 by two Springfield, Illinois, teachers who saw a need for quality, affordable auto insurance for teachers. Since then, we’ve broadened our mission to helping all educators protect what they have today and prepare for a successful tomorrow. And with our broadened mission has come corporate growth: We serve more than 4,100 school districts nationwide, we’re publicly traded on the New York Stock Exchange (symbol: HMN) and we have more than $12 billion in assets.

We’re motivated by the fact that educators take care of our children’s future, and we believe they deserve someone to look after theirs. We help educators identify their financial goals and develop plans to achieve them. This includes insurance to protect what they have today and financial products to help them prepare for their future. Our tailored offerings include special rates and benefits for educators.

EOE/Minorities/Females/Veterans/Disabled. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or protected veteran status

jobs.excerpt: About Life360Life360’s mission is to keep people close to the ones they love.
jobs.description:
About Life360

Life360’s mission is to keep people close to the ones they love. Our category-leading mobile app, Tile tracking devices, and Pet GPS tracker empower members to protect the people, pets, and things they care about most with a range of services, including location sharing, safe driver reports, and crash detection with emergency dispatch. Life360 serves approximately 102.4 million monthly active users (MAU), as of June 30, 2026, across more than 180 countries.

Life360 delivers peace of mind and enhances everyday family life with seamless coordination for all the moments that matter, big and small. By continuing to innovate and deliver for our customers, we have become a household name and the must-have mobile-based membership for families (and those friends who are basically family).

Life360 has more than 500 (and growing!) remote-first employees. For more information, please visit .

Life360 is a Remote First company, which means a remote work environment will be the primary experience for all employees. All positions, unless otherwise specified, can be performed remotely (within the US and Canada) regardless of any specified location above.

We are AI Native

We are building an AI native company where AI is an integral part of how we build and operate. AI tool usage during interviews varies by role. You may be asked to demonstrate proficiency with AI tools, discuss how you leverage AI, or complete interview exercises without AI assistance. Your Recruiter will provide clear guidance as you move through the interview process.

Undisclosed use of AI not previously discussed with or approved by your Recruiter may impact your candidacy.

About The Team

The Product Design team is the creative engine shaping the vision, strategy, and delivery of extraordinary member experiences at Life360. We are a diverse, collaborative group with an unwavering commitment to craftsmanship and delight in everything we create. With Life360’s rapid growth and strong business momentum, we have a unique opportunity to make a meaningful impact at global scale. At the heart of our mission is a dedication to helping families feel safe, connected, and cared for through the transformative power of design.

The Growth Revenue Experimentation team (within the Product Design team) is the engine behind Life360's subscription revenue growth: we turn ideas about pricing, packaging, and the paywall funnel into fast, validated experiments. We run a high volume of tests across the entire subscription funnel - driving free users to start a trial, trial to paid conversion & churn prevention. Additionally, optimizing the top-performing features to drive further conversion, SKU and pricing routing, external billing, and churn and win-back, partnering closely with the Revenue ML team to personalize offers and target the right SKU to the right user. We set and hold the bar for experiment quality and methodology across the program, using tools like Statsig to run and govern testing at scale, and we ground every decision in research and data, validating or killing assumptions before they become a build. We are also an AI-native team: AI tooling is already speeding up how we generate hypotheses, build, and measure results, and we expect that velocity to keep climbing as our own workflows get faster too.

About the Job

We're looking for a Senior Product Designer II to join our Revenue Experimentation team and help drive Life360's growth through fast, high-quality design experimentation. This role sits at the intersection of product design, growth strategy, and data-informed decision-making, you'll design, test, and iterate on experiences across our subscription and monetization surfaces to uncover new ways to grow revenue and deliver value to families. You'll partner closely with Product Managers, Engineers, Data Scientists, and Content to turn loosely defined ideas into well-scoped tests, and well-scoped tests into learnings that shape our roadmap. This role is ideal for someone who thrives on ambiguity, moves fast without sacrificing craft, and wants their design decisions to directly and measurably impact the business.

For candidates based in the US, the salary range for this position is $152k to $223k USD. For candidates based out of Canada, the salary range for this position is $176k to $207k CAD. We take into consideration an individual's background and experience in determining final salary - therefore, base pay offered may vary considerably depending on geographic location, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. The compensation package includes a wide range of medical, dental, vision, financial, and other benefits, as well as equity.

What You’ll Do

  • Design and run a high volume of experiments across Life360's revenue and monetization surfaces, from trial conversion, trial-to-paid conversion to pricing, SKU routing, and churn/win-back.
  • Turn loosely defined experiment briefs into well-scoped, testable hypotheses, using research and data to validate or challenge the underlying assumptions.
  • Lead design for experiments that originate from your own ideas, and act as a critical, PM-partnering voice on ideas that originate elsewhere.
  • Partner with Data Science and Analytics to define success metrics, interpret experiment results, and translate learnings into follow-on hypotheses.
  • Present experiment concepts, in-flight learnings, and results to cross-functional stakeholders and leadership.

What We’re Looking For

  • 6+ years of product design experience, ideally with exposure to growth, experimentation, or subscription/monetization design.
  • A track record of shipping and iterating on A/B or multivariate experiments in a fast-paced, high-velocity environment.
  • Comfort operating with ambiguity, able to take a loosely defined brief and turn it into a well-scoped, testable hypothesis using research or data.
  • A proactive, ideas-first mindset: someone who brings concepts to the table rather than waiting to be handed a fully-formed brief.
  • Strong collaboration skills, able to both lead from your own ideas and constructively pressure-test others', as a true creative and strategic partner to PMs.
  • Experience partnering closely with engineers, content, and data science across the full experiment lifecycle, from concept to bug bash to results.
  • Excellent organizational habits: clean, well-documented Figma files and clear, traceable rationale for design decisions.
  • Fluency in Figma; familiarity with experimentation and analytics tooling (e.g., Optimizely, Amplitude, Statsig, or similar) is a plus.
  • Comfort using AI tools to accelerate design and production work.
  • Strong visual design craft, with hands-on animation skills.
  • A portfolio that showcases experimentation work, problem framing, hypotheses, iteration, and measurable impact, not just polished final screens.

Ways of Working

  • Operates in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, balancing multiple experiments at once.
  • Comfortable with ambiguity. Experiment briefs often start loosely defined, and it's the designer's job to validate the underlying problem (through research or data) and refine it into something well-scoped enough to actually test, confirming or challenging the original assumptions along the way.
  • Contributes ideas proactively, including in regular ideation sessions focused on a specific theme, bringing forward experiment concepts, not just executing others'.
  • Partners with PMs as a true collaborator: leads projects that originate from their own ideas, and acts as a critical partner on PM-originated ideas, pressure-testing them for UX soundness and product fit rather than simply executing.
  • Collaborates across design and other departments when an experiment touches product areas outside their own, to keep the experience consistent and aligned.
  • Keeps work organized and traceable: clean file structure, documented hypotheses and rationale, and clean, well-organized Figma files so anyone can see what's being tested, what's been done, and why.
  • Involves engineers early in the design process to surface technical questions and constraints before they become blockers.
  • Participates in bug bashes, testing experiments before launch to confirm the experience matches intent.
  • Uses AI as a creative and productivity partner, leveraging skills, automation, and AI-generated illustrations or animations where it makes sense, to move faster and free up more time for craft.

AI-Native Expectations

  • Daily use: You embed AI in all your workflows and use it for real, substantive tasks, including research, analysis, drafting, prototyping, analytics and experimentation.
  • Review and accountability for AI output: AI-generated outputs get the same level of care of as any of your deliverables. You are accountable for everything you ship.
  • Velocity: We expect senior practitioners who use AI well to operate with meaningful leverage: doing more with the same time, taking on problems that would otherwise require a larger team.
  • Team leadership: You share what works. You automate prompting strategies that others can build on and help teammates earlier in their AI workflow adoption get up to speed.
  • Continuous learning: The tooling is changing fast. You stay current and bring recommendations to the team when something would meaningfully improve how we work.

Our Benefits

  • Medical, dental, vision, life and disability insurance plans (100% paid for US employees). We offer life and disability as well as supplemental plans for medical and dental for Canadian employees.
  • 401(k) plan with company matching program in the US and RRSP with DPSP plan for Canadian employees.
  • Paid parental leave.
  • Mental Wellness Program & Employee Assistance Program (EAP) for mental well-being.
  • Generous time off: flexible PTO, companywide holidays throughout the year plus summer and winter shutdowns.
  • Learning & Development programs.
  • Equipment, tools, and reimbursement support for a productive remote environment.
  • Free Life360 Platinum Membership and Tile trackers.

Life360 Values

Our company’s mission-driven culture is guided by our shared values to create a trusted work environment where you can bring your authentic self to work and make a positive difference

  • Be a Good Person - We have a team of high integrity people you can trust.
  • Be Direct With Respect - We communicate directly, even when it’s hard.
  • Members Before Metrics - We focus on building an exceptional experience for families.
  • High Intensity, High Impact - We do whatever it takes to get the job done.

Our Commitment to Diversity

We believe that different ideas, perspectives and backgrounds create a stronger and more creative work environment that delivers better results. Together, we continue to build an inclusive culture that encourages, supports, and celebrates the diverse voices of our employees. It fuels our innovation and connects us closer to our customers and the communities we serve. We strive to create a workplace that reflects the communities we serve and where everyone feels empowered to bring their authentic best selves to work.

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at Life360. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status or any legally protected status.

We encourage people of all backgrounds to apply. We believe that a diversity of perspectives and experiences create a foundation for the best ideas. Come join us in building something meaningful.Even if you don’t meet 100% of the below qualifications, you should still seriously consider applying!

jobs.description:
About Frontier

Frontier is a subsidiary of Fresh Prints. Fresh Prints is a New York-based, fast-growing, fully remote, 150-person company with most of our team based in India and the Philippines. A few years ago, Fresh Prints began helping other fast-growing companies build their teams. We got so good at it that we spun out a new company to focus exclusively on that — and called it Frontier.

At Frontier, we help companies grow full-time, cross-functional teams abroad. We hire the smartest people and place them into the best companies. In three years, we’ve never lost a client. If you’re interested in a Frontier role and you apply and are accepted, we’ll screen you through assessments and interviews and aim to get you an interview for a full-time job within the month.

Think of us as your personal talent agent — and good luck with the application! 😊

Please note: To ensure we find the best technical fit, our process begins with a practical skills assessment prior to interviews.

About Oak Hill Bio

Oak Hill Bio is a clinical-stage, rare disease therapeutics company focused on developing life-changing treatments for patients with urgent unmet needs. We are passionate about translating cutting-edge science into meaningful therapies and building a collaborative culture that drives innovation and impact.

About the Role

We are looking for an experienced Finance Manager / FP&A Lead to join our growing finance team and play a key role across our US and UK operations.

This is a hands-on role that combines FP&A, financial reporting, accounting, and month/quarter-end close responsibilities. The successful candidate will work closely with the US and UK Controllers and have the opportunity to support a complex, multi-group biotech organization.

The role will report directly to the Finance leadership team and will be responsible for helping ensure the accurate, timely, and high-quality delivery of financial reporting and close processes, while also providing meaningful financial analysis and insight to support business decisions.

We are particularly interested in candidates with biotech or life sciences experience, strong technical accounting knowledge, and experience working across US and UK reporting environments.

Key Responsibilities

Financial Planning & Analysis

  • Lead and support FP&A activities, including budgeting, forecasting, financial modeling, and variance analysis.

  • Provide meaningful analysis and insights into financial performance, trends, and business drivers.

  • Partner with business and finance stakeholders to develop financial plans and forecasts.

  • Translate financial data into clear insights and recommendations for leadership.

  • Support scenario analysis and longer-term financial planning.

Financial Reporting & Close

  • Support the accurate and timely completion of monthly and quarterly close processes across US and UK entities.

  • Work closely with the US and UK Controllers to ensure completeness and accuracy of financial information.

  • Review financial results, investigate variances, and identify potential accounting or reporting issues.

  • Support preparation and review of management and financial reporting.

  • Assist with US/SEC reporting requirements and related financial information.

  • Help ensure consistent accounting and reporting practices across the group.

Accounting & Technical Finance

  • Apply strong knowledge of US GAAP and UK GAAP across a multi-entity environment.

  • Support technical accounting matters and ensure appropriate accounting treatment for complex transactions.

  • Work closely with Controllers and other finance stakeholders on accounting issues and reporting requirements.

  • Develop a detailed understanding of the group's operations, entities, and financial activities.

  • Be willing to roll up your sleeves and get into the detail when required rather than operating solely at a high-level FP&A or management-reporting level.

Business Partnership

  • Partner closely with finance and operational teams across the US and UK.

  • Build strong working relationships with Controllers and other key stakeholders.

  • Help improve financial processes, reporting, controls, and systems.

  • Identify opportunities to streamline and improve the efficiency and accuracy of finance processes.

  • Support ad hoc financial analysis and projects as the business evolves.

Required Qualifications & Experience

  • Qualified accountant (e.g., ACA, ACCA, CPA, or equivalent).

  • Significant experience in finance, FP&A, financial reporting, or a combination of these areas.

  • Strong biotech or life sciences industry experience is essential.

  • Strong knowledge of US GAAP and familiarity with UK GAAP.

  • Experience with US/SEC reporting and related financial reporting requirements.

  • Experience supporting month-end and quarter-end close processes.

  • Strong financial modeling, forecasting, budgeting, and analytical capabilities.

  • Experience working within a multi-entity or multi-group organization.

  • Strong understanding of financial statements and accounting principles.

  • Excellent Excel and financial analysis skills.

  • Strong attention to detail and ability to work accurately under deadlines.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working across US and UK finance teams.

  • Experience in a public company or SEC reporting environment.

  • Experience with biotech, pharmaceutical, life sciences, or another highly regulated industry.

  • Experience with ERP systems and financial reporting tools.

  • Experience improving finance processes and controls.

What We're Looking For

We are looking for someone who combines strong technical accounting expertise with commercial and analytical thinking.

The ideal candidate will be comfortable moving between high-level FP&A work and detailed accounting analysis. They will be naturally curious, hands-on, highly analytical, and able to understand how different entities and business activities connect within a complex group structure.

This is an opportunity for someone who wants to have a meaningful impact on the finance function while working closely with experienced Controllers and senior finance leadership.

This is a player-coach role. You'll set the strategy and stay close enough to the work to write, build, and ship alongside the team. Two Social Media Managers report to the head of corporate communication and work with you on a dotted-line basis. You'll set their strategic direction, raise the editorial and craft bar, and develop them as practitioners, including goal-setting, feedback, and career development in partnership with their manager. Influence matters in this role, which is why it calls for someone who has already led and grown social practitioners.

What you’ll do

Partner with Communications and Talent Acquisition on enablement, and manage the advocacy platform and its adoption.
  • Support executive and expert social presence, partnering with Communications to help GitLab leaders and technical experts show up credibly on social, including constructive conversations with C-suite executives about proposed content.
  • Apply AI tools thoughtfully across the social workflow to help GitLab model what an AI-native marketing team looks like.
  • Prepare for and guide responses to sensitive or fast-moving issues in partnership with the appropriate teams.

What you’ll bring

  • 10+ years in social media, including at least 5 years leading social strategy for a global brand at the senior manager level or above, and accountable for the function's results.
  • Experience owning a social function end to end, including strategy, budget, headcount, tooling, and results as the accountable leader.
  • Experience leading teams, agencies, and cross-functional programs, with clear ownership of and accountability for outcomes.
  • Depth in YouTube strategy, including owning and growing a brand or business channel, and can speak to programming decisions, video formats, packaging, and the metrics that actually move a channel.
  • Hands-on experience growing LinkedIn and X as primary channels, with judgment about what content, format, and cadence work on each.
  • Experience with paid social programs and how organic and paid social reinforce each other, including creative for paid, audience strategy, and interpreting paid performance data.
  • Experience connecting social media programs to broader brand, communications, product, or business priorities.
  • Strong editorial judgment and the ability to turn complex topics into clear, engaging content.
  • Fluency with short-form and long-form video as core social formats, including working with production partners and creators.
  • Experience defining a measurement framework for social, including KPIs, dashboards, and reporting cadence, and presenting performance, learnings, and recommendations to executive leadership on a standing basis.
  • Experience building or scaling an employee advocacy program, including driving adoption across multiple functions, sustaining participation beyond launch, and reporting attributed reach and business contribution
  • Fluency with an enterprise social stack for publishing, listening, and advocacy. Ours is Sprout Social, Meltwater, and EveryoneSocial.

jobs.excerpt: Healthcare organizations are under more compliance pressure than ever, and most are managing it the wrong way: scattered tools, manual tracking, and fragmented records that leave teams exposed and exhausted.
jobs.description:
Healthcare organizations are under more compliance pressure than ever, and most are managing it the wrong way: scattered tools, manual tracking, and fragmented records that leave teams exposed and exhausted. Compliance has become someone's second job, not a program anyone is proud to stand behind.

Compliancy Group exists to change that. We are the platform for healthcare compliance programs, consolidating every element of a complete program into one connected system, so organizations can simplify requirements, gain real visibility into where risk lives, operate with confidence, and be genuinely defensible when it matters most. We do not sell a tool and walk away. We build the program with you, combining purpose-built software, proprietary conformance scoring, and ongoing access to compliance advisors, until your organization has the structure, the evidence, and the expertise to lead compliance instead of just survive it. If you are the kind of person who wants to work on something that actually protects patients and providers, you are in the right place.

We're growing our Solutions Engineering team to support one of the most important initiatives on our roadmap: managing migrations from legacy platforms to the go-forward software we’re standardizing our product roadmap and engineering efforts around. This is a high-visibility, high-impact role. You'll be the technical voice in the room for prospects and customers navigating this transition, running deep-dive demos, building sandboxes, and helping technical buyers see exactly how our future compliance program management solutions solve their problems.

Following our acquisition of Healthicity, our sales organization now brings together two strong, established platforms - Compliance Manager and Guard - that solve similar problems for customers in very different ways. As we bring these solutions together under one roof, customers are increasingly asking which platform is the right fit for their goals, and we need deep technical expertise to help them find the right answer.

This is a high-visibility, high-impact role. You'll be the technical voice in the room for prospects and customers as they evaluate their current use of compliance solutions, their pain points today and how those pain points are addressed by our future roadmap. You’ll be running deep-dive demos, building sandboxes, and helping buyers understand how each platform fits their needs, including migrating across platforms where that's the right move. You'll need to build genuine depth on both platforms, understanding not just what each one does, but why a customer might choose one over the other.

We're looking for someone who can go deep on the technical details and tell a compelling story about why it matters. If you love getting your hands dirty in a product, translating complexity into clarity, and being a trusted partner to both customers and your internal team, we'd love to talk.

What You'll Do

  • Act as the primary technical point of contact for customers evaluating or migrating across platforms. Understand their environment and design a migration path that fits their infrastructure. Please note this is a multi-year effort kicking off in late 2026 and expected to be a focus through the end of 2028
  • Own technical discovery, deep-dive demos, and sandboxes for prospects and customers, tailored to where they are in their migration journey.
  • Partner closely with Customer Success to help customers migrate smoothly and realize value quickly post-migration.
  • Support configuration and deliver minor technical changes needed to get prospects and customers successfully implemented.
  • Develop and maintain technical documentation, migration guides, and talk tracks that streamline both pre-sales conversations and post-sales onboarding.
  • Translate technical capabilities into business value. You're as comfortable with a technical buyer as you are with an economic buyer.
  • Feed prospect and customer feedback directly into Product and Engineering, helping shape product roadmaps and surfacing migration friction early.

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of experience as a Solutions Engineer, Sales Engineer, Solutions Architect, or in a similar technical pre-sales role.
  • Strong technical depth. You can credibly demo complex products, speak to configuration and implementation details, and answer tough technical questions on the fly.
  • A track record of managing relationships with large, complex organizations, ideally with a deeply technical enterprise product.
  • An understanding of, and comfort navigating, security, compliance, and IT processes at large enterprises. This maps directly to the migrations you'll be supporting.
  • A knack for storytelling and positioning. You can connect technical detail to the “why it matters” for the customer.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, comfortable presenting one-on-one, in small groups, and at larger venues.
  • Comfort working with ambiguity. This program is evolving, and we're building the playbook together.
  • A collaborative, low-ego, self-starter approach. You're as excited to help a teammate nail their demo as you are to run your own, and you find creative ways to get things over the finish line.

Nice to have:

  • Prior experience with healthcare compliance, governance, risk, or security products.
  • Experience supporting a product migration or platform transition.
  • Experience working with distributed or offshore teams.
  • Comfort operating in a small, fast-moving environment where the playbook is still being written.

Location: Remote for a US-based company; our team is evaluating qualified candidates onshore and offshore for this opportunity.

Reddit is a community of communities. It’s built on shared interests, passion, and trust, and is home to the most open and authentic conversations on the internet. Every day, Reddit users submit, vote, and comment on the topics they care most about. With 100,000+ active communities and approximately 130 million daily active unique visitors, Reddit is one of the internet’s largest sources of information. For more information, visit .

The Global Tax Team is seeking a hands-on indirect tax professional to help build and scale Reddit’s global indirect tax function. As Reddit continues to grow as a public company and expand its products and commercial offerings, this person will own critical elements of our US and international indirect tax operations, including US S&U tax and VAT/GST.

You will partner closely with the business to translate complex tax requirements into practical decisions, reliable systems, and scalable processes. In keeping with Reddit values, the successful candidate will operate with an open mindset, exercise sound judgment, and “value the human” in every interaction.

This position will report to the International Tax Senior Manager.

Responsibilities:

  • Manage key elements of Reddit’s global indirect tax function across B2B and B2C revenue streams, including US S&U tax, VAT/GST, DSTs, and other transactional taxes.
  • Oversee indirect tax registrations, return compliance, payments, exemption documentation, taxability determinations, and related controls across multiple jurisdictions.
  • Own and improve indirect tax processes and systems, including product and taxability mapping, exemptions, transaction testing, system integrations, data validation, and issue resolution.
  • Serve as the indirect tax cross-functional partner for new products and initiatives, commercial arrangements, billing changes, and geographic expansion.
  • Monitor and implement evolving e-invoicing, digital reporting, and real-time reporting requirements.
  • Perform indirect tax account reconciliations, accruals, journal entries, close activities, and internal controls.
  • Advise on the indirect tax provisions of customer and vendor agreements, invoicing requirements, and available exemptions.
  • Manage indirect tax audits, notices, and disclosures.
  • Monitor legislative and regulatory developments and assess their impact on Reddit.
  • Develop scalable processes, automation, metrics, and documentation that improve data quality, reduce manual work, and strengthen operational controls.
  • Contribute to broader Global Tax Team priorities and ad hoc projects, flexing beyond the role’s core indirect tax responsibilities as business needs evolve.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Tax, Accounting, or a related field.
  • 6+ years of indirect tax experience in public accounting and/or a multinational corporate tax function, including meaningful hands-on operational experience.
  • Technical and operational experience with both US and international indirect taxes, including B2B and B2C transactions.
  • Experience researching product and service taxability, registration and nexus obligations, place-of-supply rules, invoicing requirements, and exemptions.

jobs.excerpt: OUR MISSIONOPITO is committed to strategic growth and diversification, aiming to increase global adoption of its products and services to ensure continued provision of expertise and solutions to elevate safety, skills and competence across a global workforce in safety critical industries.
jobs.description:
OUR MISSION

OPITO is committed to strategic growth and diversification, aiming to increase global adoption of its products and services to ensure continued provision of expertise and solutions to elevate safety, skills and competence across a global workforce in safety critical industries. Through technology and innovation, the organisation will develop pioneering solutions that leverage cutting-edge advancements. A focus on data-driven intelligence will enable OPITO to harness insights into global workforce and safety trends, ensuring informed decision-making. In alignment with social value principles and the UN Sustainable Development Goals, OPITO will enhance educational opportunities, promote inclusive career pathways, support economic growth, and drive industry innovation and infrastructure. Lastly, through business effectiveness, OPITO will implement targeted and measurable continuous improvement initiatives, ensuring operational excellence across all aspects of its operations.

COMPANY OVERVIEW

Operating for over 50 years, OPITO is an industry-led organisation, with regional centres of excellence in six key regions – Asia Pacific, Middle East & India, Africa, Europe, South America & North America – OPITO drives safety and competency improvements across a diverse range of industries.

We drive consistency and safety compliance across global standards and qualifications, creating workforce development solutions. OPITO is a global leader in workforce safety, leading the skills focused dialogue with international governments as our industry prepares to meet Net Zero targets. Each year, more than 500,000 people are trained to OPITO standards through one of over 250 OPITO approved centres operating across 50 countries globally.

OUR VALUES

At OPITO, we are committed to fostering an inclusive, dynamic, and engaging workplace where individuals can bring their authentic selves to work. We value diversity, collaboration, and a spirited approach to our mission, believing that a strong team is built on mutual respect, passion, and a shared commitment to excellence.

Guided by our core values, we are steadfast in our commitment to:

  • Integrity – Acting with honesty and responsibility in all that we do.

  • Collaboration – Working together to achieve common goals and drive success.

  • Adaptability – Embracing change to stay ahead in a dynamic environment.

  • Care – Prioritising the well-being and growth of our team, partners, and industry.

At OPITO, we don’t just talk about our values—we live by them, creating a workplace where passion, resilience, and a positive mindset thrive.

JOB PURPOSE

As Vice President Strategic Partnerships - Africa reporting to the Director of Operations, you will be responsible for developing relationships, services and products to grow and extend the OPITO brand and influence as well as support registration growth across the Africa region.

ROLE RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Implementation of the agreed business growth strategies and plans

  • Supervision and management of regional Strategic Partnership Associates where appointed

  • Assist with annual budget preparation with the Director of Operations

  • Act as the key point of contact for regional customers

  • Support the development of new services and products

  • Research and amend growth plans for key markets, put these in place where they are missing

  • Work with the operations team, be a responsible senior member of company management

  • Work with the operations team and finance to develop commercial and/or advisory proposals.

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES

ESSENTIAL

  • Experience of working across multiple African countries and knowledge of local regulators

  • Proven understanding of the learning and development processes in the energy or resources sector

  • Appreciation of workplace learning and competency, and its alignment to business goals

  • Familiar with contemporary issues relating to the learning and development environment in the Energy sector

jobs.description:
Apollo.io is the leading go-to-market solution for revenue teams, trusted by over 500,000 companies and millions of users globally, from rapidly growing startups to some of the world's largest enterprises. Founded in 2015, the company is one of the fastest growing companies in SaaS, raising approximately $250 million to date and valued at $1.6 billion. Apollo.io provides sales and marketing teams with easy access to verified contact data for over 210 million B2B contacts and 35 million companies worldwide, along with tools to engage and convert these contacts in one unified platform. By helping revenue professionals find the most accurate contact information and automating the outreach process, Apollo.io turns prospects into customers. Apollo raised a series D in 2023 and is backed by top-tier investors, including Sequoia Capital, Bain Capital Ventures, and more, and counts the former President and COO of Hubspot, JD Sherman, among its board members.

Some of Apollo's biggest growth won't come from our own sales team. It'll come from other people selling or embedding Apollo under their own brand. That's the charter for Data & Distribution Partnerships, a newly created function with three mandates: scaling our data reseller business by hiring and leading a team of data reseller AEs, identifying data partnership opportunities with large platforms and crafting the bespoke commercial arrangements to support them, and uncovering new, innovative distribution partnerships beyond either of those two motions. Across all three, this is more invention than management. You're building commercial models that don't exist yet, not running relationships someone else already defined.

This is a great fit for someone who thrives in 0-to-1 environments: scrappy enough to build the strategy themselves (demand gen, pricing and packaging, marketing, sales process) and execute it personally, but experienced enough to then build and lead the team that takes it from 1 to 10. We're hiring the first Director to build and run it.

What you'll do:

1. Scale the Data Reseller Business

  • Own the volume data-resale P&L end to end: a published SKU with repeatable paper, carried by AEs
  • Hire, coach, and manage the AEs who carry the resale quota
  • Partner with Partner Marketing to fund demand generation behind the reseller business, and find the growth levers that haven't been pulled yet
  • Build a clear point of view on what increased demand gen unlocks and where the upmarket bespoke-deal opportunity is biggest

2. Identify Data Partnerships with Large Platforms and Craft the Bespoke Arrangements

  • Structure and close bespoke data agreements: one-off commercial arrangements with named, high-value counterparties, heavy up front, light after, and built as reusable templates rather than one-offs
  • Build and run discovery marketplace distribution: surfaces where a buyer is already shopping, from data-cloud marketplaces to MCP registries and platform marketplaces
  • Run new, complex BD deals personally, you're expected to be in the room for anything that doesn't fit the existing playbook

3. Uncover New, Innovative Distribution Partnerships

  • Build and run point-of-formation distribution: platforms that sit with a company from the week it's formed, think formation platforms, website builders, and the regional CPA and business-advisory networks that touch companies at inception
  • Within your first six months, arrive at several new distribution "big swings" that are prioritized, sized, and shaped for a resourcing decision
  • This is a build-from-scratch mandate: you'll define the shape of the function, not inherit one

Minimum Qualifications

  • 8+ years in business development, partnerships, or channel roles, with meaningful experience originating and closing complex, first-of-their-kind commercial agreements — not just running an existing partner program
  • Experience managing or coaching a quota-carrying team (AEs, BDRs, or partner managers) while personally closing the deals your team can't yet handle alone
  • Comfortable operating in both modes this role requires: high-volume, SKU-based commercial structures (published pricing, repeatable paper) and heavy, bespoke one-off negotiations with named counterparties
  • A track record of building something that didn't exist before — a new channel, commercial model, or category of partner — rather than optimizing an established motion

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with data licensing, API/data-reseller businesses, or platform marketplaces (Snowflake, Databricks, or similar data-cloud ecosystems)
  • Experience with point-of-formation or embedded distribution models (legal tech, business-formation platforms, fintech, or similar)

About Us

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.

Available Location: Chicago, IL; Austin, TX; Phoenix, AZ; Los Angeles, CA; San Francisco, CA; Denver, CO; St. Louis, MO; Kansas City; Dallas, TX

About the Department

The Specialist Solutions Engineering team at Cloudflare is a group of trusted technical advisors who partner with customers to solve complex security, connectivity, and performance challenges. We work hand in hand with the sales organization throughout the customer journey, from discovery and solution design through proof of value and technical validation. We are passionate about technology and dedicated to helping customers use the full power of Cloudflare's global network to achieve business-critical outcomes.

About the Role

As a Senior Solutions Engineer specializing in Cloudflare One, you will partner with account teams and customers to design, demonstrate, and validate integrated solutions across Zero Trust, enterprise WAN, and emerging AI technologies. You will lead the technical path for complex opportunities, translating customer risks, operational requirements, and business priorities into architectures that give stakeholders confidence to adopt Cloudflare.

Zero Trust is the primary focus of this role, with enterprise WAN and AI as the next priorities. Successful candidates will bring meaningful customer-facing Zero Trust experience and practical enterprise WAN experience. Email Security experience is welcome but not required. You do not need to be an expert in every part of the portfolio, but you must be able to connect these technologies into a coherent customer strategy and continue developing your expertise as the market evolves.

This is a Senior-level individual-contributor role for a curious, commercially aware technical leader who can guide customer evaluations, collaborate across teams, and improve the effectiveness of the broader field organization.

Responsibilities

  • Serve as a trusted technical advisor, leading discovery and designing Cloudflare One architectures that address customer security, connectivity, and business requirements.
  • Guide qualified opportunities through solution design, demonstrations, technical evaluations, proofs of value, success-criteria management, and technical close.
  • Advise customers on Zero Trust strategies spanning identity-aware access, secure web gateway, data protection, SaaS security, browser isolation, device posture, and secure connectivity.
  • Design WAN transformation solutions that connect users, offices, data centers, and cloud environments using Cloudflare WAN and complementary Cloudflare One services.
  • Build expertise in AI-era opportunities and risks, including employee AI adoption, Shadow AI, sensitive-data exposure, AI application access, Model Context Protocol (MCP) server controls, and agentic AI governance.
  • Use AI tools thoughtfully to improve research, customer preparation, technical analysis, content creation, demonstrations, automation, and the repeatability of field activities.
  • Support broader Cloudflare One opportunities involving Email Security when relevant to the customer's strategy and requirements.
  • Clearly articulate Cloudflare's technical and business differentiation against competing Zero Trust, email-security, networking, and adjacent AI-security solutions.
  • Partner with sales teams on account strategy, pipeline development, and revenue goals while maintaining clear ownership of technical next steps and customer outcomes.
  • Create reusable architectures, demonstration and proof-of-value patterns, technical guidance, and lightweight automation, and coach peers and partners to execute more effectively.
  • Capture customer feedback, market trends, and product gaps, translating them into actionable input for Product and Engineering.
  • Coordinate with Sales, Support, Product, and Engineering to resolve technical issues and maintain customer trust during complex evaluations.
  • Own presales evaluation outcomes through technical close, then coordinate a clean handoff to the appropriate Customer Success, Professional Services, Support, or implementation teams.

Qualifications

Successful candidates are customer-focused technical leaders who combine broad security and networking experience with strong communication, commercial judgment, and learning agility. We welcome relevant backgrounds in Solutions or Systems Engineering, technical sales, consulting, or enterprise security and network architecture.

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in a customer-facing technical role such as Solutions Engineering, Systems Engineering, technical sales, consulting, or enterprise architecture.
  • Meaningful customer-facing experience designing, demonstrating, evaluating, or implementing Zero Trust solutions.
  • Practical understanding of Zero Trust and SASE architectures, including identity, endpoint, network, application, data, and SaaS security considerations.
  • Practical experience with enterprise networking and WAN concepts such as routing, subnetting, VPNs, SD-WAN, hybrid connectivity, cloud networking, or network transformation.
  • Active professional use of AI tools and demonstrated commitment to learning how AI platforms, AI-enabled threats, data exposure, and governance affect enterprise customers.
  • Experience designing or integrating enterprise security solutions with one or more of the following: identity providers, Microsoft 365 or Google Workspace, public cloud environments, APIs, and SIEM or log-analytics platforms.
  • Proven ownership of technical evaluations or proofs of value, including discovery, architecture, scope, success criteria, deployment dependencies, stakeholder communication, technical decision management, and technical close.
  • Strong written, presentation, and demonstration skills across practitioner, architect, and executive audiences, with the ability to connect technical capabilities to risk reduction, operational improvement, and business outcomes.
  • Ability to collaborate across Sales, Product, Engineering, Support, partners, and customer teams while managing competing priorities and deadlines.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Hands-on experience with Cloudflare One capabilities such as Access, Gateway, Cloudflare One Client, Browser Isolation, CASB, DLP, Email Security, Cloudflare Tunnel, or Cloudflare WAN.
  • Experience displacing, integrating, or migrating from secure web gateways, VPN or ZTNA platforms, secure email gateways, API-based email-security platforms, MPLS networks, or SD-WAN solutions.
  • Experience with Email Security technologies, customer requirements, or threat use cases, including familiarity with Microsoft 365 or Exchange, Google Workspace, SMTP, mail flow, SPF, DKIM, or DMARC.
  • Deeper networking experience with routing, BGP, IPsec or GRE connectivity, SD-WAN, network firewalls, hybrid and multi-cloud networking, or WAN transformation.
  • Hands-on experience with AI security or governance, including Shadow AI discovery, controls for generative-AI applications, AI-related data-loss risks, MCP, agentic systems, or the broader Cloudflare AI portfolio.
  • Ability to use scripting, APIs, or automation to make demonstrations, evaluations, reporting, and deployments more repeatable.
  • Experience enabling channel partners, distributors, managed service providers, or systems integrators in complex enterprise sales cycles.
  • Relevant security, networking, cloud, or AI certifications, or equivalent demonstrated expertise.

Compensation

    • For SF, SJ, and Bay Area Metro based hires: Estimated annual salary of $244,000 - $336,000.
    • For Boston, California - Remote, Connecticut - Remote, DC Metro, Massachusetts - Remote, New Jersey - Remote, New York City, NY Metro, Remote - Washington, Washington (Kirkland), and Washington D.C. based hires: Estimated annual salary of $234,000 - $321,000.
    • For Colorado - Remote, Illinois - Remote, Maryland - Remote, Minnesota - Remote, Nevada - Remote, New York - Remote, Rhode Island - Remote, and Vermont - Remote based hires: Estimated annual base salary of $163,240 - $224,840. Estimated variable compensation target of $48,760 - $67,160.
  • This role is eligible to earn incentive compensation under Cloudflare's Sales Compensation Plan. The estimated annual salary range includes the on-target incentive compensation that may be attained in this role under the Sales Compensation Plan.
  • Application Deadline: December 8, 2026

Equity

This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare’s equity plan.

Benefits

Cloudflare offers a complete package of benefits and programs to support you and your family. Our benefits programs can help you pay health care expenses, support caregiving, build capital for the future and make life a little easier and fun! What Makes Cloudflare Special?

We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.

Project Galileo: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.

Athenian Project: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.

We will continue to abide by our privacy commitment and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.

Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!
