jobs.excerpt: ร่วมเป็นผู้ฝึกอบรมของ WPO | เข้าร่วมเครือข่ายผู้ส่งเสริมสุขภาวะระดับโลกของเรา สถานที่ทำงาน: ยืดหยุ่น / ทำงานจากระยะไกล | ไทย ที่ Workplace Options (WPO) การเชื่อมต่อระหว่างมนุษย์เป็นหัวใจสำคัญของสุขภาวะ ในฐานะผู้นำระดับโลกด้านบริการสุขภาพจิตและสุขภาวะ เราทำงานร่วมกับผู้ฝึกอบรมผู้เชี่ยวชาญเพื่อส่งมอบการอบรมที่น่าสนใจและทรงพลัง ซึ่งสร้างแรงบันดาลใจให้เกิดการเปลี่ยนแปลงเชิงบวกในสถานที่ทำงานทั่วโลก คุณจะได้เป็นผู้ดำเนินงานสัมมนาออนไลน์ สัมมนา และเวิร์กช็อปเกี่ยวกับความยืดหยุ่น ความเป็นผู้นำ สุขภาพจิต ความปลอดภัยทางจิตใจ และหัวข้อสำคัญอื่นๆ เกี่ยวกับสุขภาวะในที่ทำงาน เพื่อเสริมศักยภาพให้พนักงานเติบโตในสภาพแวดล้อมการทำงานที่มีพลวัตในปัจจุบัน สิ่งที่คุณจะทำ ในฐานะผู้ฝึกอบรมของ WPO คุณจะ: • • ดำเนินงานอบรมที่น่าสนใจและมีปฏิสัมพันธ์ในหัวข้อสุขภาวะที่หลากหลาย ปรับรูปแบบของคุณให้เข้ากับกลุ่มเป้าหมายทั่วโลก • นำเสนอเนื้อหาที่ออกแบบโดย WPO ปรับตัวอย่างและวิธีการนำเสนอให้เหมาะสมกับอุตสาหกรรม วัฒนธรรม และบริบทขององค์กรต่างๆ • สร้างสภาพแวดล้อมการเรียนรู้แบบไดนามิกโดยใช้การอภิปราย การสำรวจความคิดเห็น การสะท้อนความคิด และการถามตอบ เพื่อส่งเสริมการมีส่วนร่วมและการจดจำความรู้ของผู้เข้าร่วม • ดำเนินการจัดอบรมทั้งแบบออนไลน์และออฟไลน์ ตรวจสอบให้แน่ใจว่าการติดตั้งระบบทางเทคนิคเป็นไปอย่างราบรื่นและสร้างประสบการณ์อย่างมีประสิทธิภาพ • ทำงานร่วมกับทีมงานกิจกรรมการเรียนรู้ของ WPO อย่างใกล้ชิด ก่อนการอบรมแต่ละครั้งจะ - ตรวจสอบเอกสาร ปรับให้สอดคล้องกับเป้าหมายของลูกค้า และเข้าร่วมการประชุมเตรียมการ • รักษาความอ่อนไหวทางวัฒนธรรม ความเป็นตัวตน และความเป็นมืออาชีพในแนวทางการอำนวยความสะดวกของคุณ สิ่งที่เรากำลังมองหา• ประสบการณ์อย่างน้อย 3 ปีในฐานะผู้ฝึกอบรม ผู้ดำเนินรายการ โค้ช หรือวิทยากร โดยเฉพาะอย่างยิ่งในด้านสุขภาวะหรือภาวะผู้นำ • ต้องเป็นสมาชิกขององค์กรกำกับดูแลวิชาชีพ (เช่น ICF, EAPA) • ทักษะการสื่อสารและการอำนวยความสะดวกที่แข็งแกร่ง - มั่นใจ มีมนุษยสัมพันธ์ดี และมีส่วนร่วมกับกลุ่มต่างๆ ได้ • ความสามารถที่ได้รับการพิสูจน์แล้วในการนำเสนอต่อผู้ชมทั้งขนาดเล็กและขนาดใหญ่ในรูปแบบต่างๆ (ออนไลน์และออฟไลน์) • วุฒิการศึกษาระดับปริญญาโทขึ้นไป หรือเทียบเท่า • สามารถใช้แพลตฟอร์มเสมือนจริง เช่น Zoom, Microsoft Teams, Webex หรือเทียบเท่าได้อย่างคล่องแคล่ว • มีความมุ่งมั่นในการเตรียมการและประสานงานการประชุม คุณสมบัติที่ต้องการ แต่ไม่บังคับ • ประสบการณ์อย่างน้อย 5 ปีในสภาพแวดล้อมทางคลินิก • ประสบการณ์การทำงานกับลูกค้าข้ามชาติหรือองค์กร • ความคุ้นเคยกับหัวข้อต่างๆ เช่น สุขภาพจิต ความยืดหยุ่น ความเป็นผู้นำ ความปลอดภัยทางจิตใจ หรือวัฒนธรรมในที่ทำงาน • ยินดีและสามารถเดินทางไปจัดอบรมที่สถานที่ของลูกค้าได้เมื่อจำเป็น (ค่าใช้จ่ายในการเดินทางจะได้รับการสนับสนุน) • ประสบการณ์ในการออกแบบเนื้อหา การพัฒนาหลักสูตร หรือการออกแบบการสอน เหตุใดจึงควรเข้าร่วมเครือข่ายผู้ฝึกอบรมระดับโลกของ WPO?
jobs.description:
ร่วมเป็นผู้ฝึกอบรมของ WPO | เข้าร่วมเครือข่ายผู้ส่งเสริมสุขภาวะระดับโลกของเรา

สถานที่ทำงาน: ยืดหยุ่น / ทำงานจากระยะไกล | ไทย

ที่ Workplace Options (WPO) การเชื่อมต่อระหว่างมนุษย์เป็นหัวใจสำคัญของสุขภาวะ ในฐานะผู้นำระดับโลกด้านบริการสุขภาพจิตและสุขภาวะ เราทำงานร่วมกับผู้ฝึกอบรมผู้เชี่ยวชาญเพื่อส่งมอบการอบรมที่น่าสนใจและทรงพลัง ซึ่งสร้างแรงบันดาลใจให้เกิดการเปลี่ยนแปลงเชิงบวกในสถานที่ทำงานทั่วโลก คุณจะได้เป็นผู้ดำเนินงานสัมมนาออนไลน์ สัมมนา และเวิร์กช็อปเกี่ยวกับความยืดหยุ่น ความเป็นผู้นำ สุขภาพจิต ความปลอดภัยทางจิตใจ และหัวข้อสำคัญอื่นๆ เกี่ยวกับสุขภาวะในที่ทำงาน เพื่อเสริมศักยภาพให้พนักงานเติบโตในสภาพแวดล้อมการทำงานที่มีพลวัตในปัจจุบัน

สิ่งที่คุณจะทำ

ในฐานะผู้ฝึกอบรมของ WPO คุณจะ:

  • • ดำเนินงานอบรมที่น่าสนใจและมีปฏิสัมพันธ์ในหัวข้อสุขภาวะที่หลากหลาย ปรับรูปแบบของคุณให้เข้ากับกลุ่มเป้าหมายทั่วโลก
  • นำเสนอเนื้อหาที่ออกแบบโดย WPO ปรับตัวอย่างและวิธีการนำเสนอให้เหมาะสมกับอุตสาหกรรม วัฒนธรรม และบริบทขององค์กรต่างๆ
  • สร้างสภาพแวดล้อมการเรียนรู้แบบไดนามิกโดยใช้การอภิปราย การสำรวจความคิดเห็น การสะท้อนความคิด และการถามตอบ เพื่อส่งเสริมการมีส่วนร่วมและการจดจำความรู้ของผู้เข้าร่วม
  • ดำเนินการจัดอบรมทั้งแบบออนไลน์และออฟไลน์ ตรวจสอบให้แน่ใจว่าการติดตั้งระบบทางเทคนิคเป็นไปอย่างราบรื่นและสร้างประสบการณ์อย่างมีประสิทธิภาพ
  • ทำงานร่วมกับทีมงานกิจกรรมการเรียนรู้ของ WPO อย่างใกล้ชิด ก่อนการอบรมแต่ละครั้งจะ - ตรวจสอบเอกสาร ปรับให้สอดคล้องกับเป้าหมายของลูกค้า และเข้าร่วมการประชุมเตรียมการ
  • รักษาความอ่อนไหวทางวัฒนธรรม ความเป็นตัวตน และความเป็นมืออาชีพในแนวทางการอำนวยความสะดวกของคุณ

สิ่งที่เรากำลังมองหา

  • ประสบการณ์อย่างน้อย 3 ปีในฐานะผู้ฝึกอบรม ผู้ดำเนินรายการ โค้ช หรือวิทยากร โดยเฉพาะอย่างยิ่งในด้านสุขภาวะหรือภาวะผู้นำ
  • ต้องเป็นสมาชิกขององค์กรกำกับดูแลวิชาชีพ (เช่น ICF, EAPA)
  • ทักษะการสื่อสารและการอำนวยความสะดวกที่แข็งแกร่ง - มั่นใจ มีมนุษยสัมพันธ์ดี และมีส่วนร่วมกับกลุ่มต่างๆ ได้
  • ความสามารถที่ได้รับการพิสูจน์แล้วในการนำเสนอต่อผู้ชมทั้งขนาดเล็กและขนาดใหญ่ในรูปแบบต่างๆ (ออนไลน์และออฟไลน์)
  • วุฒิการศึกษาระดับปริญญาโทขึ้นไป หรือเทียบเท่า
  • สามารถใช้แพลตฟอร์มเสมือนจริง เช่น Zoom, Microsoft Teams, Webex หรือเทียบเท่าได้อย่างคล่องแคล่ว
  • มีความมุ่งมั่นในการเตรียมการและประสานงานการประชุม

คุณสมบัติที่ต้องการ แต่ไม่บังคับ

  • ประสบการณ์อย่างน้อย 5 ปีในสภาพแวดล้อมทางคลินิก
  • ประสบการณ์การทำงานกับลูกค้าข้ามชาติหรือองค์กร
  • ความคุ้นเคยกับหัวข้อต่างๆ เช่น สุขภาพจิต ความยืดหยุ่น ความเป็นผู้นำ ความปลอดภัยทางจิตใจ หรือวัฒนธรรมในที่ทำงาน
  • ยินดีและสามารถเดินทางไปจัดอบรมที่สถานที่ของลูกค้าได้เมื่อจำเป็น (ค่าใช้จ่ายในการเดินทางจะได้รับการสนับสนุน)
  • ประสบการณ์ในการออกแบบเนื้อหา การพัฒนาหลักสูตร หรือการออกแบบการสอน

เหตุใดจึงควรเข้าร่วมเครือข่ายผู้ฝึกอบรมระดับโลกของ WPO?

  • ผลกระทบระดับโลก - จัดอบรมเพื่อสนับสนุนพนักงานในกว่า 200 ประเทศและต่างวัฒนธรรม
  • การมีส่วนร่วมที่ยืดหยุ่น - เลือกหัวข้อการฝึกอบรมที่เหมาะสมกับตารางเวลาและความเชี่ยวชาญของคุณ
  • การสนับสนุนอย่างต่อเนื่อง - เข้าถึงสื่อคุณภาพสูงที่อิงตามหลักวิทยาศาสตร์และการประสานงานโดยเฉพาะ
  • การเติบโตทางวิชาชีพ - ได้รับประสบการณ์กับลูกค้าที่หลากหลายและขยายทักษะการอำนวยความสะดวกของคุณในระดับโลก
  • ความน่าเชื่อถือและเป้าหมาย - ร่วมงานกับผู้นำที่น่าเชื่อถือในด้านสุขภาวะในที่ทำงานระดับโลก
  • ค่าตอบแทนที่แข่งขันได้
  • ได้รับการตอบแทนอย่างเป็นธรรมสำหรับความเชี่ยวชาญและความมุ่งมั่นของคุณ

วิธีการสมัคร

กรุณาส่งใบสมัครของคุณผ่านลิงก์ต่อไปนี้ ซึ่งจะนำคุณเข้าสู่กระบวนการออนไลน์ รวมถึงการประเมินทักษะออนไลน์สั้นๆที่คุณสามารถพูดคุยเกี่ยวกับความสนใจและประสบการณ์ของคุณได้

พร้อมที่จะสร้างผลกระทบระดับโลกในขณะที่ทำในสิ่งที่คุณรักแล้วหรือยัง? สมัครเลยเพื่อเข้าร่วมเครือข่ายผู้ฝึกสอนของ Workplace Options และช่วยเปลี่ยนแปลงสุขภาวะในที่ทำงานทั่วโลก

jobs.title: Electrical Estimator - Data Center Construction
jobs.excerpt: Turner & Townsend are seeking an experienced Electrical Construction Estimator to join our team.
jobs.description:
Turner & Townsend are seeking an experienced Electrical Construction Estimator to join our team. The ideal candidate will provide detailed and accurate cost estimates for electrical systems in construction projects, ensuring effective cost management and project success. 

Responsibilities: 

  • Prepare detailed and accurate cost estimates for electrical systems in construction projects.
  • Review project plans and specifications to determine the scope of work and required materials.
  • Collaborate with project teams to develop comprehensive cost management plans.
  • Analyze project requirements and provide value engineering options.
  • Perform cost risk analysis and provide input into value engineering.
  • Communicate and collaborate with clients, contractors, and other stakeholders.
  • Utilize industry-specific estimating software and tools to prepare estimates.
  • Provide estimating advice, guidance, and analysis to project stakeholders.
  • Maintain up-to-date knowledge of industry-specific estimating processes and methodologies.
  • Prepare formal estimating reports, including quantity, cost, escalation, and other assumptions and clarifications.
  • Assist in the development of estimating standards and best practices.
  • Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering, construction management, cost management, quantity surveying, engineering or field related to construction.  
  • Minimum 3-5 years of relevant experience  
  • Thrives in a client facing role.  
  • Experience supporting program level cost management for medium or large-scale construction projects.  
  • Good knowledge of electrical systems and construction industry technical matters
  • Strong communication skills

*On site requirements might change based on client needs*

jobs.excerpt: Cancer care should be more personalized, context-specific, accessible, and human.
jobs.description:
Cancer care should be more personalized, context-specific, accessible, and human.

Cancer treatment has become extraordinarily complex and precise, but care delivery remains largely episodic. Most of a patient's experience occurs between visits, when symptoms emerge, conditions change and care teams have limited visibility.
This gap is widening, not narrowing. Treatment complexity is growing faster than oncology workforce capacity, advanced therapies once confined to the hospital are increasingly monitored at home, and the cost of that gap is concrete: preventable ED visits, delayed escalation, and clinician burnout from covering more than any single care team can sustainably manage. The problem is not a lack of clinical expertise. It is a lack of infrastructure to extend that expertise continuously, to every patient, between every visit.

We believe precision treatment requires precision care: care that surrounds the patient, not just the visit.

By combining Cureety's treatment-specific symptom monitoring, longitudinal data, and clinical intelligence with Reimagine Care's AI-enabled care delivery, oncology-trained clinical operations, and 24/7 virtual care center, we can create a differentiated model of continuous oncology care.

Our ambition: become the orchestration infrastructure for precision oncology care.

Role Brief:

Reimagine Care X Cureety is expanding its U.S. operations, and the Sales Director will support health system and community oncology segments to help execute the new business sales strategy. This will include understanding the market trends and how to successfully articulate the Reimagine Care X Cureety message to resonate across key health system segments and ultimately meet the U.S. financial growth plan. You will grow the pipeline funnel and work in partnership with Growth team leadership to bring opportunities through the closing process.
Core Responsibilities:
  • Execute on U.S. new business sales plans and achieve the company’s U.S. growth objectives
  • Problem-solve for prospects and report internally on objections and barriers, with a proposed path forward
  • Work closely with marketing to identify top prospects, nurture and drive engagement
  • Own the sales cycle from prospecting, discovery, and scoping through proposal delivery
  • Adopt strategic selling communication and toolkit
  • Monitor competitors’ products, including relevant sales and marketing data, and conduct market research to adjust strategies for maximum success
  • Use available data to accurately forecast sales and set appropriate performance goals; develop and maintain positive relationships with key clients

  • Ability to communicate, present, and influence C-Suite leaders in health systems and oncology practice leaders
  • Proven ability to generate top-of-funnel activity and scoping
  • HubSpot opportunity management - Analytical and metrics-driven, regularly leveraging data to support deal navigation
  • High degree of customer empathy, and strong ability to build relationships and rapport

  • ensure the project team is defined and staffed appropriately, and that the appropriate internal and external services are obtained to meet the objectives of the project and deliver the specified functionality and requirements
  • work directly within ITSM/ticketing platforms (e.g., ServiceNow, HaloPSA, Freshworks, or similar) to track tickets, monitor SLA compliance, and escalate appropriately

jobs.title: Director, Legal Claims Administration
jobs.excerpt: Director, Legal Claims Administration The Director, Legal Claims Administration, manages the Recovery Services area of the Legal Claims Administration Group and reports to the Senior Managing Director of Legal Claims Administration.
jobs.description:
Director, Legal Claims Administration The Director, Legal Claims Administration, manages the Recovery Services area of the Legal Claims Administration Group and reports to the Senior Managing Director of Legal Claims Administration. The Recovery Services team performs claim and defense analysis for causes of action arising under Sections 547, 550 and 502 of the U.S. Bankruptcy Code, prepares and serves of Demand Letters and Complaints asserting causes of actions pursued under Sections 547, 550, and 502 of the U.S. Bankruptcy Code and (together with partner counsel) negotiates and provides litigation support to resolve these causes of action. The Director also plays a central role in the administration of client work by the Recovery Services group, which focuses on data analysis, case tracking, and resolution of matters relating to Demand Letters or Complaints. The Director will oversee all casework while managing a caseload personally and ensuring group responsibilities are completed effectively. The Director will be the first point of contact with clients and assist and support partner counsel in connection with settlement negotiations and mediation relating to each matter. This will include obtaining relevant data from the client and/or opponent, managing data, analyzing data / defense analyses and positions asserted by opposing parties and/or counsel, and preparing independent data analyses in response. Group level responsibilities include daily tasks such as (a) responding to ministerial communications such as requests for extensions from adversaries and requests for information, (b) case tracker maintenance, and (c) creation/implementation of template responses, as well as periodic projects such as preparation and distribution of Demand Letters and Complaints, along with the filing of Complaints and service of Summonses and Complaints. The Director will be responsible for the preparation of draft documents for review by the client and/or counsel, such as Demand Letters, Complaints, settlement agreements, settlement parameters, and ensuring that work assigned to administrative staff – e.g., portfolio analysis, tracker maintenance, address research, corporate name research, etc. – is completed correctly and on time. The Director should have a J.D. or MBA coupled with at least 5 years’ experience working on corporate restructuring matters and a deep familiarity with the U.S. Bankruptcy Code and bankruptcy process. Candidates with bankruptcy litigation experience and experience managing preference matters or other avoidance actions is a plus. The Director is expected to possess at least an intermediate level of proficiency in Excel so as to be able to utilize and manage the preference defense analysis model directly. Experience with DocuSign, Pacer/ECF and research tools such as Westlaw and Lexis are also a plus.

Below is a list of specific tasks the Director, Legal Claims Administration is responsible for:

1. Demand Letter / Complaint prep:

a. Work with clients and Stretto team members to obtain materials needed to prepare defense analysis, Demand Letters and Complaints b. Supervise preparation of defense analysis and prepare summary analysis for client and counsel that notes rationale for excluding certain transferees from receiving Demand Letters or Complaints c. Conduct or manage research on corporate names / addresses of principal places of business, and registered agents in states of incorporation d. Prepare templates for Demand Letters and Complaints, or, at the request of counsel, provide templates for counsel to consider e. Prepare or supervise preparation of mail merge files for Demand Letters and Complaints f. Manage preparation of Demand Letters and Complaints g. Manage production and mailing/filing of Demand Letters and Complaints h. Manage service of Summonses and Complaints i. Perform other tasks as needed to facilitate Demand Letter / Complaint prep and distribution

2. Resolve Cases:

a. Arrange for settlement parameters with Client b. Coordinate with Client’s counsel and payees and/or their counsel on settlement negotiations c. Evaluate data-based client preference defenses asserted by transferee d. Conduct and/or facilitate secondary defense analysis e. Coordinate with partner counsel on responses to correspondence received from transferees in connection with demand letters and complaints f. Prepare or manage preparation and execution of settlement agreements with opponent g. Track status of cases, completion of settlement agreements and receipt of settlement funds

3. Overall Portfolio:

Coordinate with direct supervisor and counsel in:

a. Completing and managing case communications b. Facilitating completion of secondary defense analysis for individual preference matters c. Managing prep and execution of settlement documents and, when applicable, coordinate with counsel on motions seeking approval of settlement agreements, as well as mediations, and any pleading filed in the avoidance actions

4. Case Tracker Maintenance:

a. Work with other staff to maintain all portfolio status trackers b. Set weekly or bi-weekly meetings to discuss issues with client, counsel, and other staff c. Ensure updated trackers are circulated at bi-weekly or on the schedule determined / agreed to with client

5. Other Tasks:

a. Work with Business Development Team to support research for future potential portfolios of preference cases b. Address all tasks assigned by their direct supervisor promptly c. Address all tasks requested by client promptly and where necessary, consult with direct supervisors d. Communicate status on task completion at intervals set by direct supervisor e. Provide occasional support to other areas of the Legal Claims Administration group

6. Professional Development:

a. Stay up to date on law related to causes of actions pursued under Sections 547, 550, and 502 of the US Bankruptcy Code b. Seek opportunities to prepare “Client Alerts” and other publications related to cases arising under Sections 547, 550, and 502 of the US Bankruptcy Code

Why Join Stretto? At Stretto, you’ll be part of a collaborative team that’s dedicated to innovation, excellence, and growth. You’ll have the opportunity to shape the direction of a rapidly expanding business unit while making a direct impact on the legal community.

The Company’s salary ranges are determined by role, level, location and alignment with market data. Individual pay is determined through interviews and an assessment of various factors, including job-related skills, relevant education and experience, abilities of the applicant, and equity with other team members. The salary range listed here is subject to change at any time, at the Company’s discretion, and does not alter in any way the at-will nature of the employment relationship.

Stretto offers a competitive and comprehensive benefits package, along with opportunities for growth. We are an equal opportunity employer encouraging diversity in the workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, national origin, gender, age, religion, disability, sexual orientation, veteran status, marital status or any other characteristics protected by law.

jobs.excerpt: Title:ANTARCTICA: Network Systems Packet LeadBelong, Connect, Grow, with KBR!
jobs.description:
Title:

ANTARCTICA: Network Systems Packet Lead

Belong, Connect, Grow, with KBR! - At KBR, we are passionate about our people and our Zero Harm culture. These inform all that we do and are at the heart of our commitment to, and ongoing journey toward being a People First company. That commitment is central to our team of team’s philosophy and fosters an environment where everyone can Belong, Connect and Grow. We Deliver – Together.

Program Summary

The National Science Foundation (NSF) manages the United States Antarctic Program (USAP). The USAP supports all U.S. scientific research and related logistics in Antarctica and aboard USAP vessels that operate along the continental margin and in the Southern Ocean. Science within the Antarctic research portfolio is chosen and funded by NSF and other Federal agencies, including NASA, NOAA, and the Department of Energy. The purpose of the Antarctic Science and Engineering Support Contract (ASESC) is to enable that science.

All participants are responsible formaintaining a safe workplace and ensuring that safety is the highest priority. This includes compliance with all ASESC environmental health & safety, and quality assurance requirements.

Job Summary

The Network Systems Packet Lead will oversee the transition of all program network systemsincluding, network operations, email, system access and security, user support, and the service deskassociated with the Antarctic Science and Engineering Support Contract (ASESC). This role leads the collection, organization, validation, and transfer of network systems information to ensure continuity of mission-critical communications and IT operations by collaborating with network engineers, system administrators, operations personnel, and transition leadership to facilitate a seamless and compliant transition of network services and infrastructure.This position will play a critical role in laying the foundation every other function relies on, with the added challenge of constrained satellite bandwidth.

*This is a remote position based in the US.

Roles and Responsibilities

  • Lead the development, organization, and management of Network Systems transition packets supporting transition objectives

  • Coordinate the collection, review, validation, and transfer of network-related documentation, configurations, diagrams, inventories, procedures, and operational records

  • Collaborate with network engineers, system administrators, and subject matter experts to document current-state network architecture, services, and operational processes

  • Track transition deliverables, milestones, risks, action items, and dependencies associated with network systems

  • Ensure network documentation is complete, accurate, current, and maintained in accordance with established document control practices

  • Support the transfer and validation of network inventories, configuration baselines, asset records, maintenance histories, and support documentation

  • Assist in documenting network monitoring, incident response, cybersecurity, and continuity-of-operations procedures

  • Facilitate communication and coordination between network teams, transition personnel, and cross-functional stakeholders

  • Prepare transition reports, status updates, metrics, and briefings for leadership review

jobs.title: Sr Machine Learning Engineer (MLOps) - Remote India
jobs.excerpt: About DynatronDynatron is transforming the automotive service industry with intelligent SaaS solutions that drive measurable results for thousands of dealership service departments.
jobs.description:
About Dynatron

Dynatron is transforming the automotive service industry with intelligent SaaS solutions that drive measurable results for thousands of dealership service departments. Our analytics, automation, and AI-powered workflows help service leaders improve profitability, increase operational efficiency, and make smarter business decisions.

As Dynatron expands its AI and machine learning capabilities, building models is only part of the challenge. We need the infrastructure, engineering discipline, and operational rigor to deploy those capabilities reliably, monitor them continuously, and scale them confidently.

The Opportunity

We’re looking for a Senior Machine Learning Engineer (MLOps) to own the production infrastructure and operational lifecycle behind Dynatron’s growing AI and machine learning capabilities.

This is a senior, hands-on engineering role focused on turning models into reliable production services. You’ll build and own the pipelines, infrastructure, monitoring, governance, and deployment practices that allow our Data Science team to move from experimentation to production safely and repeatedly.

You’ll support both traditional machine learning and modern generative AI/LLM workloads, including retrieval-based and agentic applications. You’ll be responsible not simply for getting models into production, but for ensuring they remain performant, observable, secure, cost-effective, and maintainable once they get there.

You’ll work closely with our U.S.-based Data Science team. Because many of Dynatron’s data pipelines and model workloads run overnight in U.S. time, they align naturally with the India workday. You will have significant ownership of the production environment during this critical operating window.

What You’ll Do

Build & Own the ML Production Lifecycle

  • Design, build, and maintain deployment pipelines that move models reliably from development through validation and into production.
  • Establish model versioning, lineage, registry, and automated promotion practices.
  • Define repeatable production-readiness standards and deployment patterns across ML and AI workloads.
  • Partner with Data Scientists to make model handoffs efficient, consistent, and production-ready.

Drive ML Reliability & Observability

  • Own production monitoring across model performance, drift, data quality, inference health, latency, and availability.
  • Establish alerts and operational thresholds that identify degradation before it materially impacts downstream products or customers.
  • Diagnose production failures, perform root-cause analysis, and implement durable corrective actions.
  • Build operational practices that improve reliability as Dynatron’s portfolio of production models grows.

Operationalize Generative AI & LLM Workloads

  • Deploy and support production LLM applications, including retrieval-based and agentic architectures.
  • Build evaluation frameworks that measure quality, reliability, and performance of generative AI capabilities.
  • Monitor token consumption, inference costs, and cost per interaction to ensure AI capabilities remain economically sustainable.
  • Implement appropriate controls around model access, usage, safety, and production behavior.

Build Training & Retraining Infrastructure

  • Design and operate infrastructure supporting model training, validation, and retraining.
  • Build automated retraining pipelines triggered by appropriate performance, data, or business conditions.
  • Ensure training environments and workflows are reproducible, scalable, and observable.
  • Partner with Data Engineering and Data Science to ensure reliable movement of data throughout the ML lifecycle.

Establish AI/ML Governance

  • Implement model access controls, auditability, lineage, and governance standards.
  • Support model risk classification and appropriate controls based on use case and business impact.
  • Produce documentation and technical evidence required to support security, compliance, and internal governance requirements.
  • Help establish responsible production practices as Dynatron expands its use of AI.

Own Production Operations

  • Take meaningful ownership of the operational health of Dynatron’s production ML and AI services.
  • Respond to incidents, troubleshoot failures, and coordinate resolution across teams when necessary.
  • Build runbooks and operational procedures that reduce dependence on tribal knowledge.
  • Identify recurring operational issues and automate them away wherever practical.

What You Bring

MLOps & Production ML Experience

  • 6+ years of experience in software engineering, data engineering, machine learning engineering, or a related technical discipline.
  • 3+ years of hands-on experience deploying and operating AI/ML systems in production.
  • Demonstrated experience supporting both traditional machine learning and LLM-based workloads in production.
  • Strong understanding of the complete model lifecycle from development and validation through deployment, monitoring, retraining, and retirement.

Generative AI & LLM Expertise

  • Production experience with LLM-powered applications and agentic frameworks.
  • Experience with retrieval architectures, evaluation methodologies, and production monitoring for generative AI.
  • Understanding of LLM performance, latency, token utilization, and cost-per-interaction management.
  • Ability to establish practical operational and governance controls around generative AI systems.

Cloud & MLOps Engineering

  • Deep experience with a major cloud platform and its managed AI/ML services; AWS strongly preferred.
  • Hands-on experience with model registries, pipeline orchestration, ML CI/CD, automated retraining, and production monitoring.
  • Strong Python engineering skills.
  • Experience with containerization and infrastructure-as-code.
  • Experience designing reliable, repeatable, and automated production environments.

Production Operations

  • Experience operating production services with meaningful ownership for reliability and availability.
  • Strong incident response, troubleshooting, and root-cause analysis skills.
  • Ability to distinguish symptoms from underlying system failures and implement long-term solutions.
  • Comfortable making sound operational decisions independently when immediate U.S.-based support may not be available.

Communication & Documentation

  • Strong written technical communication skills.
  • Experience creating runbooks, architectural documentation, standards, and operational procedures.
  • Proactive communication style suited to distributed, asynchronous teams.
  • Ability to work effectively across Data Engineering, Data Science, Product, and other technical functions.

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent practical experience.

Nice to Have

  • Experience implementing AI governance, model risk tiering, or access-control frameworks.
  • Experience with modern data warehouse and orchestration technologies in production analytics environments.
  • Experience supporting large-scale data and ML workloads within an AWS ecosystem.
  • Experience working successfully on distributed global teams with U.S.-based colleagues.

What Success Looks Like

Successful Senior Machine Learning Engineers at Dynatron:
  • Make deploying a model to production repeatable rather than exceptional.
  • Build production AI and ML services that are observable, reliable, secure, and cost-effective.
  • Identify model degradation and operational issues before they become significant customer or business problems.
  • Create clear standards for how ML and AI capabilities move from experimentation into production.
  • Build governance into the ML lifecycle rather than adding it after deployment.
  • Reduce manual intervention through automation and strong engineering practices.
  • Create documentation and runbooks that allow knowledge to scale across the organization.
  • Operate independently while maintaining strong partnership with U.S.-based Data Science and Data Engineering teams.

Why Dynatron

  • Help build the production foundation behind a rapidly expanding portfolio of AI-enabled SaaS products.
  • Work across traditional ML, generative AI, LLMs, and emerging agentic technologies.
  • Solve meaningful MLOps challenges against large-scale automotive datasets and real-world customer applications.
  • High-impact senior IC role with meaningful ownership of Dynatron’s production AI infrastructure.
  • Work closely with Data Science, Data Engineering, Product, and technology leadership as Dynatron continues its evolution toward an AI-first organization.
  • Remote environment offering autonomy, ownership, and significant technical responsibility.

Compensation & Benefits

Compensation: Competitive and market-aligned for India
Employment: Full-time through Dynatron’s Employer of Record partner
Benefits Include:
  • Competitive local benefits provided through our Employer of Record
  • Remote working environment
  • Ongoing professional development opportunities
  • Opportunity to work directly with U.S.-based Data and Technology teams
  • Meaningful ownership of production systems supporting Dynatron’s AI strategy
Ready to build the engineering foundation that turns AI experimentation into reliable, scalable production capabilities? Join Dynatron and help us operationalize the next generation of intelligent automotive software.

Integra Partners is seeking an experienced Implementation Manager to lead complex, post-sale health plan implementations from initiation through operational handoff. This role owns the implementation plan, client relationship, cross-functional coordination, risks, decisions, and readiness activities required to deliver on time, within scope, and with a high-quality client experience. The successful candidate brings direct health plan implementation experience and practical knowledge of claims operations, testing, and issue resolution.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:
  • Independently leads complex implementations for health plan clients and healthcare partners, from kickoff and requirements validation through testing, launch, stabilization, and transition to operations.
  • Build and maintain the integrated implementation project plan, work breakdown structure, milestones, dependencies, decision log, risk and issue log, and executive status reporting.
  • Serve as the primary implementation point of contact for external clients and coordinate internal teams across operations, claims, technology, network, clinical, finance, compliance, and other functional areas.
  • Translate contractual commitments, requirements, operational workflows, and technical specifications into clear implementation requirements, owners, due dates, acceptance criteria, and signoffs.
  • Lead claims-related implementation activities, including workflow design, configuration validation, test scenario development, end-to-end claims testing, defect triage, reconciliation, and production readiness.
  • Monitor timeline, scope, quality, budget, and resource needs; identify risks early and drive mitigation, escalation, and resolution with accountable owners.
  • Facilitate internal and client-facing meetings, document outcomes, and communicate concise status summaries, recommendations, decisions, and next steps to project teams and senior leadership.
  • Ensure implementation documentation is complete and audit-ready, including project plans, requirements, meeting materials, test evidence, approvals, lessons learned, and transition documentation.
  • Apply a continuous-improvement mindset to simplify processes, strengthen controls, and improve implementation quality and repeatability.
  • Mentor junior team members and contribute to implementation standards, templates, playbooks, and best practices.
REQUIRED QUALIFICATION:
  • 5+ years of implementation, project management, client delivery, or related experience in healthcare, including direct responsibility for health plan or payer implementations.
  • Demonstrated experience leading implementation work with health plans, including requirements, cross-functional readiness, client governance, testing, launch, and post-launch stabilization.
  • Claims experience is required, with working knowledge of healthcare claims workflows, configuration, testing, adjudication outcomes, exception handling, reconciliation, and issue resolution.
  • Experience managing multiple work-streams, dependencies, risks, and executive-level communications in a client-facing environment.
  • Ability to understand complex healthcare, operational, and technical concepts and translate them into clear business language and executable plans.
  • Strong facilitation, organization, documentation, analytical problem-solving, and written and verbal communication skills.
  • Proficiency with standard project management and productivity tools; ability to quickly learn company systems and processes.
  • Ability to exercise sound judgment, manage competing priorities, and drive accountability without direct authority.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:
  • Experience with Durable Medical Equipment, Prosthetics, Orthotics, and Supplies (DMEPOS), including related benefits, provider or supplier workflows, claims, and operational considerations.
  • Experience implementing network management, utilization management, provider network, or delegated services programs.
  • Project management certification or formal project management methodology experience.
  • Experience working in a highly regulated healthcare environment and handling confidential or sensitive information.
EDUCATION AND ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:
  • Bachelor's degree preferred, or equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.
  • Willingness and ability to travel up to 35%, based on business and client needs.

SUCCESS IN THE ROLE:

First 6 months
  • Develop a strong understanding of the role, departmental policies, implementation tools, and assigned client programs.
  • Establish effective working relationships with client and internal stakeholders and independently manage core implementation routines.
  • Set measurable professional development and delivery goals.
By 12 months
  • Consistently lead complex health plan implementations with clear ownership, disciplined governance, and executive-ready communication.
  • Demonstrate strong command of claims implementation dependencies and drive issues through resolution and stabilization.
  • Contribute knowledge, templates, lessons learned, and process improvements that strengthen the implementation function.

This senior-level role, reporting to the Creative Director, balances design execution with creative leadership, elevating craft standards, enhancing ways of working, and owning day-to-day creative delivery. You can manage the design and execution of entire campaigns (not just the production of specific pieces) and demonstrate an ability to keep other team members working alongside you within established deadlines. You demonstrate a high level of proficiency in design software and applications as well as great knowledge of printing procedures, photography, illustration, 3D and structural. You’ll also play a key role in leading new business efforts, from contributing to standout creative ideas through to confidently presenting and delivering pitches.

Your work will span a diverse range of clients and categories: from brand identity and campaign rollouts to leave-behinds, animation storyboards, conference/event collateral, OOH, experiential, large format, POS, 3D, structural, sales aids, eDMs, and social content.

Key Responsibilities

  • Deliver best-in-class creative ideas and design across digital and print.
  • Execute solutions from concept to final delivery: typography, branding, campaign rollouts, leave-behinds, animation storyboards, and sales/educational collateral.
  • Develop assets for a wide range of touchpoints: social, eDMs, websites, conference/event materials, OOH, experiential, large format, POS, 3D and structural.
  • Lead and contribute to new business pitches with standout creative ideas, polished execution, and confident delivery.
  • Present and deliver design thinking in client presentations and internal forums, delivering irresistible presentations that showcase solutions and astound clients.

  • Serve as a key client-facing creative lead, building strong day-to-day relationships, attending status and briefing meetings, and confidently presenting creative work that earns trust and drives results.
  • Go the journey from initial mood boards and scamps, through to supporting the final execution. Live and breathe projects, big and small, approaching each challenge with passion, intelligence and humour.
  • Bring an inquisitive multi-channel mindset and a keen eye for the latest industry trends, helping push clients’ brands forward with big, ideas-led thinking.
  • Use Figma and Adobe Creative Suite to create, manage, and evolve design systems and collaborative workflows.
  • Embrace and champion AI tools and workflows as part of the creative process exploring how emerging technology can accelerate ideation, enhance output quality and open up new creative possibilities for the team and our clients.

Note on working arrangements

  • The role is expected to be remote; however, some travel to New Jersey, USA, may be required.
  • Availability to work 9am-5pm within the US East Coast time zone is essential
  • Candidates must have in-depth knowledge of US regulations, including FDA promotional regulations and the PhRMA Code on Interactions with Health Care Professionals

About You

  • 8+ years’ experience in a similar Creative role, with a demonstrated track record of conceptualising and executing impactful, engaging creative across platforms. Experience in health/pharma essential.
  • Strong leadership and mentoring experience, able to support and inspire a creative team.
  • A portfolio of previous work that shows the ability to turn a concept into a finished execution—spanning digital, print, OOH, social, campaign, and pitch work.
  • Abundant experience designing for Print, Digital, 3D, Structural, Experiential, Social, Animation, large format, and POS across a wide range of deliverables, including typography, branding, campaign rollouts, leave-behinds, sales aids, animation storyboards, conference/event collateral, eDMs, and OOH.
  • Proven experience leading and delivering new business pitches with confidence.
  • Advanced fluency in Adobe Creative Suite (InDesign, Photoshop, Illustrator) and Figma; Cinema 4D (or similar 3D software) highly regarded. Experience in Unreal, After Effects and/or Premiere is a strong advantage.
  • Extensive experience conceptualising and executing your own ideas within established brand guidelines, across campaign concepting, branding, production and multi-channel rollout.
  • A confident communicator who can inspire clients and colleagues alike.
  • A genuine curiosity about AI and its role in the future of creativity — comfortable experimenting with AI-assisted workflows and keen to help build a culture where the team uses these tools thoughtfully and to their full potential.
  • Passionate about ideas and the power of creativity to make real-world impact across any category. Background in retail marketing (online/in-store), OOH advertising, film/TV, gaming or consumer electronics a bonus.

Above all, the successful candidate to join Orchard will be someone who has a strong work ethic driven by creative passion, positive energy and thrives on challenges, alongside a desire to grow with the company!

Orchard Marketing is part of the Enero Group. As a Group, we proudly acknowledge the traditional custodians of the land on which we operate, the Gadigal People of the Eora Nation. Our Innovate, Level 2, RAP endorsement aims to nurture, develop, encourage, and include Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander talent, partners, and advisors both in our own agency, and across the broader industry. As such, we encourage peoples of all backgrounds to apply.

At Orchard, the future has always inspired us. As we imagine how people will connect, what they expect from brands, and where they'll turn for their essentials, we're driven by curiosity.

This curiosity pushes us to see brands not as single moments, but as a web of connected experiences. In an era where every touchpoint is an opportunity to delight and engage, we fuse creativity, data and technology to influence action across the entire customer journey.

jobs.description:
About JobGet

As the #1 app focused on everyday workers, JobGet is redefining the future of hiring. Founded in 2019, JobGet began as the only mobile-first hiring platform for everyday workers. Since then, we’ve grown by joining forces with Snagajob, the largest hourly job board in the U.S., followed by Seasoned, the leading platform for restaurant hiring. Each acquisition has brought JobGet closer to the frontline, making the platform faster, smarter, and more effective.

While most platforms chase volume, JobGet is laying the foundation for a new kind of hiring infrastructure focused on precision, speed, and real outcomes. Our AI-powered engine learns, adapts, and improves continuously. Employers don’t just get candidates, they get hires. Workers don’t just search, they get matched. The result is a more efficient hiring process with less friction and better results.

We serve a diverse range of industries, from food service and customer support to healthcare, logistics, and manufacturing. With access to over 200 million job seekers, our platform leverages cutting-edge AI to match qualified, role-ready candidates, automating key parts of the hiring process for faster decisions and better outcomes. By combining scale with precision, we’re transforming how businesses hire and how people find meaningful work.

Our mission is simple: to help everyday workers thrive by providing accessible, frictionless hiring solutions that deliver real results. Join us as we continue to build the future of work for the millions of people who power our world every day.

Learn more about our culturehere.

Who We Are

We’ve designed our values to be more than just buzzwords; they’re things we can do. We hope that our culture reflects our values by our commitment to living them every day.

Make a difference every day

  • Teamwork - We make time to help colleagues across JobGet succeed.
  • Excellence - We set ambitious targets, put in extraordinary effort, and persevere until we have accomplished — or exceeded — our goals.
  • Innovation - We’re a team of creative, outside-the-box thinkers who thrive in a continuously evolving environment. To us, innovation is about questioning the status quo and always striving to do things better.

Have Unwavering grit

  • Resilience - By remaining resilient and adaptable, we grow stronger as individuals and as an organization.
  • Accountability - We operate with an ownership mentality where everyone feels a sense of responsibility to make us better and always act in the best interest of JobGet.
  • Speed - We make decisions fast and execute them even faster. Bias for speed is one of our core strengths and a key advantage over our competitors.

Grow through curiosity & kindness

  • Respect - We treat each other with mutual respect, kindness, and celebrate our differences.
  • Learning - We ask questions and seek to understand by being genuinely curious & communicative.
  • Culture - We believe that each of us is responsible for our culture. It requires self-discipline and the drive to contribute to something greater than ourselves.

What You’ll Do

As our Principal Data Engineer, you will help lead the technical direction for how data flows, scales, and powers every decision at JobGet. You’ll own the data architecture behind our platform that connects hundreds of millions of job seekers with employers across dozens of industries; and you’ll do it at the intersection of high-throughput pipelines, real-time matching signals, and AI-driven product experiences.

Data Platform Architecture & Strategy

  • Drive Architectural Decisions: Lead design reviews for critical platform components, evaluating trade-offs across scalability, cost, reliability, and time-to-insight.
  • Champion Modern Data Stack Adoption: Evaluate and introduce best-in-class tooling (Databricks, Snowflake, dbt, Kafka, etc.) aligned with engineering principles and business needs.
  • Ensure Platform Reliability: Own the observability, alerting, and operational readiness standards for tier-1 pipelines, including runbooks, failover strategies, and reprocessing protocols.
  • Autonomy & Decision Making: Demonstrate high resourcefulness; you are empowered to make significant technical decisions and drive projects end-to-end with limited oversight.

Data Modeling & Pipeline Engineering

  • Build Production-Grade Pipelines: Design and implement robust batch data pipelines using Snowflake and dbt as the core of JobGet’s transformation layer, ingesting and serving data across product telemetry, marketplace signals, employer activity, and candidate behavior.
  • Lead Data Modeling Decisions: Establish data modeling standards (schema design, dimensional modeling, and data contracts) that serve analytics, ML feature engineering, and product instrumentation.
  • Solve the Hardest Problems: Personally take on the most complex data integration, performance, and reliability challenges that require principal-level judgment and hands-on implementation.
  • Support Real-Time & Near-Real-Time Needs: Architect and evolve streaming data infrastructure using technologies such as KSQL and Apache Flink to power real-time matching, recommendation, and product decisioning systems.

AI & Analytics Enablement

  • Enable Machine Learning at Scale: Partner closely with Platform Engineers and Data Analysts to design feature stores, training data pipelines, and inference-ready datasets that power JobGet’s AI matching engine.
  • Accelerate Analytics Delivery: Work with Data Analytics stakeholders to ensure data products are well-modeled, documented, and performant for self-serve consumption. Evaluate and integrate emerging AI-powered tools to enhance operational efficiency and developer productivity.

Data Governance, Quality & Security

  • Establish Data Governance Standards: Define and enforce policies for data quality, lineage, access control, and cataloging that scale across a growing and multi-product organization.
  • Protect Data Integrity: Implement data validation frameworks, SLA monitoring, and anomaly detection to maintain trustworthy data across all consumers.
  • Ensure Compliance & Privacy: Design data systems with privacy-by-default principles, ensuring alignment with applicable regulations (CCPA, GDPR, etc.) across candidate and employer data.

Hands-On Execution & Technical Excellence

  • Raise the Technical Bar: Mentor and level up engineers across the data team through code reviews and design guidance.
  • Partner Across Engineering & Product: Collaborate with Software Engineering, Product, and Analytics to ensure data requirements are deeply understood at inception.
  • Influence Without Authority: Drive adoption of data platform standards and architectural patterns across teams through clear communication, documentation, and trust-building.
  • Proactive Problem Solving: Personally identify and execute fixes for deep-seated bottlenecks, architectural bugs, and performance issues that impact system stability.

Who You Are

  • 10+ years of data engineering experience, with at least 3–5 years operating at a principal or staff IC level in a start-up environment.
  • Production-grade experience with Snowflake and dbt (required); you’ve designed, owned, and scaled these in a real product environment, not just used them.
  • Experience with real-time streaming technologies such as KSQL or Apache Flink is strongly preferred; you’ve built or operated streaming pipelines in production.

Binance is a leading global blockchain ecosystem behind the world’s largest cryptocurrency exchange by trading volume and registered users. Binance offerings range from trading and finance to education, research, payments, institutional services, Web3 features, and more. We leverage the power of digital assets and blockchain to build an inclusive financial ecosystem to advance the freedom of money and improve financial access for people around the world.

Role Overview

You will be responsible for production-grade AI data processing and knowledge services for Binance’s equities business. You will transform financial information—announcements, news, earnings reports, earnings call transcripts and audio/video, research reports, and more—into data, knowledge, and evidence that trading products and Binance AI can directly consume. Knowledge engineering, knowledge bases, and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) are the core scenarios. You will also build reusable processing frameworks and own model and rule integration, task orchestration, servitization, quality control, cost management, and production stability—not just document parsing, vectorization, or model API calls.

Responsibilities:

  • Own production-grade AI data processing pipelines for financial content (announcements, news, financial reports, earnings call materials, research reports, etc.), covering text, table, layout, and audio/video processing, as well as chunking, deduplication, clustering, standardization, versioning, and result validation.

  • Build layered financial knowledge bases that manage source documents, structured facts, entities and events, full-text and vector indices, and relationship data; maintain metadata including source, time, security, market, language, version, and authorization.

  • Engineer and operate RAG services in production—building query processing, permission and time filtering, multi-route retrieval, reranking integration, context assembly, evidence citation, and result return pipelines that ensure traceability to original sources.

  • Design extensible AI data processing, knowledge engineering, and indexing frameworks with unified interfaces to adapt to new sources, formats, languages, models, rules, and algorithms; support incremental updates, index rebuilds, historical backfill, deletion, and authorization expiry.

  • Integrate LLMs, document understanding models, NLP models, rule systems, and algorithm components into a unified pipeline with clear input/output contracts, task orchestration, version governance, and failure handling.

  • Own engineering capabilities for AI data processing and knowledge services: APIs, async tasks, queues, caching, retry and graceful degradation, human review, canary releases, rollbacks, fault recovery, and capacity governance.

  • Establish a quality system for AI data processing, knowledge, and RAG—measuring parsing accuracy, retrieval coverage, citation completeness, staleness, latency, stability, and cost, with tiered root-cause analysis.

  • Collaborate with data, algorithm, product, and compliance teams to deploy AI data processing and knowledge services reliably in user-facing equities products and Binance AI.

Requirements:

  • Master’s degree or above in Computer Science, Software Engineering, AI, or a related field; 5+ years of experience in backend, data platforms, ML engineering, or AI application engineering.

  • Familiarity with equity markets and the investor research and decision-making workflow; understanding of trading mechanics, market data, fundamentals, corporate actions, and major market events; ability to assess the entities, time sensitivity, sources, and usage boundaries of financial information.

  • Proficient in Python and at least one of Java or another backend language; solid software engineering, distributed systems, and service interface design skills.

  • Production experience with LLMs, NLP, or ML systems; ability to explain model invocation, task orchestration, failure recovery, version governance, and online issue resolution.

  • Production experience with knowledge engineering or RAG systems; familiarity with structured, semi-structured, and unstructured content processing; ability to explain the full pipeline from source ingestion through retrieval, citation, and online feedback.

  • Familiarity with full-text search, vector search, document storage, and their combinations; understanding of chunking, indexing, filtering, recall, reranking, context assembly, citation, and permission control—not tied to any specific database or framework.

  • Experience with performance, stability, cost, and observability governance for high-concurrency or large-scale processing systems—beyond model API calls or demo prototypes.

  • Experience adapting new data sources or content types; ability to distill source-specific logic into reusable processing capabilities.

Why Binance

• Shape the future with the world’s leading blockchain ecosystem
• Collaborate with world-class talent in a user-centric global organization with a flat structure
• Tackle unique, fast-paced projects with autonomy in an innovative environment
• Thrive in a results-driven workplace with opportunities for career growth and continuous learning
• Competitive salary and company benefits
• Work-from-home arrangement (the arrangement may vary depending on the work nature of the business team)

Guided by our purpose to develop medicines that make a profound impact on people’s lives, our global teams have delivered a portfolio of therapies since our founding in 1997. More recently, with the close of the Amicus acquisition, our portfolio has expanded to include therapies for Fabry disease and Pompe disease, expanding our ability to reach more people living with rare genetic conditions.

Our success comes from our unwavering commitment to excellence, our deep understanding of patient needs, our scientific expertise, and our world-class manufacturing capabilities. At the heart of BioMarin is a dedicated team of the brightest minds in the industry working together to deliver innovative therapies to patients and families around the world.

About Worldwide Research and Development
From research and discovery to post-market clinical development, our R&D engine involves all bench and clinical research and the associated groups that support those endeavors. Our teams work on developing first-in-class and best-in-class therapeutics that provide meaningful advances to patients who live with rare diseases.

SUMMARY DESCRIPTION:

This position progressively develops the medical writing function in alignment with the requirements of the Development Sciences department and organizational goals. Filling this need with a regular full-time employee will enable BioMarin to reduce writing-related CRO and contractor costs, increase Clinical Medical Writing productivity to meet development needs, and realize efficiencies and consistent documentation quality across programs through repeatable processes and continuity of knowledge of programs, investigational products, and indications. The Principal Clinical Medical Writer has functional oversight responsibilities for medical writing staff and for the medical writing requirements for clinical development programs, including authoring/editing documents.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Oversight responsibilities for Medical Writing staff
  • Works with the Head of Medical Writing to establish and maintain timelines for program planning.
  • Drafts and edits documents used in conducting and reporting the results of clinical studies, including protocols, protocol amendments, informed consent forms, and clinical study reports
  • Drafts and edits documents used in reporting aggregate safety and efficacy information for a molecule, such as investigator’s brochures and periodic safety reports (e.g. PBRERs, DSURs)
  • Drafts and edits documents used in the preparation of regulatory filings (e.g. briefing books, CTD Module 2/Module 5 clinical or integrated summaries).
  • Manages study team participation in the preparation of such documents, including scheduling and chairing meetings, developing and managing timelines, and managing the document review and comment adjudication processes
  • Represents CMW at cross-functional team meetings (e.g. study team, development team, other sub-teams).
  • Provides peer review and editing support for other regulatory documents, such as statistical analysis plans, CRFs, and other study materials
  • Adheres to departmental procedures and practices and technical and industry standards during all aspects of work.
  • Assists in developing and reviewing standard processes and templates within Clinical Medical Writing, and may also review/consult on the development of standard processes and templates in other departments
  • Works effectively with cross-functional groups within BioMarin
  • Other tasks as assigned.

EXPERIENCE:

Clinical Studies

  • Advanced understanding of the drug development process (discovery to market), biostatistical and clinical research concepts, clinical study conduct, clinical study data collection, database management, data integration, and generation of datasets.
  • Intermediate to advanced understanding of scientific concepts integral to nonclinical development, CMC, PK, PD, and antibody detection.
  • Advanced applied knowledge of:
  • Documentation required for the conduct of clinical studies
  • Protocol design (including objectives, efficacy and safety endpoints, and procedures for collecting and reporting AEs and SAEs)
  • Study results reporting
  • Integrated results reporting
  • Management Experience:
  • Prior administrative and/or functional management experience as a manager of a medical writer team or department in a clinical development setting preferred but not required
  • Demonstrated leadership abilities.
  • Demonstrated ability to plan timelines and resources for multiple documentation projects with shifting priorities.
  • Experience with delegating and overseeing projects and tasks.

Medical Writing

  • Writing high-quality documents that support corporate goals and objectives.
  • Experience writing, reviewing, or editing protocols, clinical study reports, INDs, BLA/NDAs, periodic safety documents, and regulatory briefing books required.
  • Advanced applied knowledge of routine document content preparation, including the use of style guides (internal, AMA, CBE, Chicago), medical dictionaries, and guidance documents that prescribe content.
  • Ability to interpret and create complex tabular and graphical clinical data presentations.
  • Ability to interpret basic clinical laboratory tests.
  • Understanding of the concepts of coding dictionaries (MedDRA, WHO Drug).

Regulatory

  • Ability to plan and manage development of the following documents in context of regulatory requirements and guidances, development program plans, and organizational business needs:
  • Standalone’ regulatory documents (eg, protocols, investigator brochures, clinical study reports, IND annual reports)
  • Prior familiarity with standard eCTD IND/NDA work, including:
  • Modules 2, 3, 4, and 5 of INDs/NDAs in eCTD format
  • Integrated Summary of Safety (ISS), Integrated Summary of Efficacy (ISE)
  • Support project teams by identifying and summarizing relevant regulations and guidelines, including differences between US and EMEA submissions and to provide recommendations for changes in documentation in response to new or modified regulations and guidances.

Project Management

  • Ability to plan, resource, and assign multiple simultaneous document development projects (standalone and complex dossiers) with shifting priorities.
  • Ability to keep CMW line management apprised of program document status, to anticipate potential issues within a program, and to raise those issues to CMW line management with proposed mitigations/solutions
  • Ability to support staff in renegotiating timelines during development as necessary.

Program Management

  • Capable of managing and maintaining multiple timelines governing multiple projects within a program.
  • Capable of performing resource assessments (short- and long-term) based on projected project needs within a program.
  • Capable of anticipating potential issues within a program and raising those issues to CMW line management with proposed mitigations/solutions.

Communication

  • Capable of well organized, concise and clear written and verbal communication.
  • Capable of comprehending complex scientific concepts and translating them into clear, concise, appropriately referenced text that meets regulatory requirements.
  • Effective at explaining writing principles to a varied audience both in individual and group settings; basic presentation skills.

EDUCATION:

  • Masters (MS) or higher degree preferred; scientific focus desirable.
  • Evidence of medical writing career development desirable, e.g. European/American Medical Writers Association certificate, Editor in Life Sciences certificate, or relevant training through Drug Information Association

Note: This description is not intended to be all-inclusive, or a limitation of the duties of the position. It is intended to describe the general nature of the job that may include other duties as assumed or assigned.

jobs.title: Executive Vice President (EVP) Finance – Insurance & Investments
jobs.excerpt: Executive Vice President (EVP) Finance – Insurance & Investments About the RoleThe Executive Vice President (EVP) Finance is a senior enterprise-level finance executive responsible for providing strategic and operational financial leadership across the Group's insurance, investment, asset management, and related financial services businesses.
jobs.description:
Executive Vice President (EVP) Finance – Insurance & Investments

About the Role

The Executive Vice President (EVP) Finance is a senior enterprise-level finance executive responsible for providing strategic and operational financial leadership across the Group's insurance, investment, asset management, and related financial services businesses.

The EVP Finance will work closely with the Group CFO, CEO, Board, business-unit CEOs, investment leadership, and senior executives to strengthen financial performance, capital efficiency, profitability, governance, risk management, and long-term enterprise value.

Key Responsibilities

Lead enterprise-wide financial strategy, planning, budgeting, forecasting, and performance management.

Provide executive oversight of financial performance across subsidiaries, business units, and investment platforms.

Drive Group-wide FP&A, management reporting, financial modelling, and commercial finance.

Monitor revenue, profitability, expenses, margins, cash flow, ROE, ROIC, and return on capital.

Oversee financial management of insurance operations, including premiums, claims, reserves, reinsurance, underwriting performance, and profitability.

Provide financial leadership for investment and asset management businesses, including portfolio reporting, valuation, investment income, performance analysis, and cost management.

Lead strategic capital planning, capital allocation, solvency, liquidity, and balance-sheet optimization.

Provide executive oversight of treasury, funding, cash management, and liquidity planning.

Establish and strengthen Group-wide financial governance, internal controls, accounting policies, and risk-management frameworks.

Ensure compliance with applicable accounting standards, tax requirements, insurance regulations, investment regulations, and statutory reporting requirements.

Lead financial evaluation and due diligence for M&A, acquisitions, joint ventures, strategic investments, restructuring, and market expansion.

Partner with the Investment, Actuarial, Risk, Compliance, Legal, Treasury, and Operations functions on major strategic and financial decisions.

Drive enterprise-wide cost optimization, operational efficiency, and profitability improvement.

Lead finance transformation, including ERP modernization, automation, AI/data analytics, dashboards, and digital finance initiatives.

Maintain senior relationships with regulators, auditors, investors, lenders, rating agencies, and other financial stakeholders.

Provide high-level financial advice to the CEO, Group CFO, Board, and Executive Committee.

Build a strong succession pipeline and lead senior finance executives across the organization.

Support the development and execution of the Group's long-term growth and value-creation strategy.

Strategic KPIs

Group revenue and earnings growth

EBITDA / operating profit

ROE, ROIC, and return on capital

Capital adequacy and solvency

Investment portfolio performance

Insurance underwriting profitability

Budget and forecast accuracy

Cost-to-income and expense efficiency

Liquidity and treasury performance

Balance-sheet optimization

Cost of capital

M&A and strategic investment returns

Regulatory and audit performance

Finance transformation and automation

Shareholder and enterprise value creation

Candidate Profile

18–25+ years of progressive finance experience, preferably within insurance, investment management, asset management, banking, reinsurance, pensions, or diversified financial services.

Extensive experience in enterprise-level, Group, regional, or multi-entity finance leadership.

Previous experience as EVP Finance, Executive Vice President Finance, Group Finance Director, Group CFO, CFO, SVP Finance, Finance Director, Deputy Group CFO, or equivalent.

Strong understanding of insurance finance, investment finance, capital management, treasury, financial reporting, and regulatory requirements.

Demonstrated experience managing complex organizations with multiple subsidiaries, business lines, and jurisdictions.

Strong commercial understanding of investments, financial markets, capital allocation, and enterprise performance.

Proven track record in M&A, capital raising, strategic investments, restructuring, or major transformation initiatives.

Extensive experience engaging with Boards, CEOs, regulators, investors, auditors, and other senior stakeholders.

Proven ability to lead large, geographically dispersed finance organizations.

Education & Professional Qualifications

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business, or related discipline.

Professional qualification such as CA, ACCA, CPA, CMA, CFA, or equivalent strongly preferred.

Additional qualifications in insurance, investments, risk, actuarial science, or financial management are advantageous.

Core Competencies

Enterprise Finance Strategy | Group Financial Management | FP&A | Financial Reporting | Insurance Finance | Investment Finance | Capital Allocation | Treasury | Solvency | Balance-Sheet Management | M&A | Financial Modelling | Risk Management | Governance | Regulatory Compliance | Cost Optimization | Finance Transformation | Executive Leadership

Leadership Characteristics

Exceptional strategic and commercial judgment

Strong executive presence

Enterprise-wide perspective

High integrity and governance orientation

Strong analytical and decision-making capability

Excellent Board and stakeholder communication

Results-driven and financially disciplined

Transformational and innovation-oriented

Strong talent-development and succession-planning capability

Comfortable operating in complex, regulated, multinational environments

jobs.description:
Freelance Data Engineer – AI Sales Development Representative (AI SDR)

Project Duration: 1 Week

Start Date: ASAP

Delivery Date: One week after start date

Engagement: Project-Based / Freelance

About the Project

We are looking for an experienced Data Engineer / Data Analyst to complete and integrate an existing AI Sales Development Representative (AI SDR) Bot.

Approximately 90% of the application is already developed. The primary requirement is to connect the existing components and communication channels and make the solution operational.

Scope of Work

The selected resource will:

  • Review and complete the existing AI SDR application.
  • Connect the prospect data/list-generation pipeline.
  • Integrate automated outreach through:

oEmail

oSMS

oWhatsApp

oAI Phone Call / Robo Call

  • Configure CUG-based phone calling, similar to the approach used in our existing SMS Marketing Campaign.
  • Connect prospect responses and outreach outcomes back to the AI SDR.
  • Complete the end-to-end workflow:

Prospect Identification Data Processing Outreach AI Interaction Qualification Sales Handoff

  • Conduct integration and end-to-end testing.
  • Fix bugs/issues identified during testing.
  • Provide basic technical documentation and knowledge transfer.

Scale

The initial target is 100,000 business prospects/month, with the architecture designed to support future scaling to 1M–2M prospects/month.

Ideal Candidate

  • Strong Data Engineering / Data Analytics background.
  • Experience integrating APIs and data pipelines.
  • Experience with Email, SMS, WhatsApp and telephony/voice APIs.
  • Experience with AI automation, AI agents or SDR/sales automation is highly desirable.
  • Able to work independently and deliver within one week.
  • Strong debugging and integration skills.

Important

This is not a greenfield development project. Approximately 90% of the application is already complete. We need someone who can connect the existing components, integrate the communication channels, test the system, and make it production-ready.

jobs.title: Enablement and Learning Program Manager
jobs.excerpt: At Sysdig, we believe cloud security isn't a compromise - it's a promise.
jobs.description:
At Sysdig, we believe cloud security isn't a compromise - it's a promise. From the start, our mission has been clear: to help organizations secure innovation in the cloud, the right way.
We created Falco, the open standard for cloud threat detection, and continue to lead the cloud security market with runtime insights, open innovation, and agentic Al. Creators of technology trusted by over 60% of the Fortune 500, Sysdig gives teams the real-time clarity to move fast and defend what matters most.
Culture matters here. We believe diversity fuels stronger ideas, and open dialogue drives sharper decisions. Recognized as a Best Place to Work and one of Deloitte's fastest-growing companies for the past 5 years, we're here to raise the standard for what cloud security and workplace culture should be.
If you have the passion to dig deeper, the desire to challenge convention, and the curiosity to build something better, Sysdig is the right place for you.

What you will do

  • Author Sysdig's enablement charter and operating model — what enablement owns, how success is measured, and how it's inspected — and get sign-off from Sales, CS, and RevOps leadership.
  • Own new-hire onboarding and the certification framework for GTM roles, with a clear, measured path to productivity. Build the ongoing recertification cadence so the program holds up as the team and product evolve.
  • Drive adoption and reinforcement of our sales methodology (e.g., MEDDPICC) and equip managers to coach it day-to-day. Coordinate delivery for major GTM moments like SKO and product launches, partnering with Product Marketing, who owns the underlying content.
  • Own the enablement tech stack (LMS, conversation intelligence) and drive structured adoption of AI-native GTM tools like Clay and enterprise Claude across the revenue org — role-based training and champions, not one-off demos.
  • Build and maintain the enablement KPI scorecard — leading indicators like training completion and certification pass rates, lagging indicators like ramp time and win rate — and use it to show where programs are and aren't moving the business.
  • Partner with Product Marketing on content adoption (they create, including battlecards; you drive field usage), RevOps on systems and reporting, and Sales/CS leadership to keep the roadmap tied to real pipeline and retention priorities.

What you will bring with you

  • 5–8+ years in sales, revenue, or GTM enablement, including experience building or significantly rebuilding a program (not just running an existing one).
  • A track record of designing measurement frameworks
  • Hands-on fluency with modern GTM and enablement tooling: LMS/content platforms, conversation intelligence (e.g., Gong), and AI-native GTM tools (e.g., Clay) and enterprise AI assistants (e.g., Claude) — you direct these tools and drive adoption, not just use them yourself.
  • Experience with a sales methodology framework (e.g., MEDDPICC, Command of the Message) and reinforcing it through coaching, not just a slide deck.
  • Excellent cross-functional collaboration skills — you can align Sales, CS, RevOps, and Product Marketing around a shared enablement plan without owning their turf.
  • A builder's mindset: comfortable defining charter and structure where none exists yet, and comfortable being judged on adoption and business metrics, not activity.

What we look for

  • Prior enablement experience in cybersecurity, cloud security, or infrastructure software.
  • Experience standing up or significantly evolving an enablement function at a company going through a platform or GTM transformation.
  • Experience running AI adoption/change-management programs (usage metrics, champions programs, structured rollout) rather than ad hoc tool training.

When you join Sysdig, you can expect

  • Extra days off to prioritize your well-being
  • 401(k) Retirement Savings Plan with a 3% company match
  • Maternity and Parental Leave
  • Mental health support for you and your family through the Modern Health app
  • Full health benefits package for you and your family
The U.S. annual salary range for this full-time position is between 128,000 and 160,000 USD/year. Actual offers may be higher or lower than this range based on a variety of factors, including your work location, job-related experience and education.
We would love for you to join us! Please reach out even if your experience doesn't perfectly match the job description. We can always explore other options after starting the conversation. Your background and passion will set you apart, especially if your career path is different.
Sysdig values a diverse workplace and encourages women, people of color, LGBTQIA+ individuals, people with disabilities, members of ethnic minorities, foreign-born residents, and veterans to apply. Sysdig is an equal-opportunity employer. Sysdig does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other legally protected status.

The Executive Vice President (EVP) Finance is a senior enterprise-level finance executive responsible for providing strategic and operational financial leadership across the Group's insurance, investment, asset management, and related financial services businesses.

The EVP Finance will work closely with the Group CFO, CEO, Board, business-unit CEOs, investment leadership, and senior executives to strengthen financial performance, capital efficiency, profitability, governance, risk management, and long-term enterprise value.
